jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT BRELLIUM

Brellium's mission is a big one – to improve the standard of care across the US healthcare system. We’ve built AI-powered technology that helps healthcare providers deliver safer, higher-quality care - starting with the first real-time medical review platform built to fix clinical and compliance risks before they impact patients.

Each year, 1 in 20 people in the U.S. experiences a medical diagnostic or compliance-related mistake. Most providers lack the time, staffing, and tools to mitigate these issues - so they go unnoticed, impacting care quality and increasing clinical and financial risk.

Brellium is building the AI-powered platform that helps providers deliver safer, more consistent care by mitigating risk early and aligning patient visits with clinical best practices. Our goal is to give every provider in the U.S. the tools to deliver clinically excellent, data-driven care - at scale.

Brellium was founded in 2021. Since then, we’ve grown to serve over 250,000 providers across all 50 states who use Brellium to take better care of their patients and ensure data-driven, compliant care. We’re a Series A company with over $30MM in funding from First Round Capital, Left Lane Capital, and Menlo Ventures.




THE ROLE

We're hiring a founding platform engineer. Brellium audits clinical notes against millions of criteria a day, with AI pipelines processing billions of tokens. You'll be the first person whose full-time job is scaling towards a highly available production environment by making our infrastructure reliable and observable, defining the patterns others build on, and making every engineer more effective in their work.

This is a hands-on senior IC role reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. You'll set this function's roadmap in collaboration with engineering leadership.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage and scale infrastructure that runs audits on clinical notes across millions of criteria daily

 - Define and support infrastructure patterns that can improve latency (e.g. making audits real time), reliability, and cost effectiveness

 - Improve developer productivity through CI/CD and local / testing environments

 - Simplify observability and drive key reliability metrics across all of our services, including AI pipelines that process billions of tokens daily

 - Manage our infrastructure and developer tooling spend

 - Steward our security posture (e.g. SOC 2, HIPAA compliance)

 - Consolidate SSO, identity, device management, and access controls across internal tools


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

 - You have owned the infrastructure / platform function somewhere

 - You have informed opinions about infrastructure and collaborate with product engineers to find right-sized solutions

 - You understand product engineering work to a high degree

 - You measure your work by whether other engineers actually use it

 - You'd rather ship something narrow in two weeks than complete in two months

 - You are used to the blurred lines at a startup and are biased towards taking ownership

 - You are experienced working in an environment with a high degree of autonomy


REQUIRED SKILLS

 - 5+ years where platform was your primary work

 - Built production infrastructure at an early-stage startup

 - Depth in AWS and infrastructure-as-code. Our tech stack includes AWS, Vercel, Azure Foundry, Claude Platform, OpenAI Platform, Gemini, and Clickhouse

 - You know how to write production-level code. Our applications are written in Python and Typescript

 - You have driven towards a target number for a cloud bill

 - You have managed audits for software compliance (e.g. SOC 2)


NICE TO HAVE

 - Healthcare or another regulated industry that includes sensitive-data handling

 - Experience with LLM infrastructure: inference cost management, gateways (e.g. Bifrost), tracing and evals (e.g. Langfuse)

 - Rolled out an identity provider like Okta

 - Mentored engineers or led a small team

Compensation: $230,000 - $300,000

We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health benefits, commuter benefits, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential.




BENEFITS OFFERED INCLUDE:

 - 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

 - Equity Compensation

 - Dinner Provided via DoorDash & stocked kitchen for NY employees

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage coverage of up to 100% premiums for you and your family

 - HSA / FSA

 - 11 paid holidays each year

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Training and professional development

 - Hybrid Work Schedule (4 days onsite, 3 if located > 1 hour away)




WHAT IT MEANS TO BE "ONE OF US"



Bias to Action: Brellium teammates do not wait to make reversible decisions or seek unnecessary approval. We quickly decide and move forward. If the decision was incorrect, we quickly reverse it and move forward.



Thinks for themselves: Brellium teammates do not take things at face value. We ask "why" until base truth is reached. If a better solution is present, Brellium teammates use it, regardless of status quo.



Negative Maintenance: The opposite of high maintenance isn’t low maintenance - it’s negative maintenance. Brellium teammates are poised under pressure, self-motivated, self-improving, self-disciplined, self-aware, and non-defensive.



Expect Excellence: We hold ourselves to exceptionally high and continuously rising standards. We strive for thoughtfulness in our decision making, and for speed and quality in our execution. We acknowledge trade-offs and communicate proactively.



Communicate with Clarity: Brellium teammates communicate concisely, directly, and purposefully. We optimize for ensuring our points are easily understood the first time.



We are aware of fraudulent job offers claiming to be from Brellium. All legitimate communication comes from brellium.com http://brellium.com, or no-reply@ashbyhq.com http://ashbyhq.com, and we will never ask for money or sensitive personal information as part of our hiring process. If there are any questions please direct them to peter@brellium.com http://brellium.com

jobs.title: Senior Accountant (Remote)
jobs.description:
Senior Accountant (Remote, Canada or United States)

Employment type: Full-time
Reports to: Finance & Accounting

About ZestyAI:

At ZestyAI, we build AI for impact — protecting what matters most. Our models help insurers reduce losses, close coverage gaps, and protect families, businesses, and communities from a changing climate. Using computer vision, generative models, and gradient boosting, we turn property and climate risk into precise, actionable intelligence for every property in North America.

We are a high-velocity innovation machine and one team with one dream. We aim high, hire higher, own our outcomes, and operate with trust and transparency. We are a remote-first company that comes together intentionally through team meetups, regional gatherings, and an annual company offsite.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Senior Accountant to own the day-to-day accounting operations that keep ZestyAI running smoothly and our books audit-ready. This role reaches across the entire general ledger — from accounts payable and receivable to billing, employee expenses, cash, and month-end close — so you'll be equally comfortable cutting an invoice, chasing a collection, reconciling a bank account, and preparing a journal entry. It's a hands-on seat at the heart of our finance/accounting team, and you'll partner closely with the Controller, Director of Finance, and cross-functional teams — with real ownership and room to grow as we scale.

We're a remote-first company that moves fast, and we want someone who works smarter, not harder. You should be genuinely excited to put AI and automation to work — in your own day-to-day and in the systems and processes we're building — to eliminate manual effort and make the close faster and cleaner. If you're detail-obsessed, take pride in clean reconciliations, like to roll up your sleeves and get stuff done, and get a kick out of finding a better way, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll Do:

• Accounts payable: Own the AP cycle — process and code vendor invoices, verify approvals, and prepare payment runs for release by an authorized approver, while maintaining strong vendor relationships.

• Accounts receivable: Manage the AR cycle end to end, including customer invoicing, collections, cash application, and follow-up on outstanding balances.

• Billing: Prepare and issue accurate, timely customer invoices in line with contract terms, and resolve billing questions and discrepancies.

• Cash reconciliation: Perform daily and monthly bank and cash reconciliations, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately and discrepancies are investigated and resolved promptly.

• Employee expense reports: Review and process employee expense reports for policy compliance, accuracy, and proper coding, and administer the corporate card program.

• Month-end close: Assist with a timely and accurate monthly close, including preparing journal entries, accruals, and supporting schedules.

• Account reconciliations: Prepare balance sheet account reconciliations, researching and clearing reconciling items on a timely basis for review by the Controller.

• Audit support: Assist with annual financial statement audits, including preparing schedules, gathering supporting documentation, and responding to auditor requests.

• Process & controls: Help maintain and improve accounting policies, internal controls, and process documentation as the company scales.

• Automation & AI: Actively look for ways to streamline and automate accounting workflows, bringing AI and modern tools into day-to-day tasks and into the systems we rely on.

• Ad hoc: Support special projects, system improvements, and cross-functional initiatives as needed.

What You'll Bring:

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally spanning AP, AR, billing, and general ledger; a mix of public accounting and private industry is a plus.

• Solid working knowledge of US GAAP and full-cycle accounting.

• Hands-on experience with cloud accounting systems (e.g., QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar), advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets, and experience with Ramp.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, and a demonstrated ability to meet close deadlines and manage competing priorities.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to investigate and resolve discrepancies independently.

• Clear, professional communication skills and a collaborative, ownership-driven mindset.

• An AI-forward, work-smarter-not-harder approach, with a track record of using automation or AI tools to save time and improve accuracy in prior roles.

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced, remote-first environment where priorities can shift quickly.

Nice to Have:

• CPA (or working toward it).

• Experience at a high-growth technology or SaaS company.

• Familiarity with revenue recognition (ASC 606) and SaaS billing workflows.

The Team:

Our finance team is small, flat, and hands-on. There are no ivory towers here — everyone is a do-er, leadership included, and the best idea wins regardless of who it comes from. You'll have direct access to decision-makers, a real say in how we work, and the autonomy to run with it. It's a culture people genuinely love: ZestyAI holds a 5.0 rating on Glassdoor.

Why Join Us:

You'll do high-impact work at a company using AI to help protect communities from climate risk—surrounded by exceptional teammates who value trust, ownership, and rapid growth.

• Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, and vision).

• Stock options for all full-time employees.

• 401(k) / RRSP plans.

• Unlimited vacation, plus life insurance and disability coverage.

• Home office funding, monthly team lunches, quarterly team events, and an annual company offsite.

Equal Opportunity:

ZestyAI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Technical SEO Contractor
jobs.description:
Velir is an established mid-sized agency with a top-tier portfolio of clients, ranging from the world’s largest non-profits to Fortune 500 brands. As of 2023, Velir acquired Brooklyn Data Company, a premier data and analytics consultancy focused on leadership, process improvement, implementation, and advanced analytics.

At Velir, we believe people are our greatest asset. Our culture is built on a foundation of trust, collaboration, and continued improvement. We strive for excellence in everything we do, embracing challenges as opportunities for growth. Our success is driven by a shared passion for making a positive impact on our customers, our communities and each other. We are a remote first company that offers competitive pay and excellent benefits.

Overview

Velir x Brooklyn Data is seeking an experienced SEO Contractor to provide up to 20 hours of support per week across a portfolio of client engagements. This role will have a strong emphasis on technical SEO, including site audits, crawlability and indexation analysis, technical issue identification, implementation guidance, and validation.

The ideal contractor can work independently, quickly assess complex websites, clearly document technical findings, and collaborate with SEO, analytics, content, and development teams to turn recommendations into measurable improvements.

This is a flexible contract role intended to supplement Velir's existing SEO capabilities and provide additional technical depth and execution support as client needs arise.

Responsibilities

Technical SEO

• Lead and support technical SEO audits across client websites

• Analyze crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, redirects, robots directives, XML sitemaps, pagination, duplicate content, and site architecture

• Identify technical issues using tools such as Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and Semrush

• Assess Core Web Vitals, page performance, rendering, JavaScript SEO, and mobile search considerations

• Review structured data and provide schema implementation recommendations

• Identify technical SEO risks associated with website redesigns, migrations, platform changes, and releases

• Develop clear, prioritized recommendations based on SEO impact and implementation effort

• Partner with developers and technical teams to troubleshoot issues and provide implementation guidance

• Validate fixes following development releases and monitor for regressions

• Support ongoing technical SEO monitoring and governance

On-Page & SEO Support

• Conduct targeted on-page optimization when needed, including metadata, headings, internal linking, and content structure

• Perform keyword and search intent research to support technical and content recommendations

• Identify opportunities to improve information architecture and internal linking

• Support content teams with SEO recommendations when technical and on-page considerations overlap

Analytics & Performance Measurement

• Use Google Search Console and analytics platforms such as GA4 to investigate organic search performance

• Analyze changes in rankings, impressions, clicks, traffic, and landing-page performance

• Connect technical SEO findings to measurable organic search outcomes

• Support SEO reporting, analysis, and prioritization

Tools & Platforms

• Regularly work within tools such as:

• Screaming Frog

• Google Search Console

• Ahrefs

• Semrush

• GA4

• Google Tag Manager

• PageSpeed Insights / Lighthouse

• Build and configure custom crawls, extractions, segments, and technical QA workflows when needed

• Document repeatable processes and contribute to scalable SEO delivery practices

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with Velir's SEO, Behavioral Analytics, CRO, Content, Strategy, UX, and Development teams

• Translate technical SEO findings into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Participate in client meetings when technical SEO expertise is needed

• Support integrated initiatives involving SEO, AEO/GEO, analytics, experimentation, content, and digital experience optimization

Qualifications

• 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with meaningful experience in technical SEO

• Strong working knowledge of:

• Crawlability and indexation

• Canonicalization and redirects

• XML sitemaps and robots.txt

• Site architecture and internal linking

• Core Web Vitals and site performance

• Structured data/schema

• JavaScript SEO and rendering considerations

• Website migrations and redesigns

• Advanced experience with Screaming Frog

• Strong experience with Google Search Console

• Experience with SEO platforms such as Ahrefs and/or Semrush

• Working knowledge of GA4 and web analytics

• Ability to independently investigate technical issues and determine likely root causes

• Ability to clearly document findings, recommendations, priorities, and implementation requirements

• Comfortable working across multiple clients and shifting priorities

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Nice to Have

• Agency or consulting experience

• Experience with enterprise or complex multi-domain websites

• Experience supporting website migrations and major platform releases

• Familiarity with CMS platforms such as Optimizely CMS, Sitecore, Drupal, and WordPress

• Familiarity with headless architectures, SPAs, and JavaScript frameworks

• Experience with log-file analysis

• Experience using BigQuery or other data tools for SEO analysis

• Understanding of accessibility and its relationship to technical site quality

• Exposure to CRO, experimentation, or behavioral analytics

• Experience with AEO, GEO, AI search visibility, and emerging search behavior

Physical Requirements

jobs.title: Director, Corporate Strategy
jobs.description:
Shape strategy, partnerships, and investor engagement at a pivotal point in Vesalius's growth and clinical evolution.

About Vesalius Therapeutics

Vesalius Therapeutics has built a unique AI-enabled platform to identify disease-causing biology pairing the world’s largest iPSC collection with state-of-the-art cellular models and rich phenotypic screens. The platform uses genetics as the arbiter of causality to translate human biology into therapeutic hypotheses, and generate rigorous, decision-enabling evidence for drug development programs. Vesalius has formed a strategic collaboration with GSK in Parkinson’s disease and is pursuing multiple other avenues in neurodegeneration and indications outside the CNS. We are also advancing a novel therapeutic program in Alzheimer’s disease.

Position Summary

Vesalius Therapeutics is seeking a highly analytical, execution-oriented Director of Corporate Development to help lead enterprise strategy, external partnering, and investor engagement. This individual will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to translate scientific, clinical, competitive, and financial information into clear strategic choices, compelling external narratives, and coordinated action.

The Director will help establish an integrated strategy, business development, and investor engagement capability as Vesalius advances its first clinical program and builds a broader pipeline. They will lead structured analyses, identify and evaluate partnership opportunities, coordinate diligence and transaction support, develop Board and investor materials, and support financing and investor engagement.

The ideal candidate combines the structured problem-solving and communication skills of a top-tier strategist with commercial judgment, strong external relationship skills, and a practical understanding of biotechnology. They are comfortable working with imperfect information, can translate complex science for business and investor audiences, and take ownership from recommendation through execution.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Strategy & Portfolio Planning

• Support development and ongoing refinement of Vesalius's enterprise strategy, strategic priorities, portfolio plan, and long-range plan.

• Lead portfolio and scenario analyses that integrate scientific differentiation, clinical path, probability of success, investment requirements, competitive context, and potential value.

• Create clear decision frameworks for program prioritization, resource allocation, sequencing, partnering, financing, and organizational investment.

• Facilitate cross-functional strategy discussions and translate conclusions into accountable plans, milestones, and decision follow-up.

Strategic Analysis & Executive/Board Support

• Lead market, competitive, pipeline, modality, company, and financing-environment analyses that inform corporate and program strategy.

• Synthesize scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial, and financial information into concise implications and recommendations for senior leadership and the Board.

• Develop scenario analyses, valuations, and financial models to evaluate strategic alternatives, investment needs, milestones, and value-creation pathways.

• Develop high-quality executive and Board materials, and partner with Finance and functional leaders on annual planning, resource allocation, operating priorities, and milestone tracking.

Business Development & Partnering

• Develop and maintain a business development strategy aligned with Vesalius's enterprise and portfolio priorities.

• Identify, assess, and prioritize licensing, collaboration, partnership, and other external growth opportunities.

• Lead or coordinate partner outreach, scientific and business presentations, cross-functional diligence, and integrated recommendations on strategic fit, value, risk, and execution requirements.

• Develop valuations and transaction scenarios, support deal structuring and negotiations with leadership, Finance, and Legal, and help transition completed transactions into effective alliance governance.

Investor Engagement & External Communications

• Help shape Vesalius's investor engagement strategy, engagement plan, and financing narrative in partnership with the executive team and Finance.

• Develop and maintain investor presentations, corporate messaging, Q&A, diligence materials, and other communications that clearly connect scientific and clinical progress to enterprise value.

• Prepare executives for investor meetings, conferences, financing discussions, and follow-up; coordinate accurate, consistent inputs across scientific, clinical, financial, and legal stakeholders.

• Monitor investor feedback, peer-company positioning, market sentiment, and the financing environment; translate external insights into recommendations for leadership.

Qualifications

• 8+ years of relevant experience in biotechnology or pharmaceutical business development, investor relations, corporate strategy, management consulting, investment banking, or a comparable role.

• Demonstrated experience across at least two of the following areas: business development, investor relations, and corporate or portfolio strategy, with the ability to contribute effectively across all three.

• Strong understanding of biotechnology R&D, clinical development, portfolio strategy, partnering, and the drivers of enterprise value.

• Experience evaluating partnerships or licensing opportunities, including diligence, valuation, financial modeling, and transaction support.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific and clinical information into clear investor, partner, executive, and Board materials.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional work, manage multiple high-priority workstreams, and build external relationships without relying on formal authority.

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in business, science, medicine, engineering, or a related field strongly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working across strategy, business development, or investor relations in an early-stage or clinical-stage biotechnology company.

• Experience in CNS, neurodegeneration, Alzheimer's disease, or complex disease areas.

• Direct experience supporting licensing transactions, strategic partnerships, private financings, investor meetings, or related external processes.

• Experience developing investor narratives and materials for a venture-backed or publicly traded biotechnology company.

• Familiarity with human genetics, data-driven drug discovery, and platform-based biotechnology models; experience supporting executive teams and Boards through major portfolio, financing, or partnering decisions.

Leadership Profile

• Gets quickly to the essential strategic, partnering, or investor question and distinguishes analysis that changes a decision from analysis that does not.

• Combines intellectual rigor with commercial judgment, pragmatism, speed, and a strong bias toward action.

• Communicates complex science and strategy simply, accurately, and with clear implications for internal and external audiences.

• Builds trust across scientific, clinical, financial, and operational teams and with external partners and investors.

• Challenges assumptions constructively and remains objective when the evidence conflicts with the preferred answer.

• Takes ownership from initial question through recommendation, external engagement, alignment, and execution follow-through.

• Thrives in an environment where priorities evolve and high-quality judgment matters more than process for its own sake.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will build a trusted, high-impact capability across strategy, business development, and investor relations. They will improve the quality and speed of Vesalius's most important decisions, identify and advance high-value partnerships, strengthen the company's investor narrative and engagement, raise the quality of executive and Board materials, and ensure that strategic priorities translate into coordinated action and measurable progress.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Director of ABM
jobs.description:
Imagine having the power to stress-test an entire power grid against a hurricane or thunderstorm before the clouds even gather. That is the reality we are creating at Neara.



We use advanced machine learning to create engineering-grade, physics enabled digital twins of electricity grids across four continents, this helps asset owners understand their biggest challenges and bring the most viable solutions to life across millions of kilometres of infrastructure.



By simulating extreme weather and structural stress at a network-wide scale, we empower the world’s largest utilities to pinpoint risks, optimise investments and build a more resilient global energy future.



Our team is a collection of brilliant minds who are fanatical about making a tangible difference in the real world, utilising AI and machine learning to accelerate everything from data classification to complex scenario analysis. We have built a special culture where innovation thrives because everyone owns the mission and we need smart, creative people to help us scale this impact to every corner of the globe.



Director of ABM



Neara is seeking a Director of ABM to lead and strengthen our ABM program. This is a player-coach role for someone who can continue to elevate the strategy and playbooks, establish consistent standards across the program, and personally shape individual account strategy, develop and execute campaigns, and work closely with Sales to advance our most strategic accounts.



Our ABMs are responsible for how target accounts experience marketing tip-to-tail in their regions. Deeply embedded with Sales, they develop a nuanced understanding of each account’s buying group and the regulatory and geographic pressures their accounts face, and design the right sequence of narratives across channels required to convert large, complex, sophisticated buying groups. The Director of ABM will make that model work consistently across regions and prove its commercial impact.



This person will bring rigor to how we build account plans, activate campaigns, measure success and communicate results. They will coach a team of regional ABMs, identify patterns across accounts, and turn the strongest approaches into repeatable programs.



This is not purely a managerial role. You are expected to be hands-on and lead ABM activation at a set of strategic accounts yourself.



What You Will Do:

 - Personally own ABM strategy and execution for a focused set of high-priority or complex accounts

 - Identify patterns across accounts and translate them into scaled campaigns, content priorities, events, and other executive engagement opportunities

 - Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to improve account data quality, goal tracking and org-wide visibility, as well as establish benchmarks that make it easy to distinguish activity from meaningful account movement

 - Develop integrated account programs and help the team balance deeply tailored account work with more scaled and repeatable programs

 - Lead regular account reviews to identify what is working, what is not, and where resources should be reallocated

 - Build a culture in which successful plays, account intelligence, and customer stories travel quickly across teams and regions

 - Create a strong operating rhythm between ABM and broader marketing team, Sales, Customer Success, and Product



Who You Are:

 - You are a true player-coach energized by developing a team but equally enthusiastic about and capable of doing the work yourself

 - You know that ABM is not “swap the logo on the landing page” nor a laundry list of bespoke Sales requests but a structured approach to changing beliefs across diverse buying committees in complex accounts

 - You can think strategically and creatively about how to measure ABM’s value beyond traditional metrics and can communicate value clearly

 - You are comfortable challenging assumptions, testing new approaches and changing course when the situation demands it

jobs.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What we do

We are seeking a General Manager, North America – Revenue Operations to lead and scale our revenue operations function across the Enterprise segment in North America. Someone who can design operating models, partner deeply with GTM leadership (Business Development and Customer Success), and drive accountability through data, process, and talent.

You will be a critical partner to GTM leadership, Finance, Product, and global Revenue Operations as we continue to scale the business, improve forecasting rigor, and elevate how we manage portfolios, pipelines, and growth across North America.

At The Trade Desk, this role offers the opportunity to shape how one of the world’s most sophisticated commercial organizations operates influencing revenue predictability, GTM productivity, and customer outcomes at scale.

Systems, Data & Scale

• Drive adoption of tools and processes that reduce manual effort and enable GTM teams to focus on customers.

• Ensure insights are actionable, timely, and pushed to GTM leadership not pulled.

Who you are

Experience & Background

• 12+ years of experience in revenue operations, GTM operations, business operations, or related leadership roles.

• Proven experience operating at scale within complex, multi-segment B2B or technology organizations.

• Experience partnering closely with senior GTM, Finance, and Product leaders in a matrixed environment.

jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

At Intuitive, we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. We are looking for team members with exceptional character who have the capacity to simplify complex problems and the energy to urgently deliver solutions to our patients. We use creative techniques to solve hard problems to achieve optimal clinical performance, manufacturabilty, business objectives, and reliability.

Within Intuitive, the Single Port robotic platform offers surgeons the ability to perform surgeries through a single incision with boundless possibilities.  This Manufacturing Engineer will effectively collaborate with core team partners and individually contribute to sustaining and improving existing manufacturing processes to achieve operational excellence.

Essential Job Duties

• Lead duplication, line transfer, and operational manufacturing line activities.
• Provide daily engineering support for existing in-house manufacturing lines.
• Execute continuous improvement projects for product quality, throughput, and cost. Utilize analytical objective data and statistical analysis to establish metrics and to inform goals and priorities.

We’re building bridges between online, social and land-based gaming businesses to create amazing, integrated experiences that keep players in the game.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Corporate Accounting to lead the day-to-day operations of our corporate accounting function. Reporting to the Senior Director, Corporate Accounting & Reporting, this role owns the monthly close process across all corporate sub-teams (e.g., GL, Accounts Payable, Treasury), partners closely with other Finance and Accounting functions (e.g., SEC Reporting, FP&A, Accounting Operations, International Finance), and supports special projects as needed. As RSI scales, this role strengthens the accounting function and builds the operational rigor that the next stage of the company requires.

We're looking for a leader with presence and credibility, someone who can walk into any room, across any reporting line, and move people toward a common goal. The ideal candidate combines a strong command of US GAAP with a proven track record of leading teams, staying hands-on, driving accountability, and building cross-functional momentum in environments where influence matters as much as positional authority.

We are seeking candidates based in the Chicagoland area, as this role requires occasional in-person collaboration at our Chicago office.

What You'll Do:

• Own the monthly close – drive timelines and deliver consolidated results across the Accounting and Finance function

• Coach and develop – lead through real-time coaching, mentoring, and feedback, building leaders and driving accountability, not just completing tasks.

• Comfort leveraging AI and automation tools to improve close accuracy, reduce manual work, and scale team output.

jobs.title: Deployment Lead, Life Sciences- NYC
jobs.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.



About the Role

As a Deployment Lead Life Sciences, you will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to customers. You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

You will focus on the Life Sciences vertical, partnering with pharmaceutical companies, clinical research organizations, and other data and services providers to deploy next-generation AI capabilities across their drug discovery, development, and operations. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with Life Sciences customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role. Success requires deep technical project management expertise, extreme ownership of outcomes, and an ability to immerse in customer workflows and partner with customer teams to solve complex engineering problems at pace.



This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.



In this role, you will:

 - Own the technical delivery plan for multiple interdependent workstreams. Translate business objectives into a roadmap with milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

 - Run day-to-day engineering execution. Track and drive delivery across OpenAI FDE and customer teams. Keep progress unblocked and sequenced. Make real-time trade-offs on scope and priority to protect the critical path.

 - Embed with customer teams to land production deployments and drive adoption. Map workflows, shape tools/integrations, and translate requirements into a delivery plan. Lead onboarding, adoption, and change management.

 - Partner with Product and Research so platform components and research workstreams land in time to support deployment goals.

 - Codify solution patterns and evals. Extract reusable patterns and package field signals to improve product and models.

 - Own value cases and ROI. Set impact hypotheses, baselines, and KPIs; run pre-/post-deployment measurement and report to exec sponsors.

 - Shape how we engage Life Sciences customers


You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring 7+ years of customer‑facing technical delivery leadership and have expertise in the Life Sciences space.

 - Track record of successfully leading large, complex, high-stakes customer engagements where customer outcomes depended on tight coordination and fast decision making, ideally involving AI.

 - Excel in high ambiguity environments. Know how to simplify complex and dynamic work.

 - Move fluidly between system level understanding and execution level detail; can dive into customer workflows/data, map constraints, sketch architectures and move ambiguous problems to shipped systems.

 - Think strategically and pattern-match. Able to step back from execution detail, recognise broader trends across deployments, and connect customer needs to scalable, reusable solutions.

 - Have strong technical fluency and sharp sequencing instincts. Confident discussing technical details, pressure-testing architectures, and making trade-offs.

 - Have shipped AI/LLM systems. You understand solution patterns, integration basics, and production pitfalls.

 - You’re a translator with executive presence. You make complex technical trade-offs legible to business leaders and convert strategy into day-to-day technical execution.

 - Enjoy being onsite with customers to accelerate delivery (often 25-50%, sometimes higher).

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Who You Are

We’re seeking a senior DevOps Engineering leader to architect and operate secure, scalable Kubernetes platforms across AWS and AWS GovCloud, including FedRAMP-authorized environments. This person will drive zero-trust security, Terraform and GitOps automation, observability, reliability, disaster recovery, and cost governance for both multi-tenant and dedicated enterprise deployments. They’ll also provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and partner closely with Security and Engineering to evolve Ontic’s platform strategy.




Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Platform Architecture

DevSecOps & Zero-Trust Security

AI-Enabled Operations & Platform Intelligence

 - Support AI/ML workload infrastructure, including scalable compute and secure model deployment

Infrastructure Automation & GitOps

 - Design safe deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, progressive delivery)

Reliability & Performance Engineering

FinOps & Cost Governance

Leadership & Governance

 - Mentor senior engineers and promote DevOps culture across teams

 - Drive architecture reviews and production readiness assessments

Qualifications

 - 8-10+ years of experience in DevOps / Platform Engineering in enterprise or high-scale SaaS environments.

 - Demonstrated experience maintaining a FedRAMP Moderate/High production environment, including continuous monitoring, vulnerability remediation, incident response, configuration management, and audit evidence.

 - Experience owning infrastructure patterns and changes within the authorized boundary, including system inventory, data-flow implications, inherited controls, and third-party services.

 - Strong experience designing and operating AWS Landing Zone architectures, including multi-account governance and guardrails.

 - Advanced Terraform experience building reusable, secure infrastructure modules and standardized environments.

 - Deep understanding of AWS and AWS GovCloud networking, including VPC design, segmentation, routing, private connectivity, and security controls.

 - Deep expertise in Kubernetes-based platform design and large-scale cluster operations.

 - Strong experience implementing GitOps workflows (ArgoCD) and CI/CD automation (Jenkins, GitLab).

 - Hands-on production experience with distributed systems, including MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, and ArangoDB.

 - Strong understanding of IAM, encryption at rest and in transit, and zero-trust access models.

 - Experience implementing enterprise observability stacks.

 - Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms and dedicated workload environments.

 - Exposure to service mesh and secure east-west traffic management.

 - Exposure to AIOps is a plus

 



This role is based in Austin, Texas, and requires work from the Austin office three days a week.

jobs.description:

As we scale to new heights, we're searching for a Quality Assurance Specialist to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality and efficiency.

• Values-driven culture with a friendly and supportive work environment

Please apply now to be part of our dynamic team and make a tangible impact on the future of payments!

Let’s build something great together!

Set up and operate devices such as non-invasive mechanical ventilators, CPAP, BiPAP, oxygen tanks, concentrators, and compressors, following specified parameters of treatment per physicians order.  Provide emergency care and assistance with cardiopulmonary resuscitation.  Determine requirements for treatment, such as type, mode, and duration of therapy, compatible with physicians' orders.  Monitor patient's physiological responses to therapy, such as vital signs, breath sounds, and consult with physician if adverse reactions occur.  Read prescription, physicians order, and review patient information to assess patient condition.  Work as part of a team of physicians, nurses and other health care professionals to manage patient care.  Inspect, clean, test and maintain respiratory therapy equipment to ensure equipment is functioning safely and efficiently, ordering repairs when necessary.  Educate patients and their families about their conditions and teach appropriate disease management techniques, such as breathing exercises, relaxation techniques, home safety, travel, and processes to facilitate independence. jobs.title: Design Director, World Systems
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a talented Design Director, World Systems to join our team on an exciting unannounced title built on a globally recognized IP in our Culver City hub, or remotely within the US.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

As Design Director, World Systems, you will own the design of procedural world generation — the systems and craft that combine terrain, creatures, props, resources, buildings, encounters, and points of interest into a cohesive, playable world. You will be hands-on from day one, partner closely with Tools to build the frameworks and tuning levers the team needs, and grow your team over time to serve the needs of the project.

What you will do:

• Own the player experience of generated worlds and raise it to a standard that feels authored, readable, and worth exploring.

• Define how diverse world elements (terrain, creatures, props, resources, buildings, encounters, POIs) compose into a cohesive whole rather than a pile of systems.

• Establish and enforce world-design standards for density, gameplay pacing, traversal distances, sightlines, landmarking, and encounter/POI placement.

• Partner with the Tools team to specify generation frameworks, authoring workflows, and the levers designers use to tune procedural output.

• Work end-to-end in an iterative process — from earliest world concepts and prototypes through directing designers in implementation and live iteration.

• Bring a strong level-design sensibility to procedural space: how far players walk, what they see, when the world breathes, and when it demands attention.

• Follow a design-thinking methodology to understand player needs, ideate, and propose solutions that meet both player and business goals.

• Understand our audience at a deep, empathetic level, and formulate world solutions that serve different player segments.

• Closely partner with Creative Director, UX Director, Director of Product, Technical Director, and Content / Adventure leadership so world systems land cleanly in the full player experience.

• Envision and direct world-generation designs that can sustain a large live-operated game, with scalable quality and a scalable content pipeline.

• Understand game engine and performance boundaries, and propose creative solutions that work within them.

• Partner with Art, UX, Tools, and Engineering to prototype specific world behaviors early — so the team can feel density, pacing, and composition before full production.

• Manage the design of multiple world systems at once, ideating on new generation problems while overseeing development of others.

• Ensure a culture of top-quality specification for all relevant design documentation.

• Inspire, empower, and grow a team of game designers to produce the best possible quality of world and level experience.

What you will need:

• 5+ years of game design leadership on large-scale worlds (open world, procedural world, action RPG, MMORPG, or comparable adventure / survival spaces)

• 5+ years of experience leading level design, world design, or encounter placement at a high craft bar

• Demonstrated experience shipping worlds that combine authored intent with generated or assembled content

• Minimum 10 years working on shipped new or live game products

• Experience iterating on ideas in the early phases of development, in a tightly collaborative environment, as well as working on production or live-operated games

• Strong instincts for gameplay pacing, world density, traversal, and sightlines — and the ability to turn those instincts into tunable systems

• Experience partnering with tools or engineering teams to define world-building frameworks, pipelines, or generation levers

• Demonstrated ability to define and ensure standards of excellence in design documentation

Bonus Points:

• Hands-on experience with procedural generation systems, world-composition tools, or content-assembly pipelines

• Experience working on major IP, navigating the competing pressures of player expectations and the need to innovate

• 3+ years working in Free to Play

• Experience on cross-platform products, and console / PC games

• Experience working directly in Unity

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA Annual Salary Range

$164,000—$247,000 USD

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry.  In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

As Head of Revenue Operations, you will build, optimize, and scale the operational, data, and technology foundation across our entire go-to-market organization—including Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Partnerships. Reporting directly to executive leadership, your mission is to transform our systems, billing infrastructure, reporting, and GTM strategy into a clear, high-performing growth engine.

You will lead a small but high-impact RevOps team (2 direct reports) while personally owning the architecture and execution of our RevTech stack (including HubSpot and Chargebee), lead management, funnel optimization, enablement and ramp, and AI deployment. This is not a traditional admin role—we are looking for a builder, strategic systems architect, and AI-forward operator who rationalizes existing tools before adding new ones, replaces manual reporting with automated signal, and shortens new-hire time-to-productivity as a core business metric.

This role is 100% remote and available to US-based candidates.

You Are

• An Operational Builder & AI-Forward Architect: Highly organized and system-minded, you thrive on taking complex, disconnected processes and building simple, scalable workflows. You actively identify, test, and deploy AI tools and automated knowledge systems to eliminate manual work and boost team productivity.

• A Strategic Systems Thinker: You look beyond basic CRM administration to understand broader business goals, connecting executive priorities to billing infrastructure, tech stack rationalization, and RevOps strategy.

• A Hands-On Problem Solver: You balance executive strategy with technical execution—equally comfortable presenting to leadership or personally building automations, forecasting models, and CRM workflows.

• A Growth & Ramp Driver: You view new-hire time-to-productivity as a business metric, using automated measurement, early success signals, and modern systems to ramp revenue teams faster.

• A Collaborative Leader: You manage, mentor, and elevate a team of RevOps professionals while bridging the gap between technical data systems and business leadership to align GTM operations.

You Will

• Own Revenue Systems, Billing Infrastructure & AI Innovation: Lead full ownership and architecture of core revenue systems (HubSpot, Chargebee, and broader RevTech). Continuously inspect, consolidate, and optimize current platforms before evaluating new spend. Build advanced automation workflows across Marketing, Sales, CS, Finance, and Partnerships, and deploy AI tools (such as living AI knowledge bases/Claude skills libraries) to streamline operations.

• Drive Enablement, Ramp & Team Productivity: Own new-hire ramp time with a clear, measurable path to reduction. Design onboarding, coaching, and exception-based reporting workflows that run through systems rather than headcount. Partner with Sales leadership on structural changes (comp design, team placement) that raise pipeline productivity per rep.

• Optimize Funnel Performance & Revenue Intelligence: Diagnose pipeline leaks and conversion bottlenecks across all channels. Build executive dashboards, forecasting models, and predictive analytics to improve speed-to-lead, decision-maker contact rates, expansion efficiency, and retention outcomes. Ground all recommendations in data first.

• Lead Data Strategy & Governance: Define how data is captured, structured, and managed across the customer lifecycle, improving CRM hygiene, billing accuracy, reporting integrity, and system interoperability.

• Manage & Develop the RevOps Team: Lead, hire, and mentor 2 direct reports. Build a culture of innovation, systems thinking, accountability, and technical excellence, raising team competency across AI, automation, and systems architecture.

• Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, CS, Finance, Product, and Executive Leadership to support product-led growth (PLG) motions, upgrade paths, monetization strategies, and long-term GTM infrastructure.

You Have

Must Have

• RevOps Leadership Experience: 5–8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, or Revenue Enablement, with proven experience leading teams or major strategic initiatives.

• Systems & Tech Stack Mastery: Deep expertise configuring and managing HubSpot, along with strong experience in billing/subscription management platforms (Chargebee or similar) and operational architecture.

• AI & Automation Curiosity: Hands-on track record implementing modern automation tools and proactive experience deploying AI solutions (including AI-powered knowledge or enablement systems).

• Enablement & Ramp Ownership: Experience owning, measuring, or influencing new-hire ramp time and onboarding outcomes as core operational metrics.

• Data & Analytics Proficiency: Strong analytical background with direct experience querying raw data, building forecasting models, and designing board-level/executive dashboards (SQL, BI tools, or advanced analytics platforms).

• Stack Rationalization Skills: Proven track record evaluating, consolidating, or replacing major GTM and business software platforms.

Nice to Have

• Billing Operations: Direct experience with Chargebee, subscription management, and revenue recognition workflows.

• Product-Led Growth (PLG): Experience supporting PLG motions, automated upgrade paths, and expansion loops.

• Early-Stage / High-Growth Scaling: Experience scaling a RevOps function in a fast-growing SaaS tech company.

• Multi-Segment GTM: Background supporting multi-segment environments (SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise).

• Marketing Attribution & Demand Gen: Deep understanding of marketing attribution models and demand generation tech stacks.

Interview Process

• Initial Screen: 30 min with the Lead Recruiter

• Hiring Manager Interview: 45 min with the CRO

• Problem Solving Interview: 60 min with the Director of People

• Cross-Functional Interviews: 30 min with the CFO & 45 min with the CEO

*We also require completion of the Wonderlic Assessment before the end of the process. This is done independently and takes about 20–30 min.

We Offer

• 100% remote work environment

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance within 30 days (100% employer-paid medical)

• Equity package

• Flexible PTO with a 15-day minimum

• Generous Parental Leave

• FSA and HSA options

• 401(k)

• Growth & Wellness Stipend

• WFH Equipment stipend

• Chance to work with the latest technology and AI tools

• A collaborative, high-ownership culture with clear opportunities for career growth

Why Join Steer?

At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

jobs.title: Deployment Lead, Financial Services- NYC
jobs.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.



About the Role

You will define how OpenAI delivers complex systems to customers. You will own how they are built, shipped, and adopted. You’ll translate business outcomes into a technical plan, run day-to-day execution across FDEs, Researchers, and Customer Engineers, and partner with customer teams to ensure delivery supports their goals.

You will focus on the Financial Services vertical, partnering with banks, asset managers, and private capital investors to deploy next-generation AI capabilities across their operations, investment processes, and portfolio companies. You will own delivery end-to-end: embedding with Financial Services customers to map workflows and success criteria, ensuring components ship on time, and leading readiness and change management for adoption. You’ll track progress, manage dependencies, make sequencing decisions, and drive 0→1 prototypes through MVP and scale. You will also share field insights with Product and Research to guide roadmap and priorities.

Success will be measured first and foremost by impact - deployments that deliver measurable value against customer goals, drive adoption, and become critical to their workflows. Additional measures of success include delivery reliability (milestones hit, low reopen/churn), operating leverage (patterns reused across deployments), judgment under pressure, and product impact (field signal that shifts roadmaps/architectures).

jobs.title: Medical Laboratory Scientist - Clinical Research Unit Full-time Days
jobs.description:
The Medical Laboratory Scientist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A Medical Laboratory Scientist performs test procedures in a clinical laboratory and conveys the results to the physician or designee in an accurate and timely manner for the purpose of patient diagnosis and treatment

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Technical responsibilities:

• Performs all aspects of pre-analytic workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure orders are entered correctly, specimens collected are appropriate for the test ordered and are correctly processed/transported.

• Verifies order where necessary

• Verifies non-patient information (e.g., collection time) according to established protocol.

• Handles unresolved orders, troubleshoots where needed.

• Verifies with physicians and/or nurses prior to laboratory information system (LIS) order entry to resolve unclear, duplicate or otherwise ambiguous orders.

• Verifies specimens for add-on tests are available and acceptable and generates add-on test orders.

• Recognizes when fraud and abuse compliance issues require adjustments to the test order

• Collecting, receiving and processing of specimens:

• Verifies specimens are correctly and completely labeled upon receipt. Evaluates specimens for appropriateness and takes necessary corrective action. Appropriately documents unacceptable specimens and proper notifications as needed.

• Prioritizes specimen processing based on established priorities.

• Aliquots specimens according to established protocols.

• Performs all aspects of analytical testing appropriate for the specific laboratory section,following established written protocols and standard operating procedures (SOP)

• Maintains test system integrity:

• Performs preventive maintenance on instruments/equipment in a timely fashion according to defined schedule.

• Verifies reagents and supplies meet defined acceptability criteria upon receipt and prior to use; takes action to ensure unacceptable items are removed from use.

• Ensures that sufficient reagents and supplies necessary for test performance are available. Notifies senior staff when minimum inventory level is encountered.

• Performs and records all necessary quality control (QC) required for test system performance.

• Evaluates QC results and takes necessary corrective actions according to established protocol.

• Performs specimen preparation:

• Performs any necessary pretest specimen preparation according to protocols (e.g., microbiology plating, cell cultures, filtering, extraction, separation, elution, absorption, etc.)

• Transfers or ships specimens to approved testing locations according to SOPs

• Performs tests:

• Prioritizes testing based on assignment or established priorities, completes testing within defined turn-around-times (TAT).

• Recognizes the need for and follows any age-specific protocols

• Responds effectively to changes in the workflow by coordinating a simultaneous series of tests when needed or adjusting work to incorporate STAT tests or fluctuations in work volume.

• Monitors daily workflow and priorities to assure meeting service levels.

• Performs technical review and interpretation:

• Reviews results for completeness, correctness, and consistency within defined test system

• Evaluates test results/reactions and provides accurate interpretations as appropriate to include correlation with, and integration of, other patient data as necessary.

• Performs visual interpretation/identifications as appropriate.

• Recognizes unusual test results/interpretations and completes indicated reflex testing or other follow-up actions.

• Follows established notification protocols for critical values, phone/fax/e-mail results requests, abnormalities.

• Troubleshoots and solves problems:

• Recognizes test system performance problems and takes necessary corrective actions

• Recognizes when unresolved problems need to be escalated and takes necessary follow-up action.

• Prints pending logs and follows-up to ensure pending tests are completed or cancelled when appropriate.

• Post-test specimen storage:

• Stores specimens and related materials (blood, slides, tissues, etc.) according to protocols for location and duration.

• Retrieves specimen and related materials when needed

• Post-analytical responsibilities:

• Performs all aspects of the post-analytical workflow appropriate for the specific laboratory section to ensure accurate results are reported within established time frames, specimens are retained appropriately, test results and/or current status are available upon inquiry, and billed charges are correct for testing performed.

• Verifies and reports results:

• Verifies results according to procedure.

• Performs computer functions necessary for releasing results.

• Generates written reports according to established protocol.

• Reviews electronic or printed reports when applicable, recognizes problems and escalates according to protocol.

• Amends reports:

• Corrects erroneous reports and amends reports according to procedure

• Responds to inquiries:

• Responds to requests for information according to established protocol for confidentiality and release of information

• Recognizes when unresolved inquiries need to be escalated and takes action

• Stores documents and records:

• Stores documents and records according to established protocol.

• Charge capture/billing:

• Performs billing and/or enter credits for tests and services when applicable.

• Recognizes billing problems and escalates accordingly

• Universal responsibilities:

• Ensures quality of operations:

• Follows written standard operating procedures (SOP).

• Operates instruments/equipment according to protocol.

• Uses computers according to established protocol; follows downtime procedures as required.

• Performs required quality system responsibilities

• Meets proficiency and competency standards of the department.

• Participates in the training of new employees and students

• Performs operational review of new SOPs.

• Participates in new test development, validations and implementation.

• Attends at least one personal development session per year

• Performs other duties as assigned, or as needed, to ensure continued quality operations

• Ensures safety of operations:

• Follows all required safety procedures, uses personal protective equipment (PPE) appropriate for tasks performed.

• Maintains cleans and organized work area

• Provides service excellence:

• Answers telephone when needed, using NM telephone etiquette

• Maintains patient confidentiality including protected health information (PHI)

• Assists patients, visitors and other contacts whenever need occurs

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Technology, Medical Laboratory Science, Clinical Laboratory Science, Chemistry, Biology, or Allied Health qualifying the applicant to take the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP), or equivalent certification examination.
• License/Certification and Regulatory Agency

• General MLS or MT (ASCP) Certification or eligible or

• Categorical BB, C, H or M (ASCP) Certification or eligible

• If hired after 1/19/2025 must be ASCP certified (or equivalent certification) within one year of employment

They are known for connecting the dots, simplifying complexities, communicating clearly and proactively, and driving highly collaborative efforts to completion, even when the path forward isn't perfectly defined.

You will partner closely with senior cross-functional leaders to make complex tradeoffs, resolve dependencies, and ensure the business is ready to sell, quote, contract, provision, bill, recognize revenue, support, and renew under the new model.

As Okta rapidly launches new innovations and expands into new markets, this role is critical to our success.

jobs.title: Systems Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT PILGRIM:

Pilgrim is building America’s biology prime - engineering, manufacturing, and deploying advanced biotechnology for defense and national security. Our primary platform, ARGUS, is a fully autonomous system for detecting biological threats in near real time, from naturally occurring pathogens to engineered agents.

We engineer hardware for biology, turning breakthrough science into fielded capabilities. Based in Redwood City, our team brings together mechanical and electrical engineering, chemistry, and biology under one roof to deliver critical technologies to the people who need them.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Systems Integration Engineer/Scientist at Pilgrim, you’ll turn biological methods into automated workflows on ARGUS. You’ll adapt sample preparation, reagent handling, qPCR, and sequencing preparation to the system, troubleshooting failures across biology, fluidics, and controls. Working with scientists and engineers, you will translate scientific advances into integrated systems that perform reliably in the real world.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Adapt sample preparation, reagent handling, qPCR, and sequencing preparation methods to automated workflows on ARGUS.

 - Define operating requirements for those workflows, including sample and reagent volumes, timing, temperature, and contamination control.

 - Establish bench baselines and compare automated performance using recovery, inhibition, sequencing quality, and processing time.

 - Design and run integration tests from individual fluidic and instrument subsystems through complete sample-to-result workflows.

 - Isolate failures across biology, fluidics, sensing, controls, and instrument software; verify causes and fixes experimentally.

 - Test workflow repeatability across operating conditions and verify performance after changes to hardware, software, reagents, or protocols.

jobs.title: Research Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT PILGRIM:

Pilgrim is building America’s biology prime - engineering, manufacturing, and deploying advanced biotechnology for defense and national security. Our primary platform, ARGUS, is a fully autonomous system for detecting biological threats in near real time, from naturally occurring pathogens to engineered agents.

We engineer hardware for biology, turning breakthrough science into fielded capabilities. Based in Redwood City, our team brings together mechanical and electrical engineering, chemistry, and biology under one roof to deliver critical technologies to the people who need them.


ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Research Associate at Pilgrim, you’ll run experiments that support ARGUS’s development, from bioaerosol collection through sample preparation, qPCR, and sequencing. You’ll own reagent preparation, sample storage, and consumable inventory. Working with scientists, you’ll troubleshoot unexpected findings and produce reliable data that guides improvements to the system.


RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Execute experiments to evaluate sample preparation methods, assay performance, and sequencing workflows.

 - Collect bioaerosol samples and process environmental samples through concentration, nucleic acid extraction, and quality checks.

 - Prepare and run qPCR assays with appropriate controls to evaluate sample recovery, inhibition, and assay performance.

 - Perform genomics and next-generation sequencing (NGS) workflows, including library preparation, sequencing-run setup and execution, and quality control.

 - Compile results, identify failed controls or inconsistent measurements, and help troubleshoot experiments.

 - Own reagent preparation and consumable inventory, including storage, expiration tracking, and replenishment with Supply Chain.

 - Document experiments, results, and deviations; update protocols as improvements are tested and confirmed.


QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Bachelor’s or master’s degree in molecular biology, biology, biochemistry, microbiology, bioengineering, or a related field, or equivalent laboratory experience.

 - Hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques, including nucleic acid extraction, PCR or qPCR, and sample quantification.

 - Ability to independently execute multistep laboratory protocols and document methods, results, and deviations.

 - Experience interpreting assay controls and sample quality measurements to identify failed or unreliable results.


PREFERRED:

 - Experience with molecular assay development or validation, sequencing library preparation, nanopore sequencing, or complex environmental samples, including bioaerosols.

jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian (Per Diem) - Naperville, IL
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!
