The role
Kombo is moving upmarket. Our sales motion is account-based, and Senior Enterprise BDRs own a small, focused book of our highest-potential accounts: Fortune 2000 companies and others where the deal size justifies a precise, strategic approach. Small book. Big impact.

You'll work tightly with AEs and leadership to develop account strategy, map stakeholders, and create pipeline that moves the business. ARR is our top metric company-wide, and the team is already hitting quota. You'll help push the standard higher from day one.

Paired with expected speed of learning and ownership, and you'll grow fast: AE in roughly 9-12 months is the most common next step, with paths into management, operations, expansion, and support opening up as we scale.

We win as a team, so you'll also work with people across the company, including the founders, to find the right approach to complex, high-value accounts. The role is thoughtful and focused, not automated or mindless.

Because of this, we don't micro-manage. We expect everyone here to own their role, including the people supporting you so you can hit your targets.



What you'll do
At any given time, only ~5% of your ICP is in market for our product. Your job is to figure out how to reach 100% of that 5%.

That means going deep on the product, our customers, and how they buy, then forming your own point of view on how to meet them where they are. You'll stay current on what's working in outbound, lean on our advisors and partners, and grow into a strong GTM operator. As one of the more experienced BDRs on the team, you'll also help onboard new hires and share what's working on accounts, sequencing, and messaging.



What we're looking for
A few traits we tend to see in BDRs who thrive here:

 - You have 1-2 years of outbound experience in B2B SaaS and have already learned what good looks like.

 - You're curious and humble, and you ask questions to really understand a customer before adjusting your angle.

 - You communicate clearly, in writing and on calls.

 - You take ownership of your work and figure things out with structured, independent thinking.

 - You have a bias toward action, and would rather ship, learn, and iterate than wait for the perfect plan.

 - You're looking for the right company to make the jump to AE, not just any company.

 - You enjoy working in person with a team.
   
   

What we offer

 - Competitive base + variable comp, uncapped accelerators above quota

 - Clear path to AE in 9-12 months for strong performers, where your comp roughly doubles

 - Generous ESOP

 - Bi-annual team offsites and monthly team events

 - Direct access to senior mentors and advisors

We're aiming to 3x our team and revenue this year, so there's real room to grow.



Interview process

 3. 1.5-hour case study

Because we were established for the purpose of public service and not for profit, we measure our success in the impact of our service.

Position Summary

ANSER is seeking an Associate Project Management Analyst to support the Naval Air Warfare Center Aircraft Division (NAWCAD), Webster Outlying Field (WOLF), Special Communications Mission Solutions (SCMS) Division. The SCMS Division operates as the organic Lead Systems Integrator (oLSI®) and provides in-service engineering, maintenance, repair, and rebuild of Command, Control, Communications, Computers, Combat Systems, Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (C5ISR) systems.

In this role, you will perform full life cycle project management activities, including initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and controlling projects. You will interface with Government Project Leads (GPLs) and Government clients to coordinate and complete project processes from requirements through delivery while supporting Integrated Project Team (IPT) activities, project reporting, status coordination, and requirements management.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Perform full life cycle project management activities, including initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and controlling projects.

• Interface with Government Project Leads (GPLs) and Government clients to coordinate and complete project processes from requirements through delivery.

• Support Integrated Project Team (IPT) activities and project coordination requirements.

jobs.title: Enterprise Project Manager
jobs.description:
AMP is applying AI-powered sortation at scale to modernize the world's recycling infrastructure and maximize the value in waste. AMP gives waste and recycling leaders the power to harness AI to reduce labor costs, increase resource recovery, and deliver more reliable operations. With hundreds of deployments across North America, Asia, and Europe, AMP’s technology offers a transformational solution to waste sortation and changes the fundamental economics of recycling.

Headquartered in Louisville, Colorado, the Denver Post and BuiltIn Colorado have recognized AMP as one of the state's top workplaces. AMP has operations and career opportunities outside of Atlanta, Cleveland, Portsmouth, Virginia, and Europe. We’re fostering an environment where passionate individuals can grow and create impact. We seek unconventional thinkers to join our mission to enable a world without waste; at AMP, your contributions have meaning and can spur change. With backing from top-tier investors and national recognition including North American Cleantech Company of the Year, we’re always seeking ways to better our operations, raising the bar on innovation, and looking to collaborate and improve in what we do. Learn more at AMPSortation.com.

The Enterprise Project Manager is a part of AMP's centralized enablement function and is responsible for owning the day-to-day project management of a complex, high-priority, and cross-functional project from initiation through closeout. This role serves as the primary point of accountability for project outcomes, ensuring the project is delivered on time, within budget, within scope, aligned with project requirements, organizational objectives, and meets contractual obligations and deliverables.

The Enterprise Project Manager works across functional and organizational boundaries to drive execution, establish accountability, manage interdependencies, and maintain transparency into project health. The role applies standardized PMO methodologies, governance processes, tools, and best practices to ensure consistent, effective, and successful project delivery.

Responsibilities

• Own the day-to-day project outcomes of a complex, high-visibility project through all phases of the project lifecycle, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, and closeout.

• Ensure adherence to all applicable contractual, regulatory, and organizational compliance requirements throughout project execution by proactively identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating contract-related risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, while maintaining compliance oversight and supporting timely resolution of contractual obligations.

• Effectively manage scope, schedule, budget, resources, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies and outcomes.

• Drive execution across cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and workstreams to achieve project commitments and deliverables.

• Develop and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and performance measures.

• Monitor and report project health, including progress, KPIs, budget, schedule, risks, issues, and key decisions.

• Ensure project change control is applied, assessing impact and ensuring approved changes are documented, communicated, and incorporated into project plans.

• Facilitate and document project meetings, stakeholder discussions, and decision-making sessions.

• Apply PMO standards, methodologies, tools, and governance requirements, including stage gates and documentation standards. This includes maintaining accurate project documentation, records, decision logs, RAID logs, and project repositories.

• Identify opportunities to improve project delivery, tools, processes, and stakeholder adoption.

Key Skills

• Project Management Expertise: Extensive experience successfully leading complex projects throughout the full project lifecycle.

• Project Planning & Execution: Advanced proficiency in developing and managing integrated project plans, schedules, budgets, milestones, and resource requirements throughout the project lifecycle.

• Compliance & Controls: Advanced expertise in analyzing, communicating, tracking, and managing contractual, regulatory, and organizational requirements while ensuring compliance and governance adherence.

• Problem Solving & Decision Making: Strong analytical skills and ability to resolve complex project challenges and provide actionable recommendations

• Stakeholder Management: Build alignment and maintain effective relationships with project sponsors, functional leaders, and project teams.

• Communication: Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

• Performance Management & Reporting: Ability to develop KPIs, assess project health, identify trends, and provide clear status reporting.

• Technology & Tools: Proficiency with project management, collaboration, reporting, and documentation tools.

Required Qualifications:

• Certification(s): Project Management Professional (PMP) strongly preferred.

• Minimum 5+ years of project management experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-year cross-functional projects

• Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Smartsheets, Google Workspace, MS Suite to plan, track, manage and report project progress and resources.

• Experience working with Construction, Installation, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance and Legal teams.

Working Conditions and Physical Demands

The physical demands described below are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. This role requires regular travel to active industrial and construction environments. Project sites may not be climate controlled and may include noise, dust, moving equipment, uneven surfaces, elevated work areas, and other typical industrial hazards. While performing the duties of this position, the employee may be required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, communicate effectively, and occasionally lift or move up to 45 pounds. jobs.title: Organic Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT WINONA:

Winona https://bywinona.com is one of the leading telemedicine companies providing HRT for women in menopause. We’ve built all of our technology in house including an EHR, patient care admin system, patient portal, website, marketing technology etc. Winona has two compounding pharmacies and a team of in house physicians providing world-class care via a fully vertically integrated business model.




ROLE SUMMARY:

The Organic Social Media Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operation of Winona's organic social channels: planning the content calendar, briefing the teams and creators who produce the work, publishing across platforms, and engaging externally to grow reach. The role translates the channel strategy set by the Head of Social and the performance insights provided by Growth into a consistent, on-brand presence that reaches women navigating menopause.

This is a planning and creative direction role. The Organic Social Media Manager owns the content plan and the posting strategy — what is produced, for which platform, when, and how often — and is expected to bring an independent point of view on the audience rather than executing recommendations without interpretation. Overarching channel strategy and all paid media remain outside the role.




REPORTING AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:

Direction is received from:

 - Head of Social — channel strategy, priorities, quarterly goals, and final content approval

 - Growth — performance insights and content recommendations, including signals from Community and Lifecycle on messaging performance. These inform the content plan; they do not replace the Organic Social Media Manager's own assessment of the audience




KEY PARTNERS:

 - Creative/Design — produces statics and video against briefs provided by this role

 - Content/SEO — supplies long-form editorial for adaptation to social

 - Patient Services — responds to inbound comments and direct messages regarding the brand, products, orders, and clinical questions. This role routes those inquiries and provides advance notice of launches, campaigns, and posts likely to generate volume

 - Community — owns the Winona community app and platform. Insight is shared in both directions and cross-promotion is coordinated where appropriate

 - Paid — owns the influencer program and supplies this role with trending TikTok content produced by creators for organic use. This role may recommend creators and repurpose approved creator content, but does not brief, negotiate, or manage paid partnerships

 - PR (under Community) — amplification opportunities, press coverage, and any situation requiring a coordinated response

 - Copy — edits captions drafted by this role. Caption strategy and first drafts belong to Social; Copy provides an editorial pass for clarity, accuracy, and brand consistency




OUT OF SCOPE:

 - Paid social strategy, buying, and budget management

 - The influencer program, including briefs, contracts, and paid creator relationships

 - Responding to inbound questions in comments and direct messages




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

 1. Posting strategy, content planning, and publishing
    
    Own the posting strategy across all owned channels: cadence, frequency, timing, sequencing, and platform-specific publishing conventions. The posting strategy is set by this role, informed by performance data and operating within the channel strategy and goals established by the Head of Social.
    
    Build and maintain the rolling content calendar, determining content mix and formats, and execute all publishing. Ensure live content remains accurate and current; when a product detail, price, or claim changes, identify and correct affected posts.

 2. Brand persona accounts
    
    Publish and maintain organic content for Winona's brand persona accounts (Jo, Cat, Menopause with Lisa, and others as they are added), in addition to the primary Winona accounts. Each persona carries a distinct voice, audience, and content remit, and must remain consistent over time and clearly differentiated from the main brand account and from one another.
    
    This includes planning each persona's content, originating or adapting material suited to that persona, and publishing on its own cadence.

 3. Concepting and briefing
    
    Develop concepts and create the ClickUp tickets that direct all production. Each ticket must contain quality guidelines sufficient for the creative teams to build the intended asset without further direction: concept, hook, script or talking points, format and specifications, reference material, and the outcome the content is meant to achieve.
    
    Ticket quality is the central competency of this role. An effective ticket is specific enough for the creative teams to execute without follow-up, while leaving creators sufficient latitude to retain an authentic voice. Imprecise tickets consume Creative capacity and are a common cause of production delays and rework.

 4. Repurposing content from paid media and other channels
    
    Identify and adapt content originally produced for paid media, ambassador programs, and other channels for use on organic social. Review incoming creative and the ClickUp submission queue, assessing each asset against the standards of the platform it would run on.
    
    Much of the paid library is already social-native: creator clips and short-form video built for feed. The work is therefore less about screening out unusable assets than about selecting what merits an organic placement, reworking hooks and captions for an audience that has not opted into an advertisement, and pacing usage so the channel does not read as recycled advertising.
    
    Own caption strategy and produce the first drafts of all hooks and captions, using AI tools to generate and refine options. Drafts are submitted to Copy for an editorial pass. Accountability for whether a caption reads as native to the platform and appropriate to its placement rests with this role.

 5. Outbound engagement
    
    Engage proactively on external accounts — creators, practitioners, menopause advocates, adjacent brands, and the conversations the target audience is already having — to build reach, relationships, and recognition for Winona. This is a defined deliverable rather than discretionary work, and it is distinct from inbox management.
    
    Engagement should be substantive and add value to the conversation. It excludes responding to critics, participating in competitor comment sections, and answering clinical or product questions in third-party threads. Relationships that progress toward a paid partnership are handed to the Paid team.
    
    Inbound comments and direct messages to Winona's own accounts are answered by Patient Services. This role routes them and escalates any reputationally sensitive matter to the Head of Social immediately.

 6. Reporting
    
    Deliver regular performance reporting against the KPIs set by the Head of Social, covering results, the factors that drove them, and recommended next tests. Escalate anomalous performance as it is identified rather than holding it for the monthly report.




QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

 - 3–5 years managing organic social for a brand or agency, with a body of work the candidate can present and explain the reasoning behind.

 - Demonstrated strength in creative briefing: the ability to translate an idea into a production ticket the creative teams can execute correctly the first time, including concept, hook, script, format specifications, and reference material.

 - A strong editorial eye for short-form video. The role does not require shooting or editing, but does require the judgment to direct others effectively.

 - Strong copywriting, particularly hooks, captions, and conversational engagement.

 - Practical fluency with AI writing tools and the editorial judgment to distinguish usable output from generic output.

 - Thorough working knowledge of Instagram and TikTok mechanics, including formats, audio, algorithm behavior, and current performance trends.

 - Daily, short-form-first presence on our primary channels: Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

 - Consistent cadence on secondary channels: YouTube Shorts, X, and Pinterest.

 - A distinct, more corporate register for LinkedIn, and substantive, disclosed long-form answers on Quora.

 - Disciplined listening-only monitoring on Reddit — no posting there without explicit sign-off.

 - Strong analytical skills: the ability to interpret performance reporting and form a defensible point of view from it.

 - Proven reliability in a role with a fixed publishing schedule and a live audience

 - The range to write and publish in multiple distinct voices, maintaining separate persona accounts without them converging on a single tone.

Strongly preferred

 - Experience in healthcare, telehealth, supplements, or wellness.

 - A record of account growth driven by outbound engagement and creator relationships, not publishing alone.

 - Familiarity with menopause, perimenopause, or women's midlife health, whether professional, academic, or personal.




ATTRIBUTES:

Substantive empathy for women in their 40s and 50s whose health concerns have been dismissed, and the judgment to distinguish content that engages the audience from content that engages at their expense. Trends should be adapted to suit this audience rather than adopted wholesale.




WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

As a full-time member of our team, you’ll enjoy:

 - Remote-first, work wherever you choose

 - Unlimited paid time off

 - Paid non-working holidays per country of residence

 - Medical/ Dental/ Vision insurance (US-W2)

 - Referral bonuses

 - Financial support for online courses

 - Fun and casual work environment

 - Employee engagement activities and virtual gatherings

 - We are a diverse, global team! 🌍

 

Equal Employment Opportunity

Winona provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected classification. Equal employment opportunity extends to all aspects of employment including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, demotion, transfer, leaves of absence, and termination. Winona takes allegations of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation seriously and will promptly investigate such behaviors.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, MetaDefender Endpoint
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

Reports to: Chief Product Officer (CPO)

Scope: Full ownership of the MetaDefender Endpoint portfolio — commercial and community  | Partners daily with global R&D  |  Global / Remote-friendly

The Position

Join a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader at the forefront of innovation. We protect the unseen — the infrastructure that powers our way of life. OPSWAT protects the world’s critical infrastructure across IT, OT, and ICS environments, trusted by more than 2,000 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide.

We are seeking an exceptional product leader to own the vision, strategy, and execution of MetaDefender Endpoint — the endpoint foundation that delivers peripheral media protection, advanced compliance, remote access control, vulnerability detection, and patch management to secure critical assets and maintain organizational security. This is a senior leadership role with end-to-end ownership of a broad endpoint portfolio spanning multiple high-value use cases, every endpoint agent flavor across desktop and mobile, a free global community edition, and a platform strategy that other OPSWAT product lines build on. You will set the roadmap, work hands-on with top global R&D teams every day, and build the business and partnerships that scale endpoint across the globe.

The Product & Portfolio

MetaDefender Endpoint secures devices inside critical IT and OT networks and powers a portfolio of endpoint use cases. This role owns that portfolio end to end:

• Peripheral Media Protection: the foundational use case — scanning and sanitizing removable media and peripheral devices before their content can be accessed, protecting devices inside critical IT and OT networks from USB and removable-media threats.

• Advanced Compliance: continuous endpoint posture and compliance assessment — verifying device health, configuration, and security controls against regulatory frameworks and organizational policy, with audit-ready evidence.

• Vulnerability Assessment: continuous asset inspection and file-based vulnerability assessment with CVSS-based risk prioritization to surface the vulnerabilities that matter most, before and after software is installed.

• Patch Management: a strategic growth direction for the company — centralized patch management across on-premises, air-gapped, and cloud environments, automatically patching third-party applications and OS updates on flexible schedules and with audit-ready evidence.

• Zero Trust Access: real-time device posture and compliance checks that feed continuous, least-privilege, per-application access — layering device health onto identity so every access decision reflects who the user is and whether their device is healthy.

• Endpoint as a platform: the shared endpoint foundation that OPSWAT’s other product lines — such as Managed File Transfer, Network Access Control, and Endpoint Malware Scanning — build their endpoint capabilities on, so each team ships on a single, common endpoint architecture without losing the agility and domain expertise it owns.

The role owns every flavor of the endpoint agent — from Windows and macOS desktop clients to iOS and Android mobile apps — delivering a consistent endpoint experience across desktop and mobile platforms.

Beyond the commercial offering, this role also stewards the free MetaDefender Endpoint community — an open, no-cost download that lets anyone experience OPSWAT’s technologies firsthand — growing adoption, gathering feedback, and building a pipeline into the commercial portfolio.

About This Role

This is a hands-on, technically-engaged product leadership role — not a pure strategy or coordination seat. You own the full endpoint portfolio across its commercial use cases, every agent flavor, and its community edition, and you are accountable for the outcomes: adoption, growth, and customer success. You partner with global R&D on a day-to-day basis — in the details of architecture, prioritization, and release — and you champion the platform strategy that lets multiple use-case teams build on a shared endpoint foundation while preserving each team’s speed and expertise. You bring an AI-first mindset, leveraging AI in the day-to-day work of the team to maximize efficiency and output. You build, mentor, and lead a team of product manager, product designer, product marketing, and engineering professionals, set the bar for product excellence, and represent endpoint to customers, partners, and executive leadership.

What You Will Be Doing

• Own product vision & strategy: define, refine, and champion the vision and roadmap for the MetaDefender Endpoint portfolio — compliance and patch management, zero trust access, and vulnerability management — aligned to business goals and evolving market conditions.

• Drive patch and compliance as a growth engine: make centralized, cross-environment patch management (including air-gapped and OT) a flagship direction, and translate it into differentiated roadmap and go-to-market.

• Champion the endpoint platform: lead the strategy to establish MetaDefender Endpoint as the single architecture that use-case teams (e.g., Managed File Transfer, Network Access Control, and Endpoint Malware Scanning) develop on — enabling reuse and consistency while protecting each team’s agility and ownership of its business goals.

• Own every agent flavor: drive a consistent, high-quality endpoint experience across all agent platforms — Windows and macOS desktop clients and iOS and Android mobile apps.

• Lead with an AI-first mindset: bring AI into the day-to-day work of the product organization — from research and requirements to analysis and delivery — to maximize efficiency and output across the team.

• Grow and steward the community edition: own the free MetaDefender Endpoint community experience end to end — adoption, engagement, feedback loops, and conversion into commercial value.

• Work hands-on with R&D: partner with global R&D teams daily — writing crisp requirements, making trade-offs, and driving execution through to high-quality, timely releases.

• Build business and partnerships: develop the business case, pricing, and packaging, and cultivate technology and channel partnerships that expand endpoint’s reach and ecosystem.

• Lead market & competitive analysis: stay ahead of emerging trends, assess competitive products, and identify customer needs to inform prioritization and positioning.

• Drive user-centered development: advocate for the end user by gathering feedback, analyzing usage data, and driving continuous improvement in usability, functionality, and satisfaction.

• Orchestrate cross-functional delivery: partner closely with engineering, sales, marketing, and support to deliver high-quality releases and seamless integration into the broader OPSWAT portfolio.

• Track performance: establish clear KPIs, monitor product and adoption performance, and use insights to guide enhancements across both commercial and community.

• Communicate with stakeholders: clearly articulate strategy, updates, and results to internal teams, executive leadership, and customers — fostering alignment and enthusiasm.

• Build and lead the team: build, mentor, and lead a high-performing, cross-disciplinary team of product managers, product designers, product marketing, and engineering professionals, setting a strong bar for product craft and execution.

What We Need From You

• Product leadership experience: 10+ years in product management with several years leading and growing PM teams, ideally within cybersecurity, endpoint, or infrastructure software.

• Broad endpoint portfolio ownership: a track record managing a wide range of endpoint use cases — such as compliance, patch management, vulnerability management, and secure/zero-trust access — not a single narrow feature area.

• Deep domain knowledge: strong grasp of cybersecurity, endpoint security best practices, data protection, threat prevention, patch and vulnerability management, and device posture/compliance.

• Hands-on and technical: comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with R&D day to day, engaging credibly on architecture and trade-offs, and going deep in the product rather than staying at the surface.

• Multi-platform endpoint experience: experience delivering endpoint or agent software across operating systems and device types — Windows and macOS desktop, and iOS and Android mobile.

• Platform product thinking: experience building or evolving a shared platform that multiple teams develop on, balancing consistency and reuse with team autonomy and speed.

• AI-first ways of working: an AI-first mindset — you actively apply AI tools to your own and your team’s daily work to move faster and raise quality.

• Community / product-led growth: experience growing a free, community, or product-led offering and converting adoption into commercial outcomes is a strong plus.

• Business & partnership builder: demonstrated ability to build the business — pricing, packaging, GTM — and to establish technology and channel partnerships.

• Track record of delivery: proven experience managing products from concept through launch, with results in user adoption, revenue growth, or market penetration.

• Analytical & decisive: strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a data-driven approach.

• Exceptional communicator: outstanding interpersonal and executive communication skills, enabling collaboration across cross-functional teams and credibility with customers and leadership.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field; MBA is a plus.

• Ways of working: familiarity with Agile methodologies or similar frameworks.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Own a strategic, high-visibility portfolio at a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader — endpoint sits at the center of compliance, patch, vulnerability, and zero-trust access.

• Shape a platform: the endpoint architecture and practices you establish will enable product lines across OPSWAT.

• Run both a commercial business and a global free community that puts OPSWAT technology in the hands of users everywhere.

• Work hands-on with world-class global R&D teams on products that protect critical infrastructure.

• Global reach, a high-growth mindset, and the chance to shape products that matter.

• Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. Safety & Environment

jobs.title: (Senior) Onboarding Sales Enablement Manager
jobs.description:

At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

You will join the GTM Sales Enablement team. The global GTM Sales Enablement team empowers internal Sales Celonauts to acquire role-specific knowledge and develop the skills to drive business growth. We do that through the design and execution of innovative sales onboarding and learning journeys, GTM in-person events and interactive workshops.

The Role:

You will serve as the architect of a new Account Executive’s first 90 days, ensuring they decrease time-to-productivity and possess the skills, product knowledge, and confidence required to achieve their quotas.

You will achieve this through the design, delivery, and ongoing coaching of our sales onboarding programs for newly hired Account Executives.

The work you’ll do:

$149,000—$202,000 USD

What Celonis can offer you:

jobs.title: Lead BI Developer
jobs.location: Arlington, VA (remote); Baltimore, MD (remote); Buffalo, NY (remote); Jersey City, NJ (remote); Manchester, NH (remote); New York, NY (remote); Philadelphia, PA (remote); Stamford, CT (remote)
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

BASE SALARY: $120,000 to $150,000 per year, paid semi-monthly

MUST HAVE:

• Expert SQL & Comfortable with Unstructured Complex Data: Extracts accurate insights from raw, unstructured data without relying on clean models

• Reporting Ownership & Data Literacy: Builds, standardizes, drives adoption, and leaves teams more data-literate

• Performance Marketing Optimization: Connects data directly to levers that move the business, i.e. campaign performance, conversion rates, or revenue per session

• Advanced LookML Development (or equivalent in Power BI / Tableau): Architects complex models with full understanding of downstream impacts

• Curiosity & Business Depth: Asks questions first; driven to grow business knowledge to become a trusted analytical partner, not just a builder

EXPERIENCE: Minimum 7 years in business intelligence or analytics with direct exposure to performance or affiliate marketing. The strongest candidates have owned reporting end-to-end, from pipeline to dashboard, worked with messy, complex, third-party data, and partnered closely with business teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses, and connect data work to decisions that actually moved the business.

YOUR ROLE

Launch Potato is looking for a Lead BI Developer to own the reporting infrastructure that powers decision-making across our Credit Cards, Make Money/Manage Money, Banking, and Marketplace verticals with a clear growth path into becoming a proactive analytical partner who helps the team see around corners.

You'll be embedded with the business from day one, partnering closely with our Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management teams to uncover meaningful trends, conduct retrospective analyses across experiments, creatives, offers, seasonality, and CAC performance, and challenge the team with insights they aren't currently seeing. This is NOT a role for someone who wants to build dashboards and hand them off, it's for someone who cares deeply about whether the work they build gets used, understood, and acted on.

Outcomes (Performance Expectations)

• 30 Days in: Actively engaged with stakeholders to audit what reporting the team is consuming and why, i.e. identifying discrepancies, redundancies, and inconsistencies across existing dashboards and beginning to develop a roadmap to standardize reporting across your verticals.

• 60 Days in: Bridging business context and data understanding by being able to articulate how assigned verticals make money and what the key performance levers are. Actively improving dashboard standardization while executing on ad hoc requests with accuracy and business context.

• 90 Days in: Dashboard standardization is in execution and a clear roadmap exists for how trusted data sources will be developed to improve the efficiency of data consumption. LookML structure is understood well enough to begin making changes with full awareness of downstream impacts. Working relationships with Yield, Paid Media, and Account Management are established.

• 6 Months in: Trust is built with the business team through education, best practices, and a standardized reporting suite that enables confident self-service analytics. Proactive retrospective analyses are being delivered across experiments, creatives, offers, seasonality, and CAC performance. Strong understanding of the full funnel metrics that support each team.

• Year 1: Trusted technical owner for assigned verticals end-to-end, from raw data ingestion through final dashboard. Reporting standardization is complete, retrospective analysis is a consistent output, and the business team views you as a go-to analytical partner who recommends action, not just reports findings.

Competencies

• Analytical Rigor: Asks the hard questions and traces discrepancies to the source before drawing conclusions.

• Reporting Ownership: Engages stakeholders to understand how reporting is used before building, i.e. creates dashboards that are adopted, not just delivered.

• Business Acumen: Invests in understanding the business by asking the right questions before pulling the data.

• Communication: Asks enough upfront to make sure the answer lands with the right context for the right audience.

• Proactive Ownership: Surfaces problems early, engages before being asked, and drives work forward with a clear point of view.

• Collaboration: Builds trust by asking genuine questions and showing they care about what stakeholders need, not just what they asked for.

• Curiosity & Growth: Asks more than most and is driven to grow from technical executor into analytical partner over time.

TOTAL COMPENSATION

Base salary is set according to market rates for the nearest major metro and varies based on Launch Potato’s Levels Framework. Your compensation package includes a base salary, profit-sharing bonus, and competitive benefits. Launch Potato is a performance-driven company, which means once you are hired, future increases will be based on company and personal performance, not annual cost of living adjustments.

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Customer Data Traceability Engineer

This entry-level role works with Customer Quality, Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to help organize, connect, and validate data used to improve product quality, customer insights, and operational decision-making.

• Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines that capture AI dataset lineage and processing history

• Document data sources, transformations, ownership, versions, and usage across AI workflows

• Support metadata catalogs, data dictionaries, and traceability dashboards

• Perform data validation and investigate missing, inconsistent, or incorrectly linked records

• Help develop scripts and tools that automate data lineage, audit trails, and traceability checks

• Assist with monitoring dataset quality and resolving traceability issues with engineering teams

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand data and reporting requirements

Preferred:

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Sponsorship Sales — Global Conferences
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Sponsorship Sales will own the strategy, sales, and execution of the sponsorship program for DASH, Datadog’s flagship annual conference, while also supporting sponsorship strategy and sales for global Datadog Summits. You will manage the full sponsorship sales cycle, from developing packages and prospecting through negotiation, closing, renewal, and partner experience. This role carries a sponsorship revenue target and partners closely with Events, Partner Marketing, Community, Sales, Finance, and leadership to build a scalable sponsorship program. You will have the opportunity to shape how Datadog packages, positions, and grows sponsorship offerings across its global conference portfolio.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

• Build and manage the sponsorship revenue plan, pipeline, and forecast for DASH, reporting progress against targets to Events and Marketing leadership while supporting sponsorship strategy and sales for global Datadog Summits.

• Develop and evolve tiered sponsorship packages across branding, speaking opportunities, booth space, digital assets, lead generation, and other offerings based on sponsor needs and event capacity.

• Manage the full consultative sales cycle, including prospecting, qualification, pitching, negotiation, closing, renewals, and expansion with new and existing sponsors, while maintaining accurate CRM and sales activity reporting.

• Serve as the primary commercial relationship owner for sponsors from contract through onsite delivery, orchestrating the end-to-end partner journey while Event Marketing and agency partners manage fulfillment.

• Collaborate with Events, Marketing, Sales, Partner Marketing, Community, and Finance on event inventory and logistics, sponsorship positioning, account strategy, invoicing, and revenue planning.

• Represent DASH and the sponsorship program in sponsor meetings, at industry events, and onsite at conferences while identifying opportunities to improve sponsorship products, pricing, and sales processes.

Who You Are:

• You have 5+ years of experience in sponsorship, media, advertising, or B2B partnership sales, ideally supporting technology events or conferences.

• You have a demonstrated track record of owning and achieving significant sponsorship or partnership revenue targets, ideally including portfolios of $2M+.

• You have experience managing a consultative sales cycle from prospecting through close with senior marketing, partnership, or business stakeholders.

• You have experience developing and pricing sponsorship packages rather than solely selling from an established rate card.

• You bring strong CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, written communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

• You are willing to travel and work onsite during DASH and global Datadog Summit events; established relationships across relevant technology partner ecosystems are a plus.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

If you want to do the best work of your career, this is the right place.

Location Requirement

Our Support team is at the heart of Attio’s customer experience — maintaining an exceptional 98% CSAT average over the past six months. You’ll play a key role in maintaining the standards that make our customers love Attio — and help us set a new benchmark for excellence in B2B SaaS support.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

We’re looking for a customer-obsessed problem solver who combines technical curiosity with empathy and a love for helping others succeed.

jobs.title: Junior People Operations Specialist - Americas
jobs.description:
About TOTEME

TOTEME is a fashion house rooted in Swedish sensibilities, modern aspirations, and the notion of style.

With an appreciation for how pieces are worn in practice, we create emblematic designs with an emphasis on materiality and shape. Archetype pieces are realized in authentic materials, rich textures and graphic silhouettes. Representing a direct and decisive way of dressing, the collections are contextualized in curated edits, visuals, and spaces.

TOTEME was founded in 2014 by Elin Kling and Karl Lindman. From the atelier in Stockholm, we create women’s and men’s collections spanning ready-to-wear, shoes, bags, accessories, and jewelry.

The Role

TOTEME is looking for a Junior People Operations Specialist to join our team in New York full-time. In this role, you will support our growing organization across the Americas with day-to-day People operations, including payroll, HR administration, compliance, recruitment, onboarding and offboarding. You will report to the Chief People & Culture Officer and have a dotted line to the SVP North America. You will work directly with the Global People & Culture Team, as well as with our local managers.

Responsibilities

• Administer payroll, including salaries and commissions for employees and contractors.
• Manage HR administration in Justworks and act as the main point of contact for the platform.
• Support compliance and labor law-related matters, including employee handbooks, minimum wage requirements, required workplace postings and work environment matters.
• Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes, including contracts, HR systems, benefits, 401(k), background checks, payroll administration and exit interviews.
• Support recruitment for Retail Managers and first-line Office managers, including job postings, screening, initial video interviews and interview coordination.
• Act as the first point of contact for US employees on day-to-day People & Culture questions.
• Support the implementation and documentation of People processes and ways of working across North America
• Coordinate Performance Management processes in North America in collaboration with the global People & Culture Team and relevant internal stakeholders.
• Support Office-related operational tasks when needed.
• Participate in and contribute to TOTEME’s social and environmental sustainability strategy.

Your Profile

• A couple of years of broad HR experience, including hands-on experience with recruitment and payroll administration.
• A relevant degree in Human Resources or a related field.
• Experience working across multiple US states and/or countries is considered a plus.
• Experience within retail is considered a plus.
• Fluent in spoken and written English, with the right to work in the US and the ability to travel when required.

About You

• A TOTEME ambassador who lives and breathes our culture and values.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
• A proactive, service-minded and solution-oriented approach.
• Able to work independently and as part of a team in an international, fast-paced environment.

This is a full-time position based at TOTEME's New York office.

The annual salary for this role ranges between $70.000-75.000 and will be set according to the applicant’s profile, skills and previous experience.

TOTEME has teams in Stockholm, London, New York, and Shanghai, as well as retail spaces across Europe, North America, and Asia.

TOTEME has an internal career development and title framework and the job title used in the recruitment ad may differ from the title used internally at TOTEME.

Candidates progress through application, screening, interviews or case assessments, followed by final pre-employment checks and a formal offer before joining our team. We anonymize names and personal details in applications during the screening stage to support fair and skills-based hiring.

By applying to this position, I agree with TOTEME’s privacy policy and to be contacted about future job opportunities for up to two years from the submission date. Find out more about our privacy policy here.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Senior Solutions Architect at is a critical role that bridges the gap between our product team and client-facing teams. You will partner closely with our Go-to-market teams (Sales, Customer Success, etc.) to shape how customers adopt Harvey across use cases, practice groups, and geographies. This role is accountable for translating complex requirements into secure, scalable architectures that deliver clear business outcomes. You will work directly with technical and non-technical stakeholders—from engineering and IT to legal operations, security, and executive sponsors—to align on the right approach.

 - Act as the customer’s technical voice back into Harvey, influencing product roadmap and internal priorities based on real-world feedback and emerging post-sales needs.







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - Proven track record designing and implementing solutions for enterprise customers in SaaS, cloud, or AI/ML environments.

jobs.title: Director of Clinical Affairs
jobs.description:
ABOUT SONIO



Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.



Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.



Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.



About the role



You'll be the first Clinical hire in the US, leading a team covering both US & Europe. You'll directly report to the CEO and sit at the Excom. Your main missions are:

 - Own clinical strategy end-to-end — translate Excom priorities into a roadmap of studies, claims, KOLs and communication, in partnership with the CSO; arbitrate clinical priorities across DS, RAQA, Marketing and Ops

 - Manage and grow a 3-person clinical team, own the clinical budget, and represent Clinical Affairs at Excom

 - Own the clinical case for FDA 510(k) and EU MDR submissions, with RAQA

 - Drive KOL engagement and medical knowledge diffusion worldwide

 - Build scalable, repeatable clinical operation



About the profile



Sonio is a mission-driven company, so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

 - 12+ years of experience in Clinical Affairs at a medical-device company, ideally in AI / SaMD; healthtech scale-up experience

 - Strong technical/scientific background with ability to analyze/understand/assess technical, clinical, or scientific results

 - Strong background in MFM / OBGYN / prenatal medicine (or credible transferability)

 - Deep familiarity with clinical study design (validation, post-market, RWE), Good Clinical Practice, biostatistics fundamentals

 - Proven experience partnering with RAQA on FDA 510(k) and EU MDR submissions; understands clinical-validation requirements for AI-based medical devices

 - Strong experience managing team with both challenge & care

 - Business acumen: comfortable arbitrating between science, product, GTM and regulatory priorities at Excom level



Location: Ideally Boston, remote can be considered for the right candidate

Salary: $200k - $220k + 10% bonus



Sonio's Benefits

⚕️Health Insurance (Medical plan, vision, dental) - up to 30,000$ per year + FSA & HSA

👵 401(k) - up 4% of your salary matched

⛑️ Life Insurance - covering 2 times your salary, up to $200k

🐣 An attractive Parental Policy for primary and secondary caregivers

🏝️ 20 PTO + 1 week offered between Christmas and New Year

🖥️ Offices in Boston (HQ) & New York (incl. free breakfast, drinks & gym)

⏰ Flexible hours & remote policies

🚎 Commuter Benefits

✈️ One offsite per year in France & regular team building with US team

🚀 Ongoing trainings and continuous opportunities for professional growth and development, specifically unlimited access to coaching



We move fast and aspire to be transparent over the process - our objective is that the process from the first chat to an offer is no longer than a month. We also aspire to give an answer to every application in a week - if you have not heard from us, please follow up at careers@sonio.ai.

jobs.title: People Business Partner
jobs.description:
About Gigs

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

Things We Care About

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

• Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.

• Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.

• Customer Obsession. Our customers' product is our product.

• Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.

• First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

The Role

We’re hiring our first People Business Partner to help define what People partnering looks like at Gigs.

At Gigs, we believe that our People team exists to help the business succeed through its people. We partner closely with leaders to build exceptional teams, make thoughtful people decisions, and create the conditions for our people to do their best work. You’ll be a trusted thought partner to our org leads and managers, deeply understanding their business, priorities, and challenges and helping them navigate the people and organizational decisions that matter most.

This is not a traditional HRBP role. You’ll work across organizational design, talent strategy, performance, manager coaching, employee relations, career development, and organizational effectiveness, while also building the People infrastructure we need to scale, from leveling and career paths to performance, manager enablement, onboarding, and talent programs.

This is a builder role with significant ownership. We’re not looking to import a playbook; we want you to identify what will have the greatest impact, build what Gigs needs, and own it from strategy through execution.

The timing is intentional: our people are hungry for more. Employees are looking for more structure, clarity, and support to grow their careers, while our managers and org leads are eager for a strong thought partner as their teams and challenges become more complex. We’re at a point where investing meaningfully in both can have an outsized impact on the business.

What you will do

Partner with leaders to build exceptional teams

• Serve as a trusted advisor to org leads and managers on talent, organizational design, performance, and team effectiveness.

• Translate business strategy and goals into thoughtful decisions about organization, roles, capabilities, and talent.

• Coach managers at all levels on leadership, feedback, performance, team dynamics, and employee development.

• Partner with leaders on talent reviews, development, promotions, succession, and retention of exceptional talent.

• Navigate employee relations and organizational change with sound judgment, empathy, and rigor.

• Use qualitative and quantitative data to diagnose problems, identify trends, and proactively surface opportunities and risks.

Build the People systems Gigs needs to scale

• Design and evolve our leveling and career framework, creating clear expectations and meaningful paths for growth.

• Build and improve performance management, talent, and manager development programs.

• Shape key parts of the employee experience, including onboarding, engagement, and other People programs as the company evolves.

• Partner across the People team to turn business and employee insights into programs that meaningfully improve how we work.

• Use AI, automation, and better systems to eliminate repetitive work, create leverage, and rethink how People work gets done.

What we are looking for

• 5+ years of HR/People experience, including meaningful People Partner/HRBP experience in a high-growth technology company.

• Experience partnering closely with leaders and managers across functions and levels.

• Strong business acumen and genuine curiosity about how businesses operate, grow, and win.

• Deep experience across organizational design, talent, performance, manager coaching, and employee development.

• Experience building or evolving career frameworks, leveling, talent processes, or other People infrastructure.

• Excellent judgment, coaching, communication, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to navigate sensitive and ambiguous situations.

• A first-principles, builder’s mindset: you’re comfortable creating from scratch, questioning existing playbooks, and rolling up your sleeves to get the work done.

• Strong analytical skills and an interest in using AI and automation to make People work more effective and scalable.

• Knowledge of employment law and employee relations is preferred.

Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.

What We Offer

At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan

Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our Careers page.

jobs.title: Regional Lead
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're hiring a Regional Lead to join our team in Cameroon. Reporting to the Country Launcher, the role holder will oversee all Wave agent network acquisition and user growth operations for the assigned region, supervising Field Officers' activities and liaising with the respective agent admin teams to achieve the set targets in the region.

In this role, you'll;

• Agent Ops

• Agent growth: Coordinate the Field Officers in identifying opportunity areas for new agent locations and acquiring required agents according to the set agent selection criteria and guidelines.

• Agent Contracting: Ensure the Field Officers recruit agents in compliance with the legal and policy requirements as per the defined procedure. Ensure all agents in your region have executed valid contracts and are trained on the contents of the contract before they sign it.

• Agent Activation & Training: Ensure all agents are trained and certified (for all products and procedures). This includes Know Your Customer (KYC) and AML/CTF as per the defined agent training procedure and requirements. It also includes delivering supplies and coordinating outlet branding.

• Agent Ongoing Liquidity Management: Coordinate the cash / e-value availability monitoring at agents in liaison with Liquidity and Agent Quality Territory teams.

• Risk Management and Routine Visitation: Manage the teams in Monitoring Agent vs. target performance through Reports on emerging issues and assessments of the region's performance.

• Agent Churn: Coordinate the Identification of Agents for Closure (as per internal procedure), recover Wave items and equipment, and ensure branding material is removed.

• Compliance & Governance: Monitor and enforce complete legal, regulatory, and procedural compliance for all regional agents, ensuring prompt resolution of non-compliance issues.

• Brand Management & Visibility: Oversee the execution and maintenance of brand assets across all agent locations to ensure consistent, high-quality representation of the Wave brand.

• Growth/Distribution

• Distribution Management: Manage a team of Field Officers who, in turn, manage field-based promoters, whose role is to recruit new users to our financial products.

• Growth Strategy: Identify and find solutions to critical blockers for user growth and develop strategies to boost the retention of newly acquired users.

• Distribution Training and Monitoring: Hire, train, manage, and monitor distribution team members and utilise data to make decisions on distribution strategies.

• Be the primary contact person for all agency networks and new users in your region: Execute operational excellence, manage costs, and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines.

• Champion excellent customer service and implementation of quality service delivery standards.

• Data Management & Insights: Collect, review, and analyze field operations data to formulate strategic recommendations and optimize regional performance.

Key details

• Location: This is a field role. You will be based in one of these cities:

• Yaoundé: to manage Yaoundé, Bafoussam, and surroundings.

• Douala: to manage Douala, Bertoua, and surroundings.

• Work authorization in Cameroon is required.

• Contract type: Permanent Contract

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• We offer generous health insurance for yourself and your dependents.

• We support working parents - we offer 26 weeks of parental leave for mothers and 4 weeks for fathers, in addition to subsidized child care when they return to work.

• Airtime reimbursement.

Requirements

• Fluent in English - this role will interact regularly with non-French speakers.

• Master’s degree in a related field.

• Speak both French and English fluently.

• At least 5 years of relevant work experience, specifically managing an agent network and/or user acquisition in Cameroon, and a minimum of 2 years of experience managing field-based teams.

• Must have worked and overseen agent network activities in the upcountry.

• Prior launch experience is desirable

You might be a good fit if you

• Communicate effectively and often, both in writing and in person, to the point of over-communication.

• Are detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do.

• Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets.

• Enjoy owning projects - you're autonomous yet know when to escalate problems.

• Have built and led strong teams in achieving key results.

• Are intellectually curious, creative in the way you go about tackling problems, and embrace failure as a means to spark innovation and growth.

• Adjust quickly to changing priorities and conditions.

• Think about culture and process from the users' perspective.

• Are tech-savvy: comfortable navigating Excel and onboarding to new tools.

Our team

• We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.

• We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.

• We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.

• We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.

• We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Dyshagia Specialist Speech & Language Therapist-York
jobs.description:

Location: York

Salary: £39,959 - £56,515 DOE per annum

Hours: 22.5 hours per week

Recruitment is prioritised at Band 7 level however, applications from suitably qualified and dysphagia-trained Band 6 clinicians will also be considered. The role will be offered at three days per week.

Why join them?

Brainkind is a charity that aims to improve the lives of people with brain injuries in the UK. Our assessment centres, rehabilitation units and hospitals use expert neurorehabilitation to support people to regain the skills they have lost. We treat people with a range of brain injuries – sustained through trauma, illness, substance abuse and more – to recover and meet their personal goals. Our employees are incredibly passionate about the jobs they do – you will find a strong team spirit across our services and amazing colleagues who always pull together and look out for each other.

MAIN PURPOSE:

To work as part of a multi/interdisciplinary team providing speech and language therapy input within the Brainkind neurobehavioral model to clients with acquired brain injury in liaison with internal and external professionals, relevant social networks, and People We Support.

MAIN TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Clinical / Professional Practice

• Work as an autonomous clinical professional in a specialist area.

• To work within the limits of own competence and area of responsibility and accountability, seeking help and advice where needed.

You can look forward to excellent benefits, including handy discounts on many brands and services.

We also put a big focus on employee wellbeing and support. It matters to us that you feel at your best. Career development is a priority. We will ensure you get all the training and learning opportunities you need to achieve your goals.

To join our friendly team, click the Apply Now button.

Please note we will be shortlisting and interviewing candidates on a rolling basis until the role is filled therefore, we recommend applying as soon as possible.

All successful candidates are subject to compliance checks including 3 years of checkable references and DBS/PVG checks

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Scale our engineering power without losing our edge – shape the future of advanced radar technology.

As our Director of Engineering, you lead the operational transformation and rapid scale-up of our largest division. You co-own the engineering strategy with our CTO, taking full ownership of executing our annual plan, departmental budgets, and operational excellence. Working alongside our Management Team, you empower domain heads across software, hardware, RF, system engineering, and SVVT to deliver world-class 3D 360° radar systems. You turn strategic decisions into scalable processes while keeping our high-performance culture thriving.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Annual plan execution and governance: Take full operational accountability for executing the annual Engineering Business Plan. Drive release targets, manage R&D OPEX and CAPEX budgets, and safeguard division health

 - Strategic partnership and scaling: Co-own the technology roadmap with the CTO and translate it into operational goals. Lead the expansion of Engineering from 100 to 200+ FTEs, establishing robust systems engineering frameworks

 - Domain leadership and empowerment: Direct and empower heads of Software, Hardware, RF, System Engineering, and SVVT. Guide teams on a rolling next-quarter operational horizon to maintain high velocity and quality

 - Program delivery and integration: Oversee multi-disciplinary programs combining hardware, embedded software, micro-Doppler AI, and signal processing. Ensure seamless cross-functional synergy for on-time, high-quality product releases

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Proven track record scaling complex, multi-disciplinary engineering divisions from scale-up to mature organizations

 - Demonstrated experience co-owning strategy and managing multi-million R&D budgets alongside C-level peers

 - Strong background in combined hardware and software environments, including RF, radar systems, and AI

 - Deep expertise in Systems Engineering principles, V-model/Agile hybrid governance, and KPI management

 - Exceptional track record in recruiting, developing, and retaining high volumes of technical talent

 - Outstanding executive presence and ability to communicate complex technical insights to C-level board members

Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Lead - SD Management
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

Drives the daily operational performance and real-time execution of the helpdesk team. This role balances workforce monitoring, service level compliance, and active agent coaching to foster a high-performance service environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Queue & Service Level Management: Actively monitor real-time call queues, abandon rates, and ticket backlogs to dynamically shift resources and secure daily SLA targets.

• Operational Escalations: Act as the first formal escalation point for critical operational challenges, vendor disconnects, or highly dissatisfied employees.
• Quality Assurance: Partner with the Quality Analyst to review team performance metrics, identify training gaps, and implement targeted remediation plans.

Experience in Years

• Total Experience: 5 to 7 years of professional experience in customer management/operations.
• Domain-Specific Experience: Minimum 2 years of direct people management or supervisory experience leading a team within a voice-capable contact centre or an HR Shared Services hub.

Ideal Candidate Experience & Profile

• People Developer: The ideal candidate is an inspiring front-line captain who has successfully managed groups of 10–15 agents, focusing heavily on operational metrics without losing sight of human morale.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

This role is part of the Business Intelligence team, a centralized function supporting the broader organization through data-driven insights and analysis. The position carries meaningful ownership and accountability, reports to the Manager of Business Intelligence, and is responsible for delivering decision-grade reporting, partnering with stakeholders on KPIs and analytical solutions, improving data quality in collaboration with Data Engineering, and leading self-service BI communications and training.

Key Responsibilities

• Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and data models supporting business functions

• Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define KPIs, and translate them into actionable reporting solutions

• Ensure data accuracy and consistency by validating source data, monitoring report outputs, and documenting assumptions and definitions

• Collaborate with Data Engineering to define analytical requirements and contribute to the design of optimized data models and transformation logic

• Support self-service BI users through communications, collateral, and training materials

• Document KPI definitions, data lineage, and reporting assumptions to support consistency and self-service analytics

• Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and improve refresh reliability

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Experience in business intelligence, analytics, or data roles

• Proficiency in SQL, including techniques such as CTEs and window functions for dataset manipulation

• Familiarity with dimensional data modeling and data warehouse concepts

• Proficiency in Power BI (DAX, data modeling, Power Query, and dashboard design) or other visualization tooling

• Excellent ownership, problem-solving, communication, and time management skills with the ability to work independently on multiple projects
