jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Ivanti empowers organisations to manage and secure technology smarter through our AI‑powered Ivanti Neurons platform. We help IT and Security teams reduce complexity, work proactively, and deliver better outcomes at scale for customers around the world.

Ivanti helps organisations work smarter through Autonomous Endpoint Management powered by our AI‑driven Ivanti Neurons platform—delivering better outcomes for our customers by reducing complexity and enabling proactive IT and security operations.

About the Role

We're looking for a rare, full-stack data and AI practitioner who can operate fluidly from raw data all the way to production AI systems and the enterprise architecture that supports them. You will ingest and reason over everything from highly structured warehouse data in Snowflake to messy unstructured sources, turn it into defensible analytics, and ship agentic AI solutions that are both intelligent and ruthlessly cost-efficient.

This is a builder-first role with real architectural ownership. You'll write the models and the agents yourself, and you'll define the reference architectures, patterns, and standards that let the rest of the organization build on top of your work. If you're equally comfortable defending a confidence interval and a system-design decision, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

• Unify structured and unstructured data. Build pipelines that pull structured data from Snowflake (and adjacent warehouses/lakes) alongside unstructured sources — text, documents, logs, transcripts — into clean, modeling-ready datasets.

• Deliver decision-grade analytics. Produce customer churn analytics with properly quantified uncertainty (confidence/credible intervals), not just point estimates, and communicate what the numbers can and can't support.

• Build predictive and prescriptive models. Move beyond "what will happen" to "what should we do about it" — forecasting, propensity, and optimization/recommendation systems that drive concrete business actions.

• Engineer agentic AI systems. Design and ship LLM-powered agents and workflows that are token-efficient by design — tight context management, retrieval and caching strategies, model routing, and evaluation harnesses that keep cost and latency low without sacrificing quality.

• Architect for the enterprise. Define reference architectures, integration patterns, and governance standards spanning data ingestion, model development, MLOps/LLMOps, security, and observability — and bring stakeholders along with clear diagrams and documentation.

• Own quality and reliability. Establish evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails for drift, accuracy, bias, safety, and cost across both classical ML and GenAI systems.

• Partner across the business. Translate ambiguous business problems into technical solutions and explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders.

What You Bring (Required)

• Strong hands-on data engineering with Snowflake (modeling, performance, cost management) and SQL, plus experience wrangling unstructured data.

• Solid applied statistics: you can build churn/retention models and correctly express uncertainty with confidence or credible intervals, and you understand the assumptions behind them.

• Demonstrated experience building predictive and prescriptive analytics that shipped and influenced decisions.

• Production experience with LLM/agentic systems — frameworks such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK, CrewAI, or custom orchestrators — with a real track record of optimizing for token efficiency, cost, and latency.

• Production RAG experience (chunking, hybrid search, reranking, retrieval evals) is strongly expected at the senior+ level.

• Architecture chops: you can design and document end-to-end systems and patterns others build on, and defend those decisions with evidence.

• Strong Python and a software-engineering mindset (testing, version control, CI/CD).

• Excellent written and verbal communication; comfort working asynchronously in a distributed team.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

• Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer, Azure AI Engineer) and/or TOGAF for enterprise architecture.

• Experience with inference optimization (quantization, model routing, caching, vLLM/TensorRT-style serving).

• MLOps/LLMOps tooling and platform-building experience.

• Domain experience in [your industry], and prior work owning AI strategy or build-vs-buy decisions.

What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)

• A unified data foundation that combines Snowflake and unstructured sources for downstream modeling.

• A churn analytics product trusted by the business, with quantified uncertainty and clear recommended actions.

• At least one production agentic solution that demonstrably reduces token spend/latency versus a naive baseline while meeting quality bars.

• A documented reference architecture and set of standards adopted by other teams.

Why Ivanti?

• Friendly flexible working model: Empower excellence whether you’re at home or in the office and support work-life balance.

• Competitive compensation & total rewards: Including health, wellness, and financial plans tailored for you and your family.

• Global, diverse teams:Collaborate with talented people from 23+ countries.

• Learning & development:Grow your skills with access to best-in-class learning tools and programs.

• Equity & belonging:We value every voice. Your story helps inform our solutions for a changing world.

What drives us

Ivanti’s mission is to elevate human potential within organizations by managing, protecting and automating technology for continuous innovation.

It is through diverse and inclusive hiring, decision-making, and commitment to our employees and partners that we will continue to build and deliver world-class solutions for our customers.

To learn more about Ivanti’s Mission and Core Values.

Inclusion at Ivanti

Ivanti is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life. Need adjustments during the process? Reach out to talent@ivanti.com we’re happy to help.

jobs.title: Sr. Regional Web Product Manager

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

The Sr. Regional Web Product Manager owns the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Samsara's regional websites across MX, CAN, and EMEA markets, with new locales as we expand. The role aligns each regional site to how buyers in that market research, evaluate, and buy. You will define those experiences, build the roadmap to get there, and prove the impact through experimentation and measurement.

This is a cross-functional individual contributor role. You will partner with regional teams and with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, Growth, and Web Engineering to shape the experience, and you will set the operating model other teams adopt when they publish internationally.

If you want to own a business-critical surface end to end and shape how a global company shows up in every market it sells in, this role is for you.

In this role, you will:

• Own the strategy and roadmap for Samsara's regional websites — defining what we build, in what order, and why, and holding the roadmap accountable to regional pipeline and awareness goals

• Define how success is measured for regional web — Set the metrics, targets, and reporting that regional and marketing leadership use to evaluate the channel

• Work with cross-functional pods of designers, engineers, content strategists, and regional marketers — setting direction, sequencing the work, and unblocking delivery

• Build and run the experimentation program for regional sites — CRO, testing, and personalization strategy

• Partner with content marketing teams to drive successful AEO and SEO strategies, and stay current on best practices and latest innovations

• Identify AI use cases and deploy agents to improve all stages of regional site product management and development

• Lead a high-complexity regional web initiatives, new market launches, site architecture changes, regional redesigns, from concept through launch and post-launch measurement

• Communicate regional web performance and roadmap progress to marketing leadership and regional stakeholders on a regular cadence, translating results into recommendations rather than status updates

• Raise the capability of the wider web and regional marketing teams — mentoring ICs, creating shared learning and documentation, and serving as the go-to expert on international web

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 5+ years in web product management, digital experience, or web strategy, including direct ownership of the roadmap for a high-traffic marketing site

• Experience owning web experiences in multiple international markets, including localizing those experiences for in-market relevance rather than translating a single source site

• Track record of running a web experimentation program, including setting the standards and interpreting the results

• Working knowledge of web analytics and experimentation tools (e.g. Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Tableau, and an A/B testing platform), and the ability to build measurement structures rather than request them

• Technical SEO and AEO foundation, including international considerations

• Experience working directly with engineering on a modern web stack: CMS architecture, component systems, performance, and release process

• Executive communication skills, including making the case for a regional web strategy to marketing leadership and to regional stakeholders with competing priorities

• Track record of driving outcomes through influence across functions and geographies without formal authority

• Has built AI workflows or agents into their own way of working, and pushes the team's thinking on what comes next

This is a high-impact, hands-on role shaping how B2B users experience Lovable every day.



Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.


ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are an exchange. The speed of good decisions matter in everything that we do. Our data domain is committed to making sure the decisions this business makes on spend, pricing, product, risk and financial crime rest on evidence rather than intuition. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality.



The Problems You'll Get to Solve

 - Growth & causal inference. Measure true incrementality, own our marketing mix model, and turn that into spend allocation under a budget.

 - Product & personalization. Rank and surface what is relevant to each customer's behaviour and holdings, from asset discovery to order form defaults, without drowning users in noise

 - Markets, pricing & execution. Model fee and spread elasticity to find the revenue-versus-volume trade-off, and improve execution quality: slippage, order routing, liquidity provider selection.

 - Risk & financial integrity. Model risk exposure across a volatile asset book, forecast liquidation risk, and detect reconciliation breaks across internal ledgers, on-chain data and partner reporting.

 - Financial crime & compliance. Detect account takeover, payment fraud and mule networks in real time, combining business rules and models that work together while staying explainable and auditable.



What You'll Be Doing

 - Own problems end to end: frame the question with the stakeholder, build the model or experiment, ship it, and follow it into production.

 - Work backwards from the decision. Start from what someone needs to decide and what it costs to get it wrong, not from the data that happens to be available.

 - Stay accountable for your models once they are live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and the day they start behaving differently.

 - Tell senior stakeholders things they do not want to hear, including that a campaign, a feature or a rule did not work.

 - Support your teammates in growing every day by setting the standard for how we do causal inference, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge.



What We Look For

 - Strong applied experience turning a messy business question into a model or a measurement: causal inference where that fits, predictive and ranking models where it does not. You know when a result is not real.

 - Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working independently rather than waiting for data to be handed to you. We use Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Looker, on top of technologies like MySQL, Druid, Kafka and Flink.

 - A track record of models that made it into production and changed a decision, not just notebooks and slide decks.

 - Sound statistical judgement, and the honesty to quantify and communicate uncertainty rather than hide it.

 - Exceptional communication skills. We expect you to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively.

 - Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering people with freedom and accountability.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience building with agentic tooling such as MCP or agent frameworks, or automation platforms like n8n.

At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. WHAT WE OFFER

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

jobs.description:

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. Lovable is changing who gets to build software. The right partners can help us reach enterprise customers, fit into their infrastructure, simplify procurement, improve the product, and support delivery.

Lovable already works with Google Cloud, Microsoft, AWS, and selected GSIs, but the opportunity is bigger than the team can run today. Dan needs a senior operator who can build the business, close execution gaps, and turn a few high-value relationships into customer adoption and revenue.

This is a business to build. There is no mature alliance organization or finished playbook to inherit.

 - Resolve dependencies across Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Operations.

jobs.title: Senior/Lead Gameplay Animator - 3C & FPS
jobs.location: Canada-Remote; France-Remote; Guangzhou Office; Hangzhou Office; Shanghai Office; Spain-Remote; United Kingdom ; United States-Remote
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior or Lead Gameplay Animator with strong AAA FPS experience to help shape responsive, compelling character movement and moment-to-moment gameplay.
With a focus on Character, Controls, and Camera (3C), you will combine animation craft with practical implementation skills to develop features from early prototypes through final in-game polish. Working closely with gameplay designers, programmers, and technical animators, you will help ensure that character animation, player input, and camera behavior work together to deliver a cohesive player experience.
This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership of gameplay animation features and opportunities to influence the systems and workflows behind them.

What You’ll Do

• Own gameplay animation features from concept to completion, including reference gathering, prototyping, asset creation, engine integration, debugging, and polish.

• Create high-quality character movement and action animations, covering locomotion, directional changes, stance transitions, traversal, and combat interactions.

• Contribute to first-person animation and its relationship with full-body movement, weapon handling, and camera feedback.

• Partner with designers and programmers to refine movement responsiveness, action timing, transitions, and interruption behavior while preserving believable weight and physicality.

• Build and refine animation graphs, state machines, blend setups, and animation layers within the project’s engine and tools.

• Use keyframe animation and motion-capture workflows to deliver animation that meets gameplay and visual requirements.

• Evaluate your work in playable builds, identify the causes of animation issues, and collaborate across disciplines to resolve them.

• Work with technical animation and engineering teams to improve workflows and address runtime, asset, and production constraints.

• For Lead-level appointments, guide feature planning, establish animation quality benchmarks, provide actionable feedback, and mentor teammates while continuing to create and implement animation directly.

What You’ll Bring

• Proven experience creating and implementing gameplay animation for AAA first-person shooters, with clear ownership of features or animation systems.

• A strong portfolio demonstrating body mechanics, weight, timing, posing, and a clear understanding of responsive gameplay animation.

• Practical experience taking animation assets into a game engine and iterating on their behavior in playable builds.

• Working knowledge of animation graphs, state machines, blending, additive animation, and gameplay-driven transitions.

• An understanding of how character movement, player controls, and camera behavior influence each other and shape game feel.

• Proficiency in professional animation tools, with experience in keyframe animation and motion-capture editing.

• The ability to investigate animation problems, explain their likely causes, and work with design and engineering partners to deliver effective solutions.

• Strong ownership, clear communication, and a consistent record of delivering work within production constraints.

What Will Set You Apart

• Hands-on experience on recent AAA FPS productions with a high standard of player movement, first-person animation, and combat responsiveness.

• Direct involvement in establishing or evolving 3C animation systems, particularly from early development through production.

• Additional experience on AAA action or action-adventure games involving sophisticated traversal, melee combat, or character interactions.

• A technical animation background that enables you to understand and resolve issues across animation assets, runtime systems, and gameplay logic.

• Experience with techniques such as inverse kinematics, motion matching, procedural animation, motion warping, or animation retargeting.

• Scripting or tool-development experience that improves animation workflows and iteration speed.

• Experience maintaining consistency between first-person presentation and third-person character animation.

Senior / Lead Expectations
Senior: Independently own complex animation features, make sound creative and technical decisions, and drive implementation and polish with cross-disciplinary partners.
Lead: Combine strong individual delivery with the ability to guide others, align animation work with gameplay goals, and maintain quality across interconnected features.
We also welcome high-potential candidates with relevant production experience and exceptional portfolios who demonstrate the ability to grow into broader ownership. Level will reflect demonstrated capability and contribution.
Location & Working Arrangement
Relocation to China is preferred. Remote arrangements may be considered based on location, time-zone compatibility, and collaboration needs.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity:
NetEase is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity in its workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We also comply with applicable federal, state, and local laws regarding applicants with criminal histories. If you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any part of the application process, please email globaltalent@service.netease.com.

Data Privacy

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive - Robotics (Boston)
jobs.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

Impact In This Role

As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive - Robotics, you'll work with some of the most exciting robotics OEMs, warehouse automation integrators, and companies building industrial robots, cobots, AMRs/AGVs, and humanoid platforms — helping them source precision components (actuators, end-effectors, structural parts, enclosures) as they move from prototype through low-volume and bridge production. You'll dig into each customer's business goals — financial KPIs, vision, key initiatives, org structure, in-house manufacturing capabilities, R&D labs — and their internal decision-making structure, so you can build relationships with the right people. You'll also learn their product roadmaps, requirements, and priorities for bringing products to market, along with their existing partnerships (design partners, contract manufacturers, local shop preferences). With that knowledge, you'll configure the right solution to speed up their time to market — identifying both prototyping opportunities and production-class manufacturing programs that let customers launch products faster than they thought possible. Your leadership will be key to coordinating the full MISUMI Americas team supporting you. You'll deliver sales presentations and lead on-site meetings — sales meetings, quarterly business reviews, tech days — to build confidence, deepen relationships, and grow customer lifetime value.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Build relationships with mechanical/electrical engineers and supply chain leads at robotics and automation companies

• Track industry trends (humanoid robotics, warehouse automation, autonomous mobile robots) to identify new account targets

• Understand robotics-specific manufacturing needs — tight tolerances, lightweight materials, small-batch runs, rapid design iteration as robots move from R&D to scale

• Build credibility and trust with C-suite stakeholders

• Prospect to build and maintain a healthy pipeline

• Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales quotas

• Maintain accurate account and opportunity forecasting in Salesforce.com

• Generate new business opportunities within your target account list

• Build meaningful, long-term relationships with key customer contacts

• Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, and industry events

• Become a true expert in your accounts' product development needs, plans, and challenges

• Help expand MISUMI Americas' reputation as a leader in digital manufacturing

• Spend over 50% of your time traveling to meet customers face-to-face

• Work within a team sales structure

• Collaborate cross-functionally to win complex deals

Desired Traits

• Experience selling specifically into robotics, automation, or advanced hardware companies — not just manufacturing broadly

• Familiarity with robotics components/subsystems (actuators, sensors, grippers, drivetrains) a plus

• Comfortable working with customers who iterate hardware designs quickly and need fast part turnaround

• Minimum of 8 years consistently meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly targets

• Manufacturing and supply chain industry experience

• BS/BA degree preferred

• Strong grasp of product development and related business requirements

• Experience driving consultative, solution-based sales and expanding within strategic industry verticals

• Track record of quickly building a new pipeline and managing a forecast to consistently exceed quota

• Expertise with modern sales tools (CRM, sequencing, prospecting, collaboration platforms)

Physical Demands

Standard office and home-office work environment with extensive computer, phone, and video-conference use. Ability to travel by air and drive within assigned territory, including navigating customer plant floors and manufacturing environments during field visits.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Digital Experiences - Mattel Digital Studio
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Mattel Digital is looking for a Product Manager to help build, launch, scale, and monetize digital experiences, platforms, and services that extend Mattel IP into meaningful fan, family, and collector engagement. This role sits on the Digital Experiences team and will help shape product strategy, build business cases, align senior leaders around investment decisions, bring new 0-to-1 opportunities to market, and grow established platforms into larger digital businesses.

The Product Manager will own and develop digital opportunities that create value for Mattel beyond one-time campaign activations. This includes fan engagement products, physical-to-digital extensions, collector utilities, subscription or service concepts, cross-brand digital platforms, and reusable experience infrastructure. The role requires strong product judgment, comfort with ambiguity, disciplined execution, business case development, executive communication, and the ability to partner across brands, marketing, design, production, engineering, legal, finance, data, DTC, gaming, and external vendors.

This role requires a Product Manager who is comfortable with both sides of digital product ownership: creating new products from zero to one and operating established platforms with a clear path to growth, scale, and monetization.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Own the strategy, discovery, definition, launch, optimization, and growth of digital experiences that leverage Mattel brands and intellectual property.

• Lead 0-to-1 product development for new digital experiences, from early concept and opportunity sizing through MVP definition, launch readiness, market launch, and post-launch iteration.

• Build product strategies and business cases that clarify the audience opportunity, consumer value proposition, revenue model, investment needs, risks, dependencies, and path to scale.

• Partner with Digital Experiences leadership to align ELT and senior stakeholders around strategic priorities, funding asks, investment tradeoffs, and launch decisions.

• Own established digital platforms and identify opportunities to improve engagement, retention, monetization, operating efficiency, and long-term scalability.

• Translate business goals, audience needs, and brand strategies into clear product requirements, roadmaps, briefs, user stories, success metrics, and decision frameworks.

• Evaluate opportunities based on audience value, business impact, feasibility, scalability, monetization potential, first-party data value, and reusable capability.

• Help shift digital work from one-time launches toward living products that are measured, maintained, improved, and scaled over time.

• Define and track product success metrics, including engagement, retention, conversion, monetization, toy revenue lift, user satisfaction, operating cost, and learning milestones; use those signals to recommend whether to scale, optimize, pivot, pause, or sunset initiatives.

• Develop product documentation and cross-functional plans, including product briefs, PRDs, business cases, experiment plans, launch plans, post-launch readouts, stakeholder updates, dependencies, budgets, risks, and launch readiness.

• Coordinate with design, production, engineering, analytics, marketing, legal, privacy, safety, and brand teams to deliver high-quality consumer-facing experiences.

• Maintain awareness of digital product, AI, interactive entertainment, creator, collector, subscription, and fan engagement trends that may inform Mattel's digital growth opportunities.

• Help create repeatable operating practices, templates, and processes that allow Mattel to build digital experiences more efficiently across brands and audiences.

• 5+ years of product management experience building consumer-facing digital products, apps, platforms, services, ecommerce experiences, fan communities, subscriptions, or other digital experiences.
• Demonstrated success taking digital products from concept through launch and post-launch growth, with clear examples of business impact, user adoption, engagement, retention, monetization, or operational improvement.

• Strong product strategy skills, including the ability to define customer problems, size opportunities, shape MVPs, prioritize tradeoffs, create roadmaps, and make clear recommendations with incomplete information.

• Experience owning product outcomes and connecting product decisions to business results, including revenue, margin, engagement, retention, customer acquisition, first-party data, brand value, and operating leverage.

• Proven ability to develop business cases, funding recommendations, executive materials, or strategic decision narratives for new or growing digital products.

• Strong analytical judgment, including the ability to define success metrics, interpret product performance, identify actionable insights, and recommend whether to scale, optimize, pivot, pause, or sunset an initiative.

• Excellent cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to align creative, technical, business, and brand stakeholders.

• Strong execution discipline, including planning, dependency management, vendor coordination, launch readiness, risk tracking, and follow-through.

• Experience working in agile product development environments and managing products through discovery, launch, lifecycle management, and post-launch optimization.

• Ability to create concise, high-quality written materials for different audiences, from working teams to senior leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in entertainment, consumer products, kids/family products, digital media, subscriptions, DTC, fan platforms, or branded digital experiences.

• Experience working with licensed or franchise-based IP.

• Familiarity with app stores, web products, live operations, user acquisition, CRM, community, content platforms, or digital commerce.

• Experience using product analytics tools, A/B testing, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, or lifecycle metrics.

• Experience working with external agencies, software vendors, design partners, or development studios.

• Understanding of privacy, safety, and compliance considerations for consumer-facing digital products, especially products that may reach kids, families, or global audiences.

• Experience using AI-assisted product, prototyping, research, analysis, or development tools such as Codex to accelerate discovery, execution, experimentation, and decision-making.

• Familiarity with AI, creator tools, interactive entertainment, digital collectibles, or emerging fan engagement models that could inform new consumer experiences or operating models.

jobs.title: Product Manager, LiveOps - Mattel Digital Studio
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

Mattel Game Studios is seeking a Product Manager, LiveOps for our casual portfolio. Your first assignment is our upcoming title built around Barbie, our flagship IP, with scope extending to additional casual titles as the slate grows.

This role owns LiveOps strategy and the meta-layer end-to-end: progression systems, collection and customization mechanics, event architecture, offer strategy, and reward structures — from pre-launch architecture through live operations. You will define the product strategy for these systems around the IP to create a cohesive experience where the brand drives player engagement, retention, and long-term revenue.

Mattel Game Studios operates as a publisher with external development studios. This role is the LiveOps lead on the publisher side, working day-to-day with the studio's Game Design, Engineering, and Production teams while aligning internal stakeholders across Product, Marketing, and Data.

The ideal candidate is passionate about casual mobile games and IP-driven player experiences, has strong instincts for how fashion, lifestyle, or collection-based meta systems drive engagement, is scrappy and proactive, thrives in a build-from-scratch environment, brings a bias toward experimentation and rapid iteration, is comfortable operating with ambiguity in a game still taking shape, and keeps up with the latest trends in LiveOps, monetization, and the broader free-to-play market.

What Your Impact Will Be:

• Co-own the game's feature roadmap with Product, Game Design, Production and the external development studio. Drive prioritization of features that strengthen the meta experience and IP expression, support the LiveOps strategy, and maintain a healthy game economy.

• Develop the LiveOps event framework and cadence strategy from scratch, defining event types, reward structures and seasonal beats — then execute and iterate a content calendar that maximizes engagement, retention and monetization.

• Own the meta-progression and offer strategy: define the player-facing shape of collection and customization progression, offer architecture, and the promotional calendar. Specify economic intent and success criteria; the Lead Designer, Systems and Economy models and balances the underlying systems to meet it. Ensure the meta-layer gives players meaningful reasons to engage with the IP across every session.

• Own LiveOps and economy outcomes: set and hold targets for engagement, retention, revenue per user, payer conversion, and economy health, and hold the go/no-go on economy changes shipping to live. Partner with the Lead Designer, Systems and Economy, who owns the underlying economic model and math. Partner with Data to analyze performance, design and run experiments continuously, and report against targets with clear action plans. Share learnings and a data-driven playbook of what works across the team and the external studio.

• Champion the IP in product decisions: ensure that events, offers, collections, and progression milestones express the brand in ways that resonate with the target audience. Partner with Game Design and the external studio to translate IP strength into product requirements and content strategies that drive engagement and monetization.

• Define LiveOps requirements for the external development studio, review builds, provide feedback on design decisions that impact economy and progression, and ensure the publisher–studio feedback loop is tight and productive.

• Keep a pulse on player sentiment via app reviews, community channels, and surveys. Translate feedback into testable hypotheses in coordination with Game Design to inform event design and economy tuning.

• Work cross-functionally across Production, Game Design, Engineering, and Marketing to align on objectives and execute key beats.

What We’re Looking For:

• 4+ years of experience in free-to-play mobile games in a Product Management or LiveOps role.
• Direct experience working on a casual mobile game with strong meta-layer or collection/customization systems such as fashion, lifestyle, or dress-up games strongly preferred (e.g. Covet Fashion, Design Home, or similar IP-driven titles). Match-3 or puzzle experience is a plus.
• Deep understanding of F2P LiveOps mechanics, meta-progression systems, and game economy fundamentals — you've built or tuned event frameworks, collection or customization loops, and offer strategies, with a track record of measurable impact on engagement and revenue KPIs.
• Strong experimentation instinct — you default to testing hypotheses and move fast to learn and iterate.
• Experience using data tools (BigQuery, Excel/Sheets, Tableau or similar) to drive decisions, including working with economy models and sink/source analyses.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present key learnings to the broader team.
• Comfortable with ambiguity — you can contribute to or adapt to game design decisions that are still in flux.
• Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working in a publisher model or collaborating closely with an external development studio.
• Experience with soft launch, geo-testing, or bringing an F2P mobile game from development through global launch.
• Experience working with licensed or well-known consumer IP.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

• Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets

• Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS

• Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About the role

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager who thinks about patient acquisition the way a GM thinks about a business. You'll own Hers' growth marketing strategy — from channel investment and budget allocation through to the customer insights and creative ideas that drive it.
This isn't a campaign execution role. You'll be setting the strategic direction: understanding who our patients are and why they come to Hers, turning that insight into high-performing creative and messaging, and making smart commercial trade-offs to grow efficiently. You'll work cross-functionally with creative, clinical, analytics, and product teams across Sydney and the UK.

What you'll do

• Own Hers' patient acquisition strategy end-to-end — from channel mix and budget allocation through to the messaging hypotheses that drive it

• Use customer research, patient insight, and performance data to build strategies that attract the right patients at the right cost

• Balance CAC and LTV trade-offs — understanding the difference between patients who stay engaged in their treatment and those who don't, and using that to inform acquisition decisions

• Build and maintain a rigorous test-and-learn framework across channels, creative formats, and audience segments

• Partner closely with our creative team to develop concepts grounded in real patient insight — you understand why creative works, not just whether it does

• Identify the highest-leverage opportunities across paid channels (Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok) and funnel experience

• Work cross-functionally with analytics, product, and clinical to make sure growth is connected to the full patient experience

• Communicate a clear, evidence-based point of view on performance and strategy to senior stakeholders

About you

• 5+ years in growth or performance marketing, with genuine ownership of commercial acquisition outcomes

• You've built a growth strategy from scratch — you know what to prioritise and why, not just how to execute what you're given

• Comfortable moving between qualitative customer insight and quantitative performance data to form a clear strategic view

• Strong understanding of creative as a commercial lever — you can brief it, evaluate it, and iterate in partnership with a creative team

• Commercial instinct: you understand CAC/LTV dynamics and can make budget investment decisions with confidence

• Hands-on experience across paid channels — but you lead with strategy and insight, not platform mechanics

• Strong communicator and natural cross-functional partner — you influence product, analytics, creative, and clinical without needing direct authority

• Thrives setting their own agenda in a fast-moving environment

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software, Compound) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, skincare, and preventative health.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

• What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.

• Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.

• Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

• Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.

• Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in Australia?

• Grow with us globally - Get mentorship from leaders across Australia, the UK, Germany, and Japan, collaborate with teams in the Philippines and South Africa, and explore new markets or travel internationally. ****Recognised on Hatch’s Hotlist as one of Australia’s top employers, we support early-career professionals to become future global leaders.

• Shape your career - Access learning budgets, conferences, certifications, peer shadowing, and a global knowledge-sharing culture.

• Work where well-being matters - Experience catered wellness talks, exercise classes, free barista coffees, funded social clubs, and quarterly rooftop parties.

• Innovate with purpose - Use state-of-the-art tools and contribute to bold, impactful solutions in healthcare.

• Support at every stage - Benefit from parental and miscarriage leave, health, professional development, and personal days, and our Employee Assistance Program.

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

jobs.title: Drilling Supervisor/Auditor
jobs.description:
• Provide quality assurance of drill pipe, BHA and specialty tools inspection for all Company business units. The tools and equipment may include, but are not limited to, drill pipe, BHA equipment, specialty drilling tools (mud motors, MWD/LWD, RSS), stabilizers, fishing tools, HWDP, API rotary connections, premium connections, casing/tubing, handling equipment, liner hangers, packers, frac sleeves, jars, power units, and cementing tools.
• Provide failure analysis to determine the cause of failures and determine the material properties of the components.
• Follow and adhere strictly to the Company approved quality assurance inspection plans and not deviate, modify, add to or delete any of the requirements listed in these plans or directives.
• Follow and adhere to the most recently published version of the “Company Oil & Gas Corp BHA & Drill Pipe Field Inspection & Management Statement of Requirements”.
• Review quality documentation, procedures and specifications to ensure that they are compliant with the required levels.
• Ensure that third party equipment and personnel supplied for well drilling and completion activities are fit for purpose.
• Review, verify and witness ITP/QCP for equipment used on the well are executed correctly and all required NDT, visual, dimensional inspections, gauging, applicable equipment function and pressure tests are performed correctly.
• Review and ensure that the drill string/OCTG items used on the well are compliant with all relevant DS1, API and Company outlined standards and requirements.
• Witness and perform surveillance of inspection activities on drill string equipment to ensure compliance with all relevant standards and all equipment are being used and calibrated correctly, and all personnel are qualified and competent.
• Witness and monitor assembly/disassembly of BHA, testing, and completion subassemblies. Provide final reports denoting the equipment’s compliance or non-compliance with Company’s specifications and requirements.
• Witness and monitor the inspections, test and build of liner hanger systems to verify correct arrangement, pressure testing and shear pinning of the tools to be in accordance with ITP, QCP, OEM specifications.
• Perform rig audits, as requested by Company, to witness drill pipe handling and connection practices and inspect rig floor equipment for certifications, calibrations, and general condition.
• Visit machine shop facilities to verify and ensure any manufacturing or repairs are as per the required specifications, equipment is in proper use and calibrated, and all inspection, testing and gauging are performed by competent personnel.
• Provide job reports and daily time-logs recording work performed and inspections completed. Reports shall also contain any non-compliances, job discrepancies and agreed remedial plans.

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, or technical discipline. (mandatory)

• Knowledge of safety principles, implementation techniques and program maintenance skills.
• Skilled computer user, proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

jobs.description:
LIFE AT UIPATH

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?






YOUR MISSION:

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager II to join our Indonesia team and help enterprise customers achieve measurable business value through automation, AI, and agentic transformation.

You will be the primary post-sales relationship owner for a portfolio of strategic and enterprise customers. You will help customers move from traditional automation to intelligent, AI-powered, and agentic ways of working.

You will work closely with customer executives, automation leaders, IT teams, business stakeholders, partners, Sales, Professional Services, Support, Product, and Technical Account Managers to drive adoption, value realization, retention, and growth.

The ideal candidate is commercially minded, outcome-oriented, and comfortable navigating complex customer environments. You should be able to build trusted executive relationships, translate emerging AI and automation capabilities into business outcomes, and proactively manage customer risks.




THIS IS WHAT YOU'LL DO AT UIPATH:

 - Own the customer success lifecycle from Sales handover through onboarding, implementation, adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion.

 - Develop and maintain joint success plans aligned to customer priorities, business outcomes, automation strategy, and AI transformation goals.

 - Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives, business leaders, IT stakeholders, and Automation Centres of Excellence.

 - Help customers identify and prioritize opportunities for automation, AI, agents, orchestration, process intelligence, and intelligent document processing.

 - Lead customer governance forums, executive business reviews, value reviews, and transformation planning sessions.

 - Drive platform adoption, usage growth, enablement, and engagement across customer teams.

 - Help customers define, communicate, and realize the value of automation and AI, including productivity gains, cost savings, improved customer experience, risk reduction, and operational resilience.

 - Identify customer risks early, maintain account health plans, and coordinate recovery actions for at-risk customers.

 - Partner with Sales on renewal strategy, commercial planning, expansion opportunities, and accurate forecasting.

THIS IS WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TEAM

 - 6-8 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Professional Services, Solution Delivery, or a related customer-facing role.

 - Experience managing enterprise or strategic customers in a technology, SaaS, cloud, automation, AI, or business transformation environment.

 - Strong project and program management capabilities.

 - Experience with executive business reviews, success planning, value reporting, and account governance.

NICE TO HAVE:

WHY JOIN US?

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer: Compute

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Frontier AI runs on datacenters, and the world is in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout in a generation. The binding constraint on progress is increasingly everything around the chips: land, power, permits, equipment, and the design and construction of the buildings themselves. Bringing a single site online involves hundreds of people, thousands of components, and decisions that move enormous amounts of capital. Much of that work still runs on spreadsheets and handoffs.

At Anthropic, we're building software and Claude-powered tools to help Anthropic scale out its compute, and we think there's an enormous opportunity to rethink how that work gets done. It's early, it's already having a real impact, and the engineers who join now will shape how one of the most consequential buildouts in the world gets done.

We're looking for strong, versatile software engineers who love building for people doing real work in the physical world. You'll embed with the teams that source sites, design buildings, procure equipment, and manage construction, learn their work deeply, and build the tools and systems they rely on every day. Datacenter experience is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert operators, model a messy domain cleanly, and move fast.

Responsibilities

• Build the core systems that track a datacenter's lifecycle (sites, designs, bills of materials, equipment, and construction progress) in one trusted, permissioned source of truth

• Embed with datacenter, energy, and supply chain teams to understand how the work actually gets done, find the critical path, and build the tools they reach for first

• Bring order to messy data by migrating and reconciling spreadsheets and legacy trackers, and integrate with the industry's tools, like construction management, scheduling, and engineering systems

• Design for trust: fine-grained permissions, auditability, and data quality for information that steers major investment decisions

• Ship early, iterate with users, and cut anything that doesn't help bring compute online sooner

• Partner with research to understand new model capabilities and share where they fall short in engineering-heavy, physical-world domains

You may be a good fit if you

• Have 8+ years of experience building software, with strong full-stack skills and solid grounding in data modeling, APIs, and databases

• Have built software that teams in a physical-world industry depend on, such as datacenters, construction, energy, manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics

• Have a track record of zero-to-one work in startup or startup-like environments

• Are deeply user-centric: you learn the domain from the people doing the work and validate with them before over-investing

• Bring high agency and good judgment about what matters, and hold strong opinions loosely

• Communicate clearly across engineering, operations, and research, and care about the societal impacts of your work

Strong candidates may also have

• Experience in datacenters (at a hyperscaler, colocation provider, operator, utility, or engineering firm), or in adjacent fields like construction, logistics, or legal

• Experience with the domain's tooling, such as construction management (Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud), scheduling (Primavera P6), PLM/BOM, ERP and procurement, CAD/BIM, DCIM, or power system studies

• A background in electrical, mechanical, or civil engineering, energy systems, or supply chain alongside a software career

• Experience building products with large language models

Candidates need not have

• 100% of the skills listed above

• Formal certifications or education credentials

• Direct machine learning or AI research experience

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$320,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Corporate Security
jobs.description:
About depthfirst

We believe that software is the foundation of modern civilization. Yet vulnerabilities threaten its integrity, security, and resilience. We are on a mission to secure the world's software.

depthfirst is building intelligence to detect and remediate critical software vulnerabilities. We are training and scaling security AI agents to discover zero-day vulnerabilities across large customer codebases and popular open source software.

Our founding team brings deep expertise in data, infrastructure, security and AI, with leaders from DeepMind, Databricks, Square, and Faire. We're looking for thoughtful, driven people excited to work at the intersection of AI, Security, and Infrastructure.



About This Role

As one of our first security engineers, you'll own corporate security at depthfirst, protecting the identities, devices, and applications our team relies on every day. You'll build the tooling, integrations, and automation that keep workforce access, endpoints, and enterprise apps secure by default as we grow.



You're excited about this role because you will...

 - Shape our corporate security foundations as one of our first security engineers, protecting the devices, identities, and applications our team relies on every day.

 - Strengthen workforce identity and access management through Okta and SSO, including phishing-resistant authentication, least privilege, and automated access provisioning and removal.

 - Build and maintain endpoint security controls through mobile device management (MDM) and endpoint detection and response (EDR), improving device configurations, patching, and visibility across our fleet.

 - Establish secure configurations for enterprise applications such as Google Workspace, Claude Cowork, and Codex, with appropriate controls for administrative access, data sharing, and integrations.

 - Write and maintain software, integrations, and automation that enforce security policies, identify configuration gaps, and reduce manual work across identity, device, and application management.



Qualifications

 - Strong software engineering skills and experience building reliable internal tools, API integrations, and automation to solve security or infrastructure problems.

 - Hands-on experience with Okta or similar identity platforms, including SSO, MFA, access policies, and identity lifecycle management; familiarity with SAML, OIDC, and SCIM.

 - Experience securing employee devices through MDM, including configuration enforcement, disk encryption, patch management, and policies that use device security posture to control access.

 - Familiarity with EDR platforms, including deploying and maintaining coverage, investigating endpoint activity, and supporting containment and remediation.

 - Experience securing enterprise SaaS applications and an understanding of the risks introduced by OAuth integrations, excessive permissions, external sharing, and AI tools with access to company data.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex security issues to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Bonus Points For

 - Experience at a high-growth startup or early-stage company

 - Familiarity with security, infrastructure, or developer tooling markets

What We Offer

 - Competitive salary with meaningful equity

 - Health, vision, and dental insurance

 - Office lunch and dinner (SF office)

 - Ownership and significant room to grow as the company scales

jobs.description:
MIDA SA TEED

Osakonnajuhatajana oled juht, kes toetab ja julgustab kogu oma meeskonda. Edendades kaasavat kultuuri, mis edendab koostööd ja ettevõtlikkust, lood keskkonna, kus kõik saavad areneda. Tegutsedes kooskõlas meie väärtustega, aitad kaasa nii enda kui ka ettevõtte edule.

Sinu ülesanded:

• Juhid oma meeskonda silmapaistva kliendikogemuse pakkumiseks, tagades suurepärased tegevus- ja visuaalsed standardid, reklaamides ja müües samal ajal aktiivselt meie tooteid.
• Võtad vastutuse oma poe ja osakonna tugevate külgede eest, analüüsid müügitulemusi, tuvastad kaubandusvõimalusi, sead eesmärke ja koostad plaane tulemuste, kasumi ja laoseisu optimeerimiseks.
• Haldad meeskonna planeerimist, ajakava koostamist ning tagad sujuvad avamis- ja sulgemisrutiinid.
• Värbad, kaasake ja arendad oma meeskonda, edendades samal ajal kaasavat ja koostööl põhinevat kultuuri, mis edendab kasvu ja innovatsiooni.
• Konkurentsieelise säilitamiseks oled kursis moesuundade, klientide eelistuste ja konkurentidega.
• Esindad ennast ja brändi positiivselt kogu kliendisuhtluse ajal.

KELLEGA SA KOOSTÖÖD TEED

Meie kauplused on meie ettevõtte süda, kus kliendid kogevad meie kaubamärki omal nahal. Dünaamilise kaupluse meeskonna osana aitavad kõik rollid – alates müüginõustajatest, osakonnajuhatajatest, poe juhatajatest ja dekoraatoritest kuni kassahalduriteni – inspireeriva ja külalislahke keskkonna loomisele. Samuti saad luua ühenduse laiema piirkonna meeskonnaga, tehes kauplustes koostööd, et jagada teadmisi ja saavutada koos edu. Koos oma meeskonnaga mängid olulist rolli, et aidata klientidel end enesekindlalt tunda ja väljendada oma individuaalsust uusimate trendide ja ajatute stiilidega. Luues oma kauplustes klientidega sisukaid sidemeid, muudame moe kõigile kättesaadavaks ja jätkusuutlikuks.

KES SA OLED​

Otsime inimesi, kellel on…​

• Jaemüügi juhtimise ja tegevuse kogemus.
• Teadmised müügi planeerimisest, analüüsist ja järeltegevusest, kasutades kliendikeskseid tööriistu ja aruandlust.

Ja inimesi, kes on…​

• Tugevad ja enesekindlad juhid, kes inspireerivad, juhendavad ja arendavad oma meeskondi, näidates samal ajal ettevõtte väärtusi ja kultuuri.
• Edukad koostööl põhinevas dünaamilises keskkonnas ja lahendustele keskendunud mõtteviisiga.
• Motiveeritud looma suurepäraseid kliendikogemusi, reklaamides ja müües samal ajal oma tooteid.
• Tugeva huviga moesuundade, kommertslikkuse ja konkurentide teadmiste vastu, et suurendada müüki.
• Tõhusad suhtlejad, loomingulised ja uudishimulikud.
• Paindlikud, analüütilised ja saavutustele orienteeritud, võimelised haldama statistikat ja töötama numbritega.

KES ME OLEME

H&M Group on ülemaailmne ettevõte, mis koosneb tugevatest moebrändidest ja ettevõtmistest. Meie eesmärk on tõestada, et erakordse disaini, taskukohaste hindade ja jätkusuutlike lahenduste vahel pole kompromisse. Tahame vabastada moe paljude jaoks ja meie kliendid on iga meie otsuse keskmes.​

Meid ühendavad tuhanded kirglikud ja andekad kolleegid, keda omakorda ühendab meie ühine kultuur ja väärtused. Üheskoos tahame kasutada oma jõudu, ulatust ja teadmisi, et viia moetööstust kaasavama ja jätkusuutlikuma tuleviku poole. ​

MIKS SULLE MEELDIB SIIN TÖÖTADA ​

H&M Groupis oleme uhked, et oleme elujõuline ja külalislahke ettevõte. Pakume oma töötajatele atraktiivseid hüvesid koos ulatuslike arenguvõimalustega kogu maailmas. ​

• 25% töötajate soodustus kõigilt meie H&M Groupi kaubamärkidelt nii kauplustes kui ka veebis (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories ja ARKET).​
• Mitmed lisasooduskupongid terve aasta vältel
• Paindlik töögraafik
• Tasustatud soovitusprogramm

LIITU MEIEGA

Meie ainulaadsus tuleneb paljude asjade kombinatsioonist – meie kaasavast ja koostöökultuurist, tugevatest väärtustest ja kasvuvõimalustest. Kuid ennekõike on meie inimesed need, kes teevad meist need, kes me oleme.​

Kandideeri, saates oma CV esimesel võimalusel, kuid mitte hiljem kui 22.10.2026. Andmepoliitika tõttu võtame taotlusi vastu ainult karjäärilehe kaudu.

Brutotöötasu 1560Eur / kuus

Astu koos meiega oma karjääris järgmine samm. Teekond algab siit.​

jobs.title: Market Expansion & Clinician Operations Lead (backed by Y Combinator, $5M+ ARR, $23M+ raised)
jobs.description:
🧠 ABOUT LEGION HEALTH

At Legion Health https://legionhealth.com/, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications https://nypost.com/2026/03/27/business/artificial-intelligence-can-now-prescribe-mental-health-drugs/, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.




📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

 - Job Type: Full-Time

 - Role Type: Market Expansion / Clinician Operations / Workforce Planning

 - Ideal Experience Level: 3+ years in healthcare operations or equivalent experience, including multi-market execution

 - Location: Onsite in San Francisco, CA




🚀 THE OPPORTUNITY

Legion is hiring a Market Expansion & Clinician Operations Lead to turn expansion plans into markets that are ready to deliver care, with the right clinician capacity in the right places. You will connect market prioritization, state-entry execution, workforce forecasting, recruiting, onboarding, and capacity deployment into one reliable operating process.

You will partner with Operations, Clinical, Revenue & Network Operations, Provider Partnerships, Finance, Product, and Engineering. Your job is to make dependencies and decision gates explicit, surface risks early, and ensure a launch becomes sustainable clinical capacity rather than a collection of completed checklists.

This is a hands-on operating leadership role. You should be comfortable building a forecast, working a launch's critical path, improving recruiting and onboarding workflows, and turning recurring manual work into measurable, repeatable systems. Clinical decisions remain with clinical leadership; legal, regulatory, and payer approvals remain with the relevant accountable experts.




✅ RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

 - Build market-entry plans that connect demand, payer readiness, clinician supply, launch economics, operating capacity, and cross-functional dependencies.

 - Run launch readiness reviews with clear owners, milestones, evidence, risks, and decision gates; resolve critical-path blockers and escalate tradeoffs early.

 - Coordinate state entry and payer-entry readiness with Revenue & Network Operations and legal, compliance, and clinical partners; track required approvals without substituting for their judgment.

 - Forecast clinician demand and productive capacity by market, specialty, schedule, and expected patient demand; make hiring and deployment recommendations from that forecast.

 - Own the operating process from clinician recruiting through offer acceptance, onboarding, readiness, and productive deployment, in partnership with the recruiting and clinical teams.

 - Improve handoffs across licensing, credentialing, contracting, training, systems access, scheduling, and availability, so clinicians are ready when patients need them.

 - Create clear readiness standards and dashboards for offer-to-ready conversion, time to productive capacity, coverage gaps, and capacity utilization.

 - Partner with Finance and relevant operations owners on accurate clinician compensation administration and reconciliation.

 - Track launch performance through first visit, clean claim, and cash milestones with the teams accountable for each stage.

 - Document repeatable playbooks, improve workflows, and partner with Product and Engineering on automation that removes avoidable coordination work.

 - Build a dependable operating cadence that gives leadership a clear view of market readiness, clinician supply, blocked decisions, and the next action.




🏆 YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU…

 - Launch markets with clear readiness evidence, accountable owners, and fewer avoidable critical-path delays.

 - Match productive clinician capacity to demand while keeping coverage gaps and unused capacity visible.

 - Shorten the path from accepted offer to ready, productive clinician without skipping quality or compliance requirements.

 - Give clinical, commercial, and operations leaders a forecast and status view they trust.

 - Build repeatable processes that improve as Legion grows and reduce the manual effort required for each additional market.




🧰 IDEAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS

And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.
