The good news is we can teach you how to answer the phone and make a perfect pizza. But here are a few skills you should have to be a successful Delivery Driver:

•A clean driving record and the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Record check. Safety is a priority for us and we want to make sure anyone we put on the road is safe to be there. You will also need access to reliable vehicle that is insured and have a valid driver's license.

•Happy customers keep us in business. You've to be a fun and friendly person, who is comfortable talking to strangers.

•The team is what makes working in our store fun. You have to be a team player who is on time every day with a great attitude!

•Our stores are open 363 days a year. Yes, that's right even on the weekends and the holidays; that's when we are busiest! While you're schedule is pretty flexible, you have to be willing to work when the team needs you the most.

•You should have the ability to read a map and find your way around the delivery area. Maybe you will even be able to teach your co-workers some short-cuts!

•You have to be at least 18 years old.

•You must have a minimum of two (2) years driving history.

• Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
• Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
• Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

• To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
• Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

• Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

• Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
• Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
• Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
• Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

• Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

• Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
• Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
• Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
• Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

• Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
• Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
• Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
• Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
• Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
• Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

• Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

All drivers (applicant or employee) must meet these requirements in order to be eligible to drive:

• Must be 18 years or older
• Have a minimum of the last 2 years licensed driving history in the United StatesMust provide documentation of at least 2 years of licensed driving history in the U.S.
• Must have an unsuspended or uninterrupted driving history of at least 1.5 years during the last 2 years. The suspension cannot be at the start of the 2 year period
• No more than 1 violation and 1 at-fault accident associated within the last 2 years
• No more than 2 violations and 1 at-fault accident associated within the last 3 years
• No more than 3 violations in the last 3 years
• No more than 1 at-fault accident in the last 3 years
• Moving citations (i.e. speeding, vehicle safety, etc.) count as violationsSeatbelt citations do not count as violations; andInoperable brake light citations do not count as violations.
• No distracted driving/inattentive driving violations within the last 3 years
• No serious violations allowed in the past 5 years. Some examples include:Drugs/AlcoholLeaving the sceneFailing to report an accidentReckless/careless drivingVehicular homicideHit and runSpeed contestEluding policeMaking a false police reportDriving while suspended/not licensedSpeeding 30 MPH or faster over the posted speed limit

Periodic Delivery Vehicle Inspection

Motor vehicles used for business purposes including, but not limited to, making deliveries, must have the following items inspected under the supervision of franchisees and the managers of stores at the start of employment and thereafter on a periodic basis:

• Headlights
• Turn signals
• Tires

• Taillights/Break lights
• Brake pressure
• Windshield wipers
• Doors
• Backup lights
• Exhaust system
• Horn

Any motor vehicle that does not pass the inspection must not be used to operate a motor vehicle for business purposes including, but not limited to, making deliveries. These inspections are not intended to replace extensive mechanical inspections by a professional and the vehicle operator is responsible for the safe operating condition of his/her vehicle.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.

Surfaces include ceramic tile bricks with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36 and 48.

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.

Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.

Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72 high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.

Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.

Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24 - 30 and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.

Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Additional Job Details

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
Workers reach above 72 occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.
Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.
Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.
Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing walking and climbing duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Intern, Marketing
jobs.description:
About Harbinger

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger’s best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

Job Overview:

• Location: Immerse yourself in our innovative culture! This role requires a commitment of 4 days in-office per week at our facility in Garden Grove, CA as well as full-time hours (40 hours a week).

• Duration: 8 weeks for quarter or 15 weeks for semester (January 11 to April 30 OR January 11 to March 12)

• Relocation Support: A $1,000 relocation stipend is available for interns currently residing more than 50 miles from Garden Grove, CA.

• Compensation: Earn an hourly rate of $25-35 USD per hour.

Job Summary:

Harbinger is building the next generation of medium-duty electric vehicles, and we're in one of the most exciting chapters of our company so far — evolving our brand, expanding into new verticals, and scaling how we show up in the market. We're looking for a Marketing Intern focused on Events to support Harbinger's growing presence at trade shows, ride-and-drives, dealer and fleet events, industry conferences, and other brand experiences. Working closely with the Event Marketing Manager and broader Marketing team, you'll help bring events to life from early planning through on-site execution and post-event follow-up.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role for someone who is an exceptionally strong communicator, highly organized, and comfortable coordinating across many moving pieces. You'll work with teams across Harbinger—including Sales, Engineering, Service, Operations, and Marketing—as well as outside vendors and partners to gather information, coordinate assets, track deliverables, and make sure the details come together.

You'll gain real-world experience executing B2B events for a fast-growing automotive technology company while contributing to programs that directly support Harbinger's brand, customer relationships, dealer network, and sales pipeline.

What You'll Do:

• Event Planning & Execution Support the planning and execution of trade shows, industry conferences, ride-and-drives, vehicle demonstrations, dealer and fleet events, and other Harbinger activations. Maintain event timelines, checklists, action items, and deliverable trackers to keep projects organized and on schedule. Coordinate event materials including signage, booth graphics, brochures, giveaways, apparel, presentations, and other branded assets. • Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination Work cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, Service, Operations, and other teams to gather product information, technical details, vehicles, equipment, and materials needed for events. Communicate event requirements, deadlines, and action items clearly to internal stakeholders and help follow up on outstanding deliverables. Coordinate with agencies, exhibit partners, printers, venues, and other vendors on timelines, revisions, shipments, and asset delivery. Help ensure everyone involved in an event understands key logistics, responsibilities, deadlines, and day-of expectations.

• Content & Asset Coordination Help manage updates to Harbinger’s website, internal resources, and dealer resources. Draft or refine event-related social media copy and content for LinkedIn or internal communications. Support asset version control to ensure consistency across files, templates, and platforms. Collaborate with creative partners or agencies on revisions and asset delivery.

• Event Marketing & Brand Support Support development and review of event-related materials, including signage, presentations, invitations, landing pages, email communications, and sales collateral. Review event assets for consistency with Harbinger's brand standards and help maintain accurate versions across files and platforms. Help prepare internal event briefs, schedules, staffing information, and other communications ahead of events. Support event promotion and communications across email, social media, dealer channels, and other marketing touchpoints.

Required Skills:

• Currently pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Event Management, or a related field.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence communicating across teams, vendors, and external partners.

• Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to keep track of multiple deadlines, deliverables, and moving pieces at once.

• Strong follow-through and a willingness to proactively ask questions, communicate updates, and follow up with stakeholders.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical teams.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

 

Why Numeric

Every business relies on accounting. Yet most software in the space was built in the early 2000s — clunky, slow, and far behind the curve on AI. Today, accountants are facing a growing, unsolved data problem https://numeric.substack.com/p/accountings-data-problem as a consequence of complexity, data, and system fragmentation — and they lack the tools to solve it. The problems are real, hard, and increasingly urgent. But they’re solvable.

Enter Numeric — the modern financial data platform for accounting and finance. Weaving together data, workflows, and AI-first solutions, we’re empowering accounting teams to achieve verifiable, detailed financial data faster and make business decisions with greater confidence.

We have strong product market fit and a growing base of customers who love our product — including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, and many more. We’re backed by top-tier investors including Menlo Ventures, IVP, Founders Fund, and 8VC.

 


ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will help us win mid-market and enterprise accounts by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won. Our emphasis is on supporting your potential ambition to be a pivotal member at a company ready for scale.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the full sales cycle for mid-market and enterprise accounts — from prospecting and pipeline generation through demo, negotiation, and closed-won

 - Run discovery calls and tailored demos that connect Numeric's platform to each prospect's specific accounting and finance challenges

 - Share market intelligence, competitive dynamics, and customer insights back to Product, Marketing, and Leadership

 - Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and crisp, timely follow-up — owning your deals end-to-end with precision

 - Don't take yourself too seriously


MUST-HAVES

 - Experience selling into the Office CFO. Idea ERP, billing and revenue, finance systems or data warehouse applications

 - You have 7-10 years of full-cycle closing experience, selling complex SaaS 

 - You are excited to meaningfully contribute to our sales motion and culture from the ground up


YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You move fast. You leverage tools/technology to maximize your selling time and are comfortable managing a pipeline of a dozen or more opportunities.

 - You skillfully guide prospects through their entire buying process—engaging the right stakeholders at the right time to create consensus.

 - You treat sales as a listening exercise then ask questions with precision. You can explain complex concepts in simple terms.

 -  You share insights about the market, our product, industry trends, etc. back to the company.

 - You obsess over sending crisp follow-up emails, on time, and take pride in your forecast

 


HOW WE WORK

This role is in person in San Francisco or New York (in office by default but with flexibility to manage your schedule as you see fit).

We strongly believe we will only be successful if everyone on the team is anchored in our following set of core principles:

 - Brick by Brick: To win, our team needs to show up and execute in each domain every day.

 - Love the Game: We focus on the craft and a deep sense of giving a f*ck. We’re building a company full of people who are equally engaged and motivated.

 - SALY: We refuse to accept “Same As Last Year.” For too long, accounting and finance systems have reflected outdated processes instead of reimagining what’s possible. We’re driven by a first-principles approach to building better solutions.

 - Own the Outcome: We own our results. We typically hire builders and give them large mandates with high-trust. Engineers are responsible not just for code, but for ensuring the product is solving the end problems of the users.

 - Earn the right: We’re impatient to deliver results. We relentlessly iterate, measure, and improve. Every day is an opportunity to beat our prior best, raising the bar for the value we deliver to customers.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure to

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when removing trash and performing other outside tasks.
In-store temperatures range from 36 degrees in cooler to 90 degrees and above in some work areas.
Sudden changes in temperature in work area and while outside.
Fumes from food odors.
Exposure to cornmeal dust.
Cramped quarters including walk-in cooler.
Hot surfaces/tools from oven up to 500 degrees or higher.
Sharp edges and moving mechanical parts.

SENSING

Talking and hearing on telephone.
Near and mid-range vision for most in-store tasks.
Depth perception.
Ability to differentiate between hot and cold surfaces.

TEMPERAMENTS

The ability to direct activities, perform repetitive tasks, work alone and with others, work under stress, meet strict quality control standards, deal with people, analyze and compile data, make judgments and decisions.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS including, but not limited to the following:

Standing

Most tasks are performed from a standing position.

Walking

For short distances for short durations.
Surfaces include ceramic tile"bricks" with linoleum in some food process areas. Height of work surfaces is between 36" and 48".

Sitting

Paperwork is normally completed in an office at a desk or table.

Lifting

Bulk product deliveries are made twice a week or more and are unloaded by the team member using a hand truck.
Deliveries may include cases of ingredients and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds with dimensions of up to 3' x 1.5'.
Cases are usually lifted from floor and stacked onto shelves up to 72" high.

Carrying

Large cans, weighing 3 pounds, 7 ounces, are carried from the workstation to storage shelves.
Occasionally, pizza sauce weighing 30 pounds is carried from the storage room to the front of the store.
Trays of pizza dough are carried three at a time over short distances, and weigh approximately 12 pounds per tray.

Pushing

To move trays which are placed on dollies. A stack of trays on a dolly is approximately 24"- 30" and requires a force of up to 7.5 pounds to push.
Trays may also be pulled.

Climbing

Team members must infrequently navigate stairs or climb a ladder to change prices on signs, wash walls, perform maintenance.

Stooping/Bending

Forward bending at the waist is necessary at the pizza assembly station.
Toe room is present, but workers are unable to flex their knees while standing at this station.
Duration of this position is approximately 30 - 45 seconds at one time, repeated continuously during the day.
Forward bending is also present at the front counter and when stocking ingredients.

Crouching/Squatting

Performed occasionally to stock shelves and to clean low areas.

Reaching

Reaching is performed continuously; up, down and forward.
Workers reach above 72" occasionally to turn on/off oven controls, change prices on sign, and lift and lower objects to and from shelves.
Workers reaching down to perform such tasks as scooping cornmeal from a plastic barrel, or washing dishes.
Workers reach forward when obtaining topping ingredients, cleaning work surfaces, or answering phones.

Hand Tasks

Eye-hand coordination is essential. Use of hands is continuous during the day.
Frequently activities require use of one or both hands.
Shaping pizza dough requires frequent and forceful use of forearms and wrists.
Workers must manipulate a pizza peel when removing pizza from the oven, and when using the rolling cutter.
Frequent and/or forceful pinching is required in the assembly of cardboard pizza boxes.
Team Members must be able to grasp cans, the phone, the pizza cutter and pizza peel, and pizza boxes.

Machines, Tools, Equipment, Work Aids

Team Members may be required to utilize pencils/pens, computers, telephones, calculators, TDD equipment, pizza cutter and pizza peel.

DRIVING SPECIFIC JOB DUTIES

Deliver product by car and then to door of customer.
Deliver flyers and door hangers.

REQUIRES

Valid driver's license with safe driving record meeting company standards.
Access to an insured vehicle which can be used for delivery.

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

Navigational skills to read a map, locate addresses within designated delivery area.
Must navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings, private homes, and other delivery sites while carrying product.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Carrying

During delivery, carry pizzas and beverages while performing "walking" and "climbing" duties.

Driving

Deliver pizzas within a designated delivery area. A Team Member may make several deliveries per shift.

Walking

Delivery personnel must travel between the store and delivery vehicle and from the delivery vehicle to the customer's location.

Climbing

During delivery of product, navigation of five or more flights of stairs may be required.

WORK CONDITIONS

Exposure To

Varying and sometimes adverse weather conditions when delivering product, driving and couponing.

SENSING

Far vision and night vision for driving.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

 

Why Numeric

Every business relies on accounting. Yet most software in the space was built in the early 2000s — clunky, slow, and far behind the curve on AI. Today, accountants are facing a growing, unsolved data problem https://numeric.substack.com/p/accountings-data-problem as a consequence of complexity, data, and system fragmentation — and they lack the tools to solve it. The problems are real, hard, and increasingly urgent. But they’re solvable.

Enter Numeric — the modern financial data platform for accounting and finance. Weaving together data, workflows, and AI-first solutions, we’re empowering accounting teams to achieve verifiable, detailed financial data faster and make business decisions with greater confidence.

We have strong product market fit and a growing base of customers who love our product — including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, and many more. We’re backed by top-tier investors including Menlo Ventures, IVP, Founders Fund, and 8VC.




ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will help us win Mid-Market accounts by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to closed-won. Our emphasis is on supporting your potential ambition to be a pivotal member at a company ready for scale.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the full sales cycle for mid-market accounts — from prospecting and pipeline generation through demo, negotiation, and closed-won

 - Run discovery calls and tailored demos that connect Numeric's platform to each prospect's specific accounting and finance challenges

 - Share market intelligence, competitive dynamics, and customer insights back to Product, Marketing, and Leadership

 - Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and crisp, timely follow-up — owning your deals end-to-end with precision

 - Don't take yourself too seriously


MUST-HAVES

 - Experience selling into the Office CFO. Idea ERP, billing and revenue, finance systems or data warehouse applications

 - You have 3-5 years of full-cycle closing experience, selling complex SaaS 

 - You are excited to meaningfully contribute to our sales motion and culture from the ground up


YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You move fast. You leverage tools/technology to maximize your selling time and are comfortable managing a pipeline of a dozen or more opportunities.

 - You skillfully guide prospects through their entire buying process—engaging the right stakeholders at the right time to create consensus.

 - You treat sales as a listening exercise then ask questions with precision. You can explain complex concepts in simple terms.

 -  You share insights about the market, our product, industry trends, etc. back to the company.

 - You obsess over sending crisp follow-up emails, on time, and take pride in your forecast




HOW WE WORK

This role is in person in San Francisco or New York (in office by default but with flexibility to manage your schedule as you see fit).

We strongly believe we will only be successful if everyone on the team is anchored in our following set of core principles:

 - Brick by Brick: To win, our team needs to show up and execute in each domain every day.

 - Love the Game: We focus on the craft and a deep sense of giving a f*ck. We’re building a company full of people who are equally engaged and motivated.

 - SALY: We refuse to accept “Same As Last Year.” For too long, accounting and finance systems have reflected outdated processes instead of reimagining what’s possible. We’re driven by a first-principles approach to building better solutions.

 - Own the Outcome: We own our results. We typically hire builders and give them large mandates with high-trust. Engineers are responsible not just for code, but for ensuring the product is solving the end problems of the users.

 - Earn the right: We’re impatient to deliver results. We relentlessly iterate, measure, and improve. Every day is an opportunity to beat our prior best, raising the bar for the value we deliver to customers.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB

You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and make sure everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you've always done it. Well maybe it is time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Now's your chance - Domino's is hiring bosses - more specifically assistant managers. It's a tough job...one that needs a natural like you. Of course, you will also need some skills - judgment, math, the ability to multi-task.

You'll be working for a company that is fun and flexible. And also, it's work experience you're going to use for a long time to come. You've had our pizza. Now help us make it even better. Apply now!

JOB REQUIREMENTS

You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. This includes all cost controls, inventory control, cash control, product quality, maintenance of perfect image (among team members and throughout store), customer relations, and service times.

You must lead by example by following ALL policies and procedures 100% of the time and expect the same from your team.

Possess navigational skills to read a map and locate addresses within designated delivery area

Able to navigate adverse terrain including multi-story buildings

Ability to drive in adverse weather conditions including rain, sleet, snow, high winds, and hail.

Have a positive and helpful attitude

Willing to conform to all image and uniform standards of Domino's Pizza

Ability to work alone and with others

Desire to meet high quality control standards, even in fast-paced circumstances

JOB DUTIES INCLUDE:

All duties assigned to CSRs and Delivery Experts

Train team members

Maintain appropriate staffing levels during your shift

Manage inventory

Control cash

Complete all required and requested reports

Additional tasks as requested by General Manager and above-store leadership

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/SKILLS

Ability to add, subtract, muliply, and divide accurately and quickly (may use calculator)

Ability to make correct monetary change

Ability to enter orders using a computer keyboard and touch screen

Strong hand/eye coordination

Ability to receive instruction and complete tasks within a specified period of time

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Many tasks are performed from a standing position and team members are expected to remain in this position for extended periods of time.

Delivery experts are expected to walk briskly or run when safe to do so between the store and delivery vehicle and between the delivery vehicle and the customer's location location

jobs.title: SEO Strategist
jobs.description:
Digible Company Overview

Privately owned and operated, Digible was founded in 2017 with a mission to bring sophisticated digital marketing solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a comprehensive suite of digital services as well as a predictive analytics platform, Fiona, that is the first of its kind.

At Digible, Inc. we love to celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees – and it shows. We pride ourselves on our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. These values are pervasive throughout every step of a Digible employee's journey. Starting with our interviews and continuing through our weekly All Hands Transparency Round-up, values are at the heart of working at Digible.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career could look like here at Digible.

Digible Core Values:

• Authenticity - The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.

• Curiosity - The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.

• Focus - The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.

• Humility - The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".

• Happiness - The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role:

Digible, Inc. is looking for an SEO Strategist to join our team!

The SEO Strategist is a hands-on SEO practitioner and performance owner within Digible’s SEO practice. You manage a portfolio of local SEO campaigns across multifamily, student, senior, and single-family rental properties, applying professional judgment across technical, on-site, and off-site SEO. You directly execute when diagnosis, risk, ambiguity, or continuity materially benefits from Strategist expertise while leveraging SEO Coordinators for standardized implementation, recurring audits, listings, citations, data pulls, and other repeatable execution.

You'll love this job if:

• Take real satisfaction in making a measurable impact across a portfolio of accounts

• Are process-oriented and find genuine pleasure in improving how things work

• Learn quickly and proactively seek out knowledge from senior teammates

• Are passionate about SEO and hungry to go deeper on the technical side

• Take pride in accuracy, consistency, and never missing a deadline

• Thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where the work is always evolving

• Naturally think “we” instead of “I”

What you'll do:

SEO campaign execution:

• Manage a portfolio of up to 108 accounts, owning SEO performance and directly executing technical, local, and content work when professional judgment is required, while leveraging Coordinators for standardized implementation.

• Diagnose and prioritize on-site and off-site optimizations that drive organic visibility and keyword rankings; directly implement complex or nonstandard changes and delegate repeatable implementation where appropriate.

• Conduct website audits, determine the appropriate technical SEO recommendations, and implement or direct implementation based on complexity, risk, and whether continuity from diagnosis materially benefits the outcome.

• Own the strategic use and health of Google Business Profile, Google Tag Manager, and Google Search Console across assigned accounts while leveraging Coordinators for standardized maintenance and updates.

• Drive organic traffic and rankings through proven SEO fundamentals

• Flag accounts with declining visibility or technical health trends before they become a client-facing issue

Analysis & reporting:

• Analyze campaign performance and ROI and own the client-facing interpretation and recommendations, using standardized reporting support from Coordinators where available.

• Identify keyword visibility trends and translate findings into actionable next steps

• Support reporting improvements and contribute to internal documentation efforts

Collaboration & process:

• Partner with Senior SEO Strategists for advanced troubleshooting, testing, and strategic guidance

• Escalate strategic tradeoffs and technical risks with clear recommendations, not just problems

• Follow internal standards consistently, maintain documentation for Strategist-owned judgment workflows, and partner with Coordinators to keep execution procedures current as platforms and tools evolve.

• Work cross-functionally to deliver exceptional client and employee experiences

How success will be measured:

• Accounts per FTE: up to 108

Strategic Planning, Optimization, Scheduling, and Delegation for all accounts by the 5th Digible business day

• SVT Opportunity Recommendations: 1 per month

• SLA Adherence: ≥95%

• Support Annual Tests on 2-4 PMCs

• Campaign Optimization Completion: 100% within monthly cycle

• Thought Leadership Contributions: 2 per year

• Client Performance Growth: Organic visibility +10% YoY

You should have:

• 2–4 years of concentrated SEO experience

• Experience implementing local SEO campaigns across multiple markets

• Proficiency with on-site and off-site SEO strategies

• Working knowledge of Google Business Profile, GTM, and Google Search Console

• Experience conducting website audits and implementing technical SEO recommendations

• Google Analytics Certification

• Strong copywriting and research skills

• Familiarity with emerging AI integrations in SEO

• Strong communication skills, initiative, and high attention to detail

• Multifamily, student housing, or senior living experience is a plus

Pay, Perks and Such:

• Annual Salary of $70,000-$87,000

• 4-Day Work Week (32-hour work week)

• WFA (Work From Anywhere)

• Profit Sharing Bonus

• 3 weeks PTO plus Sick Leave and Bereavement

• 13 Paid Holidays

• 401(k) + 5% employer match

• 75% employer-paid Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• $75/month Physical Wellness reimbursement

• $75/month Mental Wellness reimbursement

• $1,000 annual travel fund after 3 years

• Dog-Friendly Office

• Paid Parental Leave

• Company Sponsored Social Events

• Weekly lunches and snacks for in-office employees.

HEADS UP! We believe in transparency throughout our hiring process. To help us ensure a great fit, we'll ask you to share a few professional references during the hiring process who can speak to your experience and skills. It’s all part of our commitment to open, honest communication and our core values: Focus, Authenticity, Humility, Curiosity, and Happiness.

jobs.title: Reliability Test Intern (Winter 2027)
jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity’s reach into the solar system. Today, Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe— large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military. With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts.

Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization. Astranis has raised over $750 million from some of the world’s best investors, from Andreessen Horowitz to Blackrock and Fidelity, and employs a team of 450 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

Reliability Test Intern (Winter 2027)

Internships at Astranis typically last for twelve weeks, and are hourly roles designed for students who are currently enrolled at a four-year university.

As an Intern, you will have an amazing opportunity to work on hard problems — we pride ourselves on giving everyone at Astranis a chance to do meaningful work on complex projects, no matter their seniority. Many past interns have designed and tested hardware/software that is heading to space on our first satellite, and many of them are now full-time employees at Astranis.

If you have already graduated from a four-year university, please apply to be an Associate Engineer.

Role

• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to plan reliability tests for satellite hardware

• Support test plan and procedure development based on design specifications and mission profiles

• Set up, operate, and monitor environmental test equipment, including thermal chambers, thermal vacuum systems, vibration shaker tables, and combined thermal vibe chambers

• Execute reliability tests such as thermal cycling, thermal vacuum, and vibration

• Collect, analyze, and document test data to identify potential failure modes and ensure hardware meets reliability targets

• Design test fixtures, setup instrumentation and data acquisition systems

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field

• Strong interest in hardware reliability, testing, and hands-on engineering work in a fast-paced environment

• Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and adapt to changing project needs

• Strong communication skills

• Must be onsite 5 days per week

Bonus

• Hands-on experience with environmental or reliability testing

• Familiarity with test equipment such as test chambers and DAQs

• Experience with data analysis tools in Python, MATLAB, or similar

• Exposure to hardware design, integration, or lab-based engineering projects

• Understanding of failure analysis, root cause investigation, or reliability engineering principles

• Previous internship, research, or project experience in aerospace or hardware-focused environments

The base pay for this position is $29.00 per hour.

Base Hourly Pay

$29—$29 USD

U.S. Citizenship, Lawful Permanent Residency, or Refugee/Asylee Status Required

(To comply with U.S. Government space technology export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the United States, or other protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3))

Our mission and products are built for everyone, regardless of gender, race, creed, or background. We believe in a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we invite all people to join our team and bring their unique perspectives to make us stronger.

SMS Terms of Service

1. When you opt in to receive SMS messages from Astranis Space Technologies Corp., we may send you messages related to your job application, including updates, interview coordination, and other recruiting communications.
2. You can cancel the SMS service at any time by replying with any of the following industry standard keywords:

a. STOP
b. STOPALL
c. OPTOUT

f. QUIT

jobs.description:
Overview:
You were born to be the boss. We know. You get up in the morning and you make sure everyone else in the house is doing what they need to do. Then you go to work and you make sure that everyone there is doing what they need to do, even your boss. You just do that because you have always done it. Well maybe it's time you moved up. You want to be the boss? Well now's your chance, Domino's Pizza is hiring bosses - more specifically Assistant Managers. It's a tough job, one that needs a natural like you. jobs.title: Founding Procurement Lead, Customer Outcomes
jobs.description:
FOUNDING PROCUREMENT LEAD, CUSTOMER OUTCOMES

San Francisco Bay Area | Full-time | In person


BUILD THE FUTURE OF PROCUREMENT WITH US

Aron is building an AI chief of staff for procurement.

Procurement teams are responsible for enormous amounts of spend, but much of the work that could create value never gets done. Categories go years without being competitively sourced. Supplier negotiations get deferred. Savings opportunities sit buried across invoices, contracts, emails, and ERP systems.

We’re building Aron to change that.

Aron works alongside procurement teams to understand their spend, identify opportunities, run sourcing work, engage suppliers, and turn fragmented information into commercial decisions.

We’re backed by Menlo Ventures and Storm Ventures and work with customers ranging from mid-market manufacturers to some of the world’s largest enterprises.

We’re looking for an exceptional procurement operator to join the founding team.




YOUR MANDATE

Make Aron indispensable to our customers, then help us turn what you learn into product.

This is not a traditional Customer Success role.

You will own some of Aron’s most important customer relationships and the procurement work happening inside them.

You’ll sit directly between our customers and our engineering team.

When Aron works, you’ll push it further.

When Aron gets something wrong, you’ll understand why.

When the product cannot complete the work yet, you’ll get the job done, then work with engineering so a human doesn’t need to do it the next time.

You’ll have significant influence over what we build.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN




CUSTOMER OUTCOMES

You’ll become a trusted partner to procurement leaders at major industrial companies.

You will:

 - Own customer implementations and ongoing success

 - Understand each customer’s spend, suppliers, categories, constraints, and procurement priorities

 - Identify the highest-value work Aron should take on

 - Drive opportunities from raw data through sourcing and commercial decision

 - Build credibility with CPOs, category managers, finance leaders, and plant-level stakeholders

 - Track value rigorously from identified opportunity through realized savings

 - Identify opportunities to expand Aron’s role inside each customer

Your customers should view you as an extension of their procurement organization, not their software vendor.




PROCUREMENT EXECUTION

You’ll do real procurement work.

That can mean:

 - Diving into millions of dollars of messy spend

 - Determining whether two seemingly identical parts are actually comparable

 - Building and launching an RFQ

 - Finding additional suppliers

 - Challenging an incumbent’s pricing

 - Calling or emailing a supplier to get a bid moving

 - Normalizing quotes with different units, specifications, freight, payment terms, and MOQs

 - Running another negotiation round

 - Evaluating commercial and supply-risk tradeoffs

 - Preparing an award recommendation

 - Determining whether negotiated savings actually reached the P&L

You should be able to look at a sourcing recommendation and know when something doesn’t smell right.




PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT



You’ll have a front-row seat to where AI succeeds and fails in real procurement work.

We expect you to turn that into product.

You’ll work directly with our engineers to:

 - Identify where Aron requires human intervention

 - Reproduce and diagnose workflow failures

 - Define what an excellent procurement outcome should look like

 - QA AI-generated recommendations

 - Translate recurring customer problems into product requirements

 - Help determine what Aron should automate next

 - Design workflows that work across customers rather than for a single account

 - Help Aron capture the context and commercial judgment that should matter the next time it performs the work

One of the most important questions you’ll ask is:

“Why did I have to do this manually, and how do we make sure I never have to do it again?”


WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You’ve spent roughly 5-10+ years in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, or procurement transformation and have been exceptionally good at it.

You’ve personally owned meaningful spend.

You’ve run competitive sourcing events.

You’ve negotiated with suppliers.

You’ve had to defend a sourcing recommendation to senior leadership.

You’ve dealt with terrible ERP data, incomplete specifications, difficult stakeholders, incumbent suppliers, and savings targets that still had to be delivered.

Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments is particularly valuable.

You might come from companies such as Apple, Tesla, Amazon, Applied Materials, Honeywell, Danaher, Rockwell Automation, Flex, Jabil, or another world-class procurement organization.

But pedigree alone doesn’t matter.

We care much more about whether you are an exceptional operator.


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

You are the person people give the difficult category to.

You can go from a CPO conversation to a 20,000-line spreadsheet without losing energy.

You are commercially aggressive without being reckless.

You notice when a quote is using the wrong unit before anyone else does.

You don’t accept “the data is bad” as the end of an analysis.

You can build trust with a supplier without becoming afraid to negotiate with them.

You communicate complicated commercial decisions simply.

You are extremely detail-oriented but know when 80% is enough to move forward.

You don’t need a playbook for every situation.

You have high standards and low ego.

You are curious about technology and want to understand what AI can genuinely do rather than simply talk about it.

Most importantly, you take ownership.

When something isn’t working, your first instinct is to figure out how to fix it.




THIS ROLE PROBABLY ISN’T FOR YOU IF

You want a traditional Customer Success job.

You primarily want to manage relationships rather than own outcomes.

You want engineering to figure out the product while you relay customer requests.

You haven’t personally run sourcing or negotiation work.

You need clean data before you can make progress.

You prefer clearly defined responsibilities and mature processes.

You want to join a company where everything has already been figured out.

It hasn’t.




YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS

By the end of your first three months:

 - You independently own several important customer relationships

 - Those customers trust your procurement judgment

 - You can take a sourcing opportunity through an approval-ready recommendation without the founder

 - You have personally identified product failures and helped engineering eliminate them

 - You can explain exactly where humans are still required in Aron’s workflows and why

 - Customer implementations are getting faster

 - We are measuring customer value more rigorously

 - The founder is no longer required to personally rescue day-to-day procurement work




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We’re not looking for someone to operate Customer Success as it exists today.



We’re looking for someone to help invent what Customer Success looks like when the software itself is becoming part of the procurement team.

Today, you may perform part of the work yourself.

Tomorrow, Aron should perform it.

Your job is to make that transition happen without compromising the quality of the outcome.

If you’ve spent years becoming exceptional at procurement and want to use that experience to help build the product that changes how the function operates, we’d like to meet you.

jobs.title: Especialista en Gestión Integral de Riesgo y Agua, Saneamiento e Higiene con Enfoque en Niñez
jobs.description:
DATOS GENERALES

Zonas de Intervención:

Comayagua, La Paz, Francisco Morazán, Valle, Choluteca, Intibucá, El Paraiso y Lempira

Sede de oficina: Tegucigalpa

Mes de inicio

Octubre

Plazas Disponibles

2 vacantes

Reportará a

Gerente de Proyecto

Unidad a la que pertenecerá

Programas

DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL DEL PROGRAMA:

Honduras ha sido uno de los tres países con Índice de Riesgo Climático más alto a nivel global durante las dos últimas décadas[1]. Según el Índice para Gestión del Riesgo (INFORM), 144 municipalidades (48.3%) presentan un nivel alto o muy alto de riesgo. Un 31.8% de la población habita en áreas expuestas al riesgo de desastres naturales, mientras que el 33.2% del PIB es vulnerable a este tipo de desastres. En el marco del proyecto Establecimientos de Espacios Seguros de aprendizaje: Planes de Seguridad Escolar en el marco de Servicios de ASH resiliente al clima en Centros educativos con enfoque de género, se están apoyando a 376 centros de educación básica a nivel de 9 departamentos en Honduras.

De acuerdo con las necesidades y brechas identificadas a nivel de centro educativo seleccionados, el proyecto se centrará en el seguimiento de procesos de capacitación realizadas en el año 1 del proyecto y seguimiento en la actualización participativa del Plan de Seguridad Escolar e implementación de una actividad del Plan según criterios definidos (acciones comunitarias que apunten hacia el cumplimiento de requisitos de certificación del Programa de Escuelas Verdes y Seguras de SEDUC) total en 54 centros educativos, directamente en la zona de intervención del proyecto.

El escenario de múltiples emergencias por el que Honduras paso en 2020, con fuertes impactos adversos debido al COVID-19 y las tormentas tropicales ETA / IOTA, indican la necesidad de fortalecer el acceso seguro a servicios ASH en centros educativos, apoyando el cambio en actitudes, comportamientos y practicas sobre la gestión del agua para uso humano, considerando un entorno de inseguridad hídrica (escasez, contaminación, falta de acceso en el predio, etc.) Las actividades propuestas se alinean con la estrategia de Centros Educativos Verdes y Seguros de SEDUC, y con las Normas Mínimas para la Educación de la Red Interagencial para Educación en Emergencias en el ámbito ‘Protección y bienestar’ (Nota No. 11 sobre Reducción y gestión de Riesgos y Desastres, y Nota No. 6 sobre Agua Potable e Higiene), dirigidas a fortalecer las capacidades de escuelas y comunidades para promover el acceso a servicios de ASH resiliente al clima y con enfoque de género. Las actividades se implementarán en Centros educativos donde se capacito a un docente por centro educativo (en temas de GIR, CC, WASH y MHM) centro de red de docentes durante 2020, con el objetivo de diseminar el conocimiento entre un grupo mayor de docentes del mismo centro educativo y en otros centros educativos a través de las redes de docentes, padres de familia y estudiantes de manera semipresencial, siguiendo protocolos de bioseguridad.

OBJETIVO DE LA POSICIÓN:

Fortalecer la gestión integral del riesgo ante la sequía y la resiliencia climática mediante procesos de formación y coordinación en 102 municipios, incorporando el enfoque WASH en los planes de emergencia municipal y de seguridad del agua, así como la actualización del manual metodológico integrado para centros educativos.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES:

• Coordinación y fortalecimiento institucional en temas de Gestión de Riesgo con integración de criterios sensibles a la niñez.

• Realizar un diagnóstico de capacidades de las oficinas regionales de COPECO para identificar necesidades de fortalecimiento en la actualización de los Planes de Emergencia Municipal (PEM), con énfasis en protección y atención de la niñez.

• Desarrollar jornadas de capacitación y asistencia técnica dirigidas al personal de las oficinas regionales de COPECO y actores municipales.

• Elaborar y/o adaptar herramientas técnicas y lineamientos para facilitar la incorporación de criterios de protección y atención de la niñez en los PEM.

• Brindar acompañamiento técnico a las oficinas regionales de COPECO para la revisión y actualización de los PEM de municipios priorizados.

• Facilitar talleres participativos municipales con COPECO, alcaldías, CODEM, instituciones de protección, salud, educación, organizaciones comunitarias y otros actores relevantes para revisar riesgos, capacidades y mecanismos de respuesta.

• Revisar y validar técnicamente los PEM actualizados, asegurando que incorporen los criterios mínimos de protección y atención de la niñez.

• Socializar los PEM actualizados con las instituciones y actores responsables de la respuesta municipal, definiendo roles y responsabilidades.

• Coordinación y fortalecimiento institucional en temas de WASH con enfoque en sequía.

• Realizar un diagnóstico de capacidades y necesidades de los actores municipales y comunitarios vinculados a la gestión del agua en los municipios priorizados.

• Identificar y mapear actores clave del sector WASH a nivel nacional, regional y municipal, definiendo roles y mecanismos de coordinación para el acompañamiento de los PSA.

• Coordinar con las entidades gubernamentales competentes del sector WASH la definición de lineamientos, herramientas y criterios técnicos para la elaboración e implementación de los PSA.

• Desarrollar jornadas de capacitación y asistencia técnica dirigidas a municipalidades, prestadores de servicios de agua, juntas administradoras de agua y otros actores clave sobre Planes de Seguridad del Agua con resiliencia climática.

• Facilitar procesos participativos para la elaboración y/o actualización de los PSA en los municipios, involucrando a municipalidades, prestadores de servicios, comunidades y entidades gubernamentales.

• Gestión y articulación con autoridades clave.

• Establecer y/o fortalecer mecanismos de coordinación interinstitucional entre COPECO, CODEM, municipalidades, SEDUC-DECOAS, SANAA, CONASA, AMHON y otros actores vinculados a la gestión del riesgo, WASH y SAN.

• Desarrollar reuniones y mesas técnicas interinstitucionales para analizar escenarios de sequía, compartir información, definir prioridades y acordar acciones de preparación y respuesta.

• Actualización del Manual integrado de GIR.

• Revisión y análisis del manual vigente, identificando contenidos desactualizados, vacíos técnicos, duplicidades y aspectos que requieren fortalecimiento.

• Revisión del marco normativo e institucional vigente relacionado con gestión integral del riesgo, cambio climático, educación, protección de la niñez, WASH y respuesta ante emergencias.

• Levantamiento de necesidades y consulta con actores clave de la Secretaría de Educación, COPECO, SEDUC-DECOAS, municipalidades, CODEM, docentes y otros actores vinculados.

• Identificación y actualización de amenazas y escenarios de riesgo que pueden afectar al sector educativo, incluyendo sequía, inundaciones, deslizamientos, sismos, incendios, epidemias y otros eventos relevantes.

• Incorporación del enfoque de resiliencia climática en los procesos de prevención, preparación, respuesta y recuperación del sector educativo.

• Otras funciones que deberá atender:

• Ejecutar el plan de trabajo territorial definido.

• Dar seguimiento permanente a los municipios asignados.

• Coordinar con técnicos municipales, UMAs, CODEM y otras instituciones.

• Gestionar los aspectos logísticos y administrativos necesarios para el desarrollo de actividades territoriales.

• Participar activamente en las reuniones de planificación del proyecto.

• Seguimiento y supervisión del personal técnico a la implementación planes de emergencia municipal.

• Revisión de los planes de emergencia y PSA-RC para garantizar la calidad del documento. reportes periódicos sobre funcionamiento de estaciones y equipos de monitoreo.

• Base de datos actualizada de los PSA-RC y PEM.

• Medios de verificación organizados y disponibles conforme a los estándares institucionales.

• Otras funciones que le sean asignadas por el Gerente del Proyecto, en el marco de los objetivos y necesidades del programa.

PERFIL MÍNIMO REQUERIDO

Estudios Profesionales:

Profesional universitario en una de las siguientes disciplinas: Ingeniería civil, forestal o ambiental; Licenciatura en Pedagogía, Gestión del Riesgo u otras carreras afines relacionadas con la adaptación al cambio climático, la gestión de riesgos o el desarrollo territorial.

Experiencia Profesional:

• Mínimo cinco (5) años de experiencia en gestión integral del riesgo de desastres a nivel municipal y en el ámbito educativo.

• Mínimo cinco (5) años de experiencia en WASH, con enfoque en resiliencia climática y protección de la niñez.

• Coordinación interinstitucional: Experiencia en comunicación, coordinación y relacionamiento con actores municipales, regionales y nacionales para facilitar la articulación, implementación y escalamiento de acciones.

• Trabajo territorial: Experiencia en trabajo con municipalidades y organizaciones locales.

• Experiencia facilitando procesos de formación y asistencia técnica.

Conocimientos

• Amplia experiencia en la elaboración de planes de emergencia integrando criterios de protección infantil.

• Conocimiento en metodologías educativas y planes de emergencia a nivel municipal.

• Capacidad de expresión y facilidad para trabajar con comunidades, con especial atención en la niñez.

• Articulación con actores del sistema de GIR — Conocimiento para colaborar con actores claves como AMHON, Secretaría de Educación, SANAA y CONASA.

Competencias:

• Habilidad para establecer relaciones de coordinación con instituciones públicas y organizaciones locales.

• Capacidad para organizar, registrar y sistematizar información de campo.

• Orientación a resultados y capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en territorio.

• Disponibilidad para movilizarse y viajar dentro del país, incluyendo desplazamientos constantes entre los municipios de intervención.

• Dominio de herramientas como Excel, Word y PowerPoint.

• Conducción 4x4: Experiencia en conducción de vehículos 4x4 en terrenos de difícil acceso, con licencia vigente.

• Responsabilidad y respeto: Competencias actitudinales esenciales para el trabajo comunitario.

jobs.title: Legal, Partnerships & Strategic Transactions
jobs.description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.



THE ROLE

We are hiring a senior attorney to lead the legal work behind Baseten's partnerships and strategic transactions. This is the seat where model labs, hyperscalers, distribution platforms, and our largest customers meet, and where the licenses that govern open weight models get read, negotiated, and turned into commitments we can stand behind. Reports to the Chief Legal Officer, works directly with the founders and partnerships leads, and shares the deal surface with the rest of the legal team.

Not every partnership is about revenue. Some are about awareness and being the place a lab launches. Some are about compute, capacity, and maintaining optionality. Some are about market share and developer adoption, and some are about not being locked out of a channel a competitor is building. This role has to see which game each deal is playing, structure for that, and know when a relationship that looks strategic is really a dependency. The paper is the output. The judgment is the job.

THE QUESTIONS YOU WILL WORK ON

Four questions run through nearly everything this seat touches.

Open weight licenses are becoming a market of their own

The permissive licenses that built open source software are giving way to model licenses with usage thresholds, attribution triggers, certified partner exemptions, geographic carve outs, and commercial only distribution terms, many written by labs outside the United States. Each release is a new instrument. You will read them first and help the market read them right.

Rights follow the license, responsibility follows role

The same model can be a shared API, a dedicated deployment, a customer supplied checkpoint, or a fine tune, and who holds what right changes with each. Whether Baseten is licensee, host, distributor, or acting on a customer's behalf determines what we can promise, what we can indemnify, and what no one in this market can honestly underwrite. Getting that allocation right, and explaining it plainly to a customer's outside counsel, is the core craft.

Partners who are also channels, customers, and competitors

A lab can be supplier, customer, and rival for the same workload. A hyperscaler can be our compute vendor, our distribution channel, and our competitor in one quarter. You will structure for channel conflict, exclusivity, and information flow so Baseten stays independent and customer centric.

Cross border by default

Labs, compute providers, and customers sit in different jurisdictions with different rules on export controls, sanctions, data residency, and what a license permits. Partnership paper and compliance posture have to move together, and you will work with our regulatory and policy leads to make sure they do.

WHY THIS MATTERS TO BASETEN

Our model catalog, distribution relationships, and partner channels are a large part of why customers choose us and why labs launch with us. A license question that stalls a dedicated capacity deal, a distribution term that limits how we serve a customer, or a partnership that creates a conflict we did not see coming has direct revenue and strategic consequences. This role exists to get ahead of those questions and to make Baseten the counterparty labs, platforms, and enterprises trust to get the model layer right.

RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead the legal workstream for model lab relationships: distribution agreements, hosted API and early access arrangements, token and capacity commitments, coalition and joint development agreements, and renegotiations as models and licenses evolve.

 - Lead strategic platform and channel deals: hyperscaler marketplace and gateway agreements, white label and reseller structures, co-sell and referral arrangements, and enterprise partnerships that combine a customer relationship with a distribution one.

 - Build and own Baseten's framework for open weight and custom model licenses: how we read them, how they apply across shared, dedicated, customer supplied, and fine-tuned deployments, what we confirm to customers before deployment, and where our indemnities begin and end.

 - Serve as the legal voice on model licensing questions in customer deals, including direct engagement with customer counsel on license interpretation, attribution and threshold mechanics, and the allocation of responsibility between Baseten, the lab, and the customer.

 - Advise leadership on channel strategy, conflict, and competition: exclusivity, most favored terms, information flow to partners who compete with us, and the structural protections that keep Baseten independent and customer centric.

 - Partner with our regulatory, policy, and security leads on the cross-border dimensions of partnership paper, including export controls, sanctions, KYC, and data residency, so that compliance posture and commercial terms move together.

 - Build the templates, playbooks, and per release licensing statements that let the business self-serve on standard arrangements and escalate the novel ones, and keep them current as the market changes.

 - Support M&A, acquihires, and other strategic or one-off transactions as needed, including diligence on inherited licenses and partner agreements.

 - Help build the partnerships legal function as it grows, and contribute across whatever the team needs.

WHAT WE VALUE

 - Reads the license. You start with the text the grant actually uses, not with what everyone assumes it says, and you can explain what it means to an engineer, a CFO, and a lab's general counsel in the same afternoon.

 - A point of view. You take a position, defend it, and change it when the facts change. We are not hiring someone to summarize both sides.

 - Structural thinking. You see how a distribution term today shapes a customer negotiation next year, and you design for the second order effects.

 - Technical fluency. You can hold your own on inference, model weights, fine tuning, multi tenancy, and dedicated versus shared deployments, and you know why the distinction matters for rights and responsibility.

 - Commercial grounding. Partnership legal work serves the business. You know which terms to hold, which to trade, and how to say so without slowing the deal down.

 - Builder mentality. You operate independently, build from scratch, and have low ego. You are as comfortable drafting a per release licensing statement as you are negotiating with a hyperscaler.

REQUIREMENTS

 - JD and active bar membership in good standing.

 - 8+ years of technology transactions or partnerships experience, with meaningful in-house time leading partnership, licensing, or platform deals at an AI, cloud, or developer infrastructure company.

 - Deep familiarity with open source and open weight model licenses, including the newer custom licenses from frontier and international labs, and the ability to interpret them across deployment models.

 - Experience structuring strategic partnerships with counterparties who are also customers or competitors, including channel, reseller, marketplace, and co sell arrangements.

 - Direct experience allocating IP and indemnity risk in AI or platform agreements and explaining that allocation to sophisticated counterparties.

 - Clear, direct communicator who can translate license text and deal structure for founders, partnerships leads, and customer counsel.

 - The ability to learn, build, and master AI tooling and systems to self-serve and operate at breakneck speed.

 - A desire to become a recognized thought leader in your field.

YOU MIGHT EXCEL IF YOU

 - Have led AI partnerships or model licensing legal work at a frontier lab, hyperscaler, or AI platform company.

 - Have negotiated with or on behalf of model labs and understand how they think about distribution, attribution, and downstream use.

 - Have worked on marketplace, gateway, or ecosystem agreements and understand the economics of being a channel.

 - Have handled cross border licensing or distribution with labs or partners outside the United States.

 - Have built a licensing framework or playbook from scratch at a company that was growing faster than its paper.

 - Have a considered view on where the open weight ecosystem is going and what it means for the companies that host it.



BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

 - (U.S. only) 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents

 - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!)

 - Paid parental leave

 - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot

 - (U.S. only) Company-facilitated 401(k)

 - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities.

Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you.

At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh. 


ABOUT ABRIDGE

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.




THE ROLE

Abridge is expanding beyond physicians and into broader care team workflows, and Nursing is one of Abridge’s most important new product areas. Nurses carry a large share of documentation and care coordination, especially in inpatient and ED settings. Their workflows involve frequent handoffs, fragmented data, and significant administrative load.

As PM Lead for Nursing, you will own the nursing journey end to end. You will lead discovery with nurses and nursing leaders, set product strategy, and work closely with engineering, design, clinical science, machine learning, and customer teams to build experiences that nurses return to throughout their shifts. The opportunity is to combine conversations, longitudinal chart context, and explicit nurse direction to help nurses understand their patients, document efficiently, coordinate care, and get work done.

You will shape the end-to-end Nursing experience across Abridge surfaces and EHR integrations and partner closely with clinical experts, engineering, design, and health system leaders. 

This is a hybrid role, with a preference for this PM to be based out of NYC, but open to SF. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead Nursing product strategy and discovery. Define the product vision and roadmap for Nursing across inpatient, ED, and ambulatory use cases. Identify and prioritize workflows that create real time time savings, operational ROI, and measurable impact for health systems.

 - Deliver clinician love for a new user type. Conduct deep user research with nurses, nurse managers, and CNIOs to understand documentation patterns, care coordination gaps, and device-specific workflows. Test hypotheses quickly and iterate based on adoption, retention, and perceived time savings.

 - Deliver high quality Nursing workflows. Partner with engineering and design to build intuitive and reliable documentation and handoff experiences across mobile, desktop, and EHR surfaces. Support workflows like many-to-one documentation, team-based notes, carry-forward, and handoff summaries.

 - Integrate deeply with EHR and enterprise environments. Work across Epic, Cerner, and Meditech workflows to ensure we meet table stakes expectations and can scale nursing adoption inside large hospital systems. Ensure data and context flows align with our broader strategy of leveraging clinical context to create defensible value.

 - Define success and measure impact. Establish KPIs such as time saved per shift, documentation completeness, task throughput, and workflow adoption. Build a clear path to monetization and demonstrate early value through design partners and beta deployments.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 5+ years of product management experience with 0 to 1 ownership in a complex domain.

 - Strong ability to understand and design for highly variable workflows across settings and roles.

 - Experience partnering closely with engineering, design, and ML teams

 - Ability to translate strategic goals into clear product decisions, sequencing, and measurable outcomes.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where little exists.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, especially with clinical audiences.


BONUS POINTS IF…

 - Experience working with clinical SMEs, and health system stakeholders.

 - You have worked directly with nursing, inpatient, or ED operational workflows.

 - You have experience with Electronic Health Records like Epic, Cerner, Meditech.

 - You have built productivity tools, workflow automation, or ambient intelligence products.

 - You have worked in health systems, health IT, or clinical operations roles.

 - You have hands-on experience shipping products that deliver measurable operational or financial ROI in healthcare.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - We are looking for a candidate who is a “consumer / user PM” with a B2B background
   
   - Reference: Peter Deng’s five types of PMs (link https://lennysvault.com/insights/strategic-thinking/d580c3e3-0970-4634-aeb5-4ff4515256b8)

 - Key specific competencies for success in nursing include:
   
   - Deep user empathy + product taste [rationale: experience is the #1 risk in nursing]
   
   - Track record to execute on complex, cross-functional initiatives to deliver outcomes [rationale: alignment with inpatient, managing Epic dependencies]
   
   - Ability to synthesize complex and sometimes conflicting information (from market context to engagement data) to define roadmap [rationale: important to be able to cut through multiple factors, e.g. commercial / business context; team has, in the past, gotten stuck in the dynamics of Mayo + Epic]
   
   - Grit + resilience [rationale: building nursing is hard]

 - Candidates don't necessarily need to spike on nursing/healthcare expertise or insane technical depth (e.g. uthat of a research/platform PM). These can all be coached by leadership for someone with a growth mindset, or supported by engineering


WHY WORK AT ABRIDGE?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.



HOW WE TAKE CARE OF ABRIDGERS:

 - Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

 - Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

 - Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

 - Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

 - Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.
