jobs.title: Senior Product Quality Engineer, Anduril Expeditionary Systems
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

As a Sr Product Quality Engineer, you will work inside & outside the organization to define, develop, and execute processes that deliver high quality & reliable products. This role focuses on our Anduril Expeditionary Systems (AES) product portfolio (products like Menace-I and TITAN) with career growth opportunities as products develop. The right person for this role has knowledge of manufacturing, product development, sub-system performance criteria, inspection and continuous improvement. If you are someone who loves to build world-class quality processes, work hands-on, and be accountable for results, then this role is for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Drive product improvement by implementing processes for data collection and incident reporting that will inform activities like detailed design reviews, process development, verification, validation, and qualification of processes and parts, and sub assemblies. 0.

• Drive clarity & resolution for development ambiguities associated with product maturity, process stability, and field performance that impact the product meeting it's quality & reliability goals for volume production.

• Facilitate Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) activities for field and reliability issues. Review the effectiveness of actions and share lessons learned across the product team.

• Champion the transition from new product introduction (NPI) to a sustainable & predictable product experience for our customers.

• Own the elimination of product risk to improve reliability across the product lifecycle. Engage in quality activities from concept through development and manufacturing to field use.

• Ensure the execution of product and process requirements. Define and improve such requirements.

• Work cross-functionally to define and execute the product roadmap.

• Lead product health data analysis and improvement activities. Establish metrics for measuring quality and the factors that predict quality performance.

• Support the continuous improvement of the Quality Management System. Define and improve required documentation and activities.

• Support investigations, initiatives, and projects as needed, at the team or organization level.

• Develop and implement manufacturing requirements, quality standards, and product quality plans per category of component (castings, forgings, machined parts, electromechanical systems). Cross functional leadership through design, manufacturing, quality, and reliability engineering to analyze process capability potential from the early design phase and direct design decisions based on data.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or similar technical field

• 7+ years of experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Quality in aerospace/defense or similar complex hardware environments, including Edge Compute, Communications, or electronics products.

• Proven experience leading root cause corrective action (RCCA) efforts for complex problems and issues, utilizing tools such as 8D, Lean Six Sigma, Fault Tree Analysis, and DMAIC methodologies.

• Strong working knowledge of design review and quality management of PCBA, harnessing, machined & sheet metal components, and weldment structures.

• Strong working knowledge of product development methodologies such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Verification & Validation (V&V) testing, Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) elements including Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA) and Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T).

• Proven experience creating and managing a Program Quality Management Plan (QMP)

• Working knowledge of mechanical and/or electrical manufacturing processes.

• A strong ownership mindset with demonstrated capability to drive projects and teams from start to completion.

• Analytical skills and experience with data mining, data quality, metrics generation, issue management systems, and statistical analysis tools (MATLAB, JMP, Minitab, etc.)

• Working knowledge of Configuration Management and Document Control

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive alignment on quality standards.

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree in a technical field

• 10+ years of experience with developing quality systems for low volume, high complex manufacturing environments and suppliers.

• Experience working under DoD Program of Records (PoR) requirements

• Working knowledge of AS9100/ ISO 9001-based Quality Management System requirements.

• Experience working on weldments and driving weld requirements

• Experience with IPC standards

• Lean six sigma certification is preferred.

• Experience with government contracts and mil standard or other regulatory requirements.

• Experience with Teamcenter, Siemens NX, Jira, Foundry, Oracle, or Odoo.

US Salary Range

$146,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Corporate Counsel
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Hyperbolic Labs is on a mission to democratize AI by breaking down the barriers to computing power with our Open-Access AI Cloud. By making better use of idle computing resources across the globe, we offer an innovative GPU marketplace and AI inference service that promise affordability and accessibility for all. As pioneers at the intersection of AI and open-source technology, we believe in an open future where AI innovation is limited only by imagination, not by access to resources. We're looking for forward-thinking individuals who share our passion for making AI universally accessible, secure, and affordable. Join us in building a platform that empowers innovators everywhere to turn their visionary AI projects into reality.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Hyperbolic is seeking a high-impact, commercially minded in-house legal counsel to help shape the legal and commercial foundation of our AI infrastructure business.

This is a highly visible role working directly with our founders and leadership team on some of the company’s most important transactions. You will own the agreements through which Hyperbolic secures GPU capacity, brings strategic partners onto its platform, and serves its customers.

A central part of your mandate will be aligning MSAs with neocloud providers and customers to deliver a consistently high quality of service while protecting Hyperbolic from legal, operational, and financial risk. Your work will directly influence how we scale, enter new markets, and build durable relationships across the AI infrastructure ecosystem.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Draft, review, and negotiate MSAs with neoclouds and customers, matching terms across capacity, pricing, timeline, performance, service levels, security, liability, and termination.

 - Design a wide range of innovative commercial agreements, including creative deal structures with neoclouds, channel partners, market makers, vendors, and technology providers.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, and Operations to ensure contractual commitments are technically achievable and financially supportable.

 - Navigate an evolving regulatory and compliance landscape, including AI sales restrictions, potential CFTC oversight, SOC 2 & GDPR requirements, and financial-services and data-privacy laws across jurisdictions.

 - Lead the company’s response to disputes, litigation, and regulatory inquiries, providing clear and decisive counsel under pressure.

 - Advise on corporate governance, fundraising, debt and equity financings, intellectual property protection, and other strategic corporate matters.

 - Build contract templates, negotiation playbooks, approval processes, and systems for tracking contractual obligations and risk.

 - Manage outside counsel and the legal budget.




WHO YOU ARE

 - J.D. and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.

 - 5+ years of relevant legal experience, including commercial technology transactions and meaningful in-house experience.

 - Significant experience drafting and negotiating complex infrastructure, cloud, or enterprise customer MSAs.

 - Strong understanding of committed capacity, usage-based pricing, SLAs, security obligations, indemnities, liability caps, and termination economics.

 - Able to compare interconnected supplier and customer agreements, identify mismatched obligations, and develop practical risk mitigations.

 - Commercial, collaborative, and comfortable making sound decisions in a fast-moving environment.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at a neocloud, GPU cloud, public-cloud provider, data-center operator, high-performance computing company, or infrastructure marketplace.

 - Experience with channel, reseller, marketplace, referral, capacity-sharing, or other non-standard commercial arrangements.

 - Experience supporting an early-stage company across commercial, corporate, regulatory, and product matters.

Hyperbolic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Internal Systems (Robotics)
jobs.description:
The Company
We believe general-purpose, generally-intelligent robots will be built in our lifetimes. Robots will work in our factories, move our goods, walk on our streets and eventually be in our homes. To build that future, research and deployment must work in lockstep: real-world operation must make the technology better and better technology must make deployment easier. We're looking for the thinkers, builders, and researchers who want to be part of that loop.
As an AI robotics company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, on state-of-the-art hardware, every line of code written at Tutor has a direct impact on the global, physical economy.
Our Culture
We believe that something truly special can happen when talented, motivated people work together; at Tutor, every member of our team is empowered to have real impact in everything that they do. We're characterized by both technical excellence and next-level collaboration and respect.
About the Role
Tutor designs and builds its robots, manufactures them, deploys them into customer facilities, maintains them, and teaches them new work. Each of those functions runs on software we wrote: the systems that track each robot, its site, its owner, its service history, and its current job. That software, and the shared data model underneath it, is what this role owns.
Today that ownership is spread across many people. Maintenance, manufacturing, tutoring, deployment, and sales each have tools that were built by whoever needed them first, and the definitions they share live in a schema that nobody owns end to end. We're looking for a senior engineer to take responsibility for the company's internal systems and the data model they run on, and to improve both as the company grows.
We build our own tools. We wrote our own PLM, and we are customizing our own MES rather than buying one off the shelf. When a function needs software we usually write it, use it ourselves, and keep improving it, and we plan to keep doing that as we grow. This role owns the systems that habit produces.
This is a role for someone with senior software experience who likes operations. You'll spend time on the manufacturing floor, on deployment calls, and with the people who maintain robots in the field, because the systems you own are theirs to use. You'll also spend a lot of time in the schema, since a change to what a "robot" or a "job" means touches every function at once.
A significant portion of this role involves working with AI coding agents. Internal tools are a good fit for agents, and you'll direct them to build and maintain a large surface of internal software, review their output critically, and design the interfaces and data that make them effective.

jobs.title: Revenue Accounting Manager
jobs.location: Mountain View, California; San Francisco, California
jobs.description:
(GAQ427R221)

Databricks is looking for a Revenue Accounting Manager to join our team. You will report to the Manager of Revenue Accounting and play a hands-on leadership role across the full revenue accounting close cycle, from evaluating complex contract terms and applying ASC 606, to leading UAT for new system logic, to preparing financial reporting deliverables for internal and external stakeholders. This is an individual contributor position with significant ownership and cross-functional influence.

Our revenue accounting environment is evolving rapidly. New SKUs, new go-to-market motions, shifting policy requirements and system migrations are the norm. We need someone who thrives in ambiguity, adapts when priorities shift and takes ownership of complex problems. Our ideal candidate has a builder’s mindset: someone who digs into the details, challenges existing processes and leads improvements that make the close faster, more accurate and scalable.

The Impact You Will Have

• Lead the close, end to end. Own and review monthly close activities, including usage reviews, journal entries, revenue estimates, flux analyses, account reconciliations and management reporting. Identify opportunities to improve quality and compress the close timeline.

• Apply ASC 606 with sound judgment. Evaluate complex and non-standard customer arrangements, document accounting conclusions and ensure consistent application of revenue recognition policies as our product portfolio evolves.

• Dig into the details. Pull, validate and troubleshoot data directly across contracts, billing systems, revenue systems and the general ledger. Trace discrepancies to the source and drive them through resolution.

• Own key revenue accounts. Manage revenue subledger-to-GL reconciliations for deferred revenue, contract assets and unbilled accounts receivable. Ensure balances are accurate, complete and supported.

• Turn data into insights. Analyze large datasets and explain key drivers affecting revenue, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue and other financial metrics. Provide clear recommendations to management.

• Lead system and process improvements. Define business requirements, lead UAT, assess accounting impacts and partner with Engineering and Finance Data Services to implement scalable solutions across revenue, billing and ERP systems.

• Automate relentlessly. Identify manual, repetitive processes and take ownership of building or championing automation through SQL, scripts, AI tools, workflow improvements or systematic solutions.

jobs.title: HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Studs is a category-defining ear piercing and earring brand named one of “the 10 most innovative companies in retail for 2023” by Fast Company. Studs connects ear piercing with aftercare and earring shopping to create an end-to-end Earscaping® experience. We offer a better retail and digital experience that prioritizes safety and expertise in a cool, fun and welcoming environment, along with a wide earring assortment—all at an accessible price point.

The HR Business Partner will run the systems and administration behind employee relations at Studs, and owns leave, accommodation, and day to day benefits support end to end. You keep every case documented, every ticket moving, and every system current, so that when a decision needs to be made the record is already complete and correct.

Leave, accommodation, and work restriction matters are where you work directly with employees. You run the interactive process, coordinate with managers on what a restriction means for scheduling, and carry each case from first notice through return to work. Complex investigations and sensitive terminations are led by the SVP, People, and you support them with preparation, documentation, and follow through rather than carrying them yourself.

This role is systems heavy by design. You own your own lane of changes in ADP, you keep the case and ticket systems clean without being asked, and you serve as backup for core People Operations processing so that no critical function depends on one person being available.

This role is ideal for someone who is genuinely good at the part of employee relations that most people treat as overhead. You would rather build the tracker than improvise, you notice the case that has gone quiet for eleven days, and you can hold a confidential conversation with an employee about a medical restriction with warmth and precision at the same time.

Salary Range: $100,000 — $125,000

Location: HQ (New York, NY) — Hybrid

Key Responsibilities:

Leave, Accommodation, and Work Restrictions

• Own leave of absence administration end to end, including eligibility, notices, tracking, and return to work.

• Run the interactive process for accommodation requests and document each step as it happens.

• Coordinate work and scheduling restrictions with Regional and Studio Managers so that coverage plans reflect them.

• Serve as the employee point of contact throughout, maintaining confidentiality on medical information.

• Escalate accommodation and leave questions with legal exposure to the SVP, People and outside counsel.

Employee Relations Systems and Case Administration

• Own the employee relations case system: intake, routing, status, ownership, and closure.

• Manage the People Service Center ticket queue against defined response and resolution standards.

• Maintain documentation completeness on every case, and flag files that are not ready for a decision.

• Track corrective action across regions and surface where similar situations are being handled differently.

• Report case volume, type, severity, and trend to the SVP, People on a set cadence.

Case Support

• Prepare investigation and termination materials for the SVP, People, including timelines and document sets.

• Schedule and coordinate meetings, notifications, and follow up actions on active matters.

• Execute the system and record changes that follow a decision, including separations in ADP.

• Maintain the employee relations playbook and escalation criteria as they are updated.

Benefits Support

• Serve as the day to day contact with our benefits broker on employee questions and issues.

• Support enrollment, qualifying life events, and open enrollment execution.

• Coordinate benefits continuation and COBRA for employees on leave or separating.

• Reconcile benefits deductions with Payroll before each cycle closes.

People Systems and Coverage

• Own a defined lane of ADP changes, including leave status, restrictions, and separation records.

• Serve as trained backup for core People Operations processing during absence or peak volume.

• Keep data consistent between the case system, the ticket queue, and ADP.

• Contribute to process improvement where administration is slow, manual, or error prone.

Requirements:

• 4 to 6 years in human resources with direct ownership of employee relations, leave and accommodation administration.

• Hands-on experience running the interactive process and managing leave cases end to end.

• Strong systems fluency, including HRIS administration and case or ticket management platforms.

• Experience with ADP strongly preferred, and the ability to own configuration in a defined scope.

• Multi-state experience, including familiarity with state leave programs.

• Working knowledge of benefits administration, including continuation and COBRA.

• Exceptional documentation discipline and follow through on cases that span weeks or months.

• Able to handle sensitive medical and personal information with discretion.

• Comfortable supporting complex matters led by someone else rather than owning every decision.

• Based in New York City and able to work onsite three days per week.

Benefits & Perks

• Flexible Work Environment (3 days in office, 2 days work from home)

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (including a plan option with $0 in-network mental health visits)

• Access to Mental Health and Work/Life Resources including Online Therapy, Gender Affirmation Support Services, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Voluntary Life Insurance

• Health and Commuter Tax-Advantaged Accounts

• Stock Options in connection with the Company’s Equity Incentive Plan

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Paid Time Off, Paid Safe & Sick Leave, and Paid Parental Leave

• Paid Sabbatical After 4 Years of Service

• Exclusive Employee Discounts on Piercings and Jewelry (we’ve got your friends and family covered too!)

• Access to PerkSpot and additional benefits such as pet insurance, discounted tickets, personal finance coaching, healthy rewards, and more!

jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

About the Role

jobs.title: GTM Engineer (Revenue Operations)
jobs.description:
About Flow
Flow Engineering is an AI-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor.

About the role
Flow is seeking a GTM Engineer to build and run the systems behind how we find, win, and grow customers. Our customers are hardware teams in aerospace, defense, automotive, and adjacent industries, and our sales motion reflects that: long evaluation cycles, multiple stakeholders across engineering and procurement, and pilots that expand into full deployments. Getting the right data, tooling, and process in place is what lets a small team run that motion well.

This role sits between sales, marketing, customer success, and leadership. You will own our GTM stack end to end, automate the work that slows the team down, and turn pipeline and customer data into something the whole company can trust and act on.

What you'll do

 - Own and evolve our GTM stack, including CRM, enrichment, sequencing, and analytics tools, and the integrations that connect them.

 - Build automated workflows for prospecting, lead routing, enrichment, and account research, using APIs, scripting, and AI tooling where it makes the team faster.

 - Design and maintain our pipeline structure, deal stages, and data model so that forecasting and reporting reflect what is actually happening in the business.

 - Build dashboards and reporting on pipeline health, conversion, sales cycle, and pilot-to-deployment expansion for the GTM team and leadership.

 - Partner with sales and customer success to identify friction in how deals move and translate it into process or tooling changes.

 - Support planning work such as territory and account segmentation, target account lists, and quota and capacity modeling as the team grows.

 - Keep data clean and consistent across systems, including deduplication, field hygiene, and clear ownership of records.

About you

 - 3+ years in revenue operations, GTM engineering, sales operations, or a similar role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company selling to enterprise customers.

 - Hands-on experience administering a CRM and building automations and integrations across a GTM stack.

 - Comfortable writing code or scripts (Python, JavaScript, SQL, or similar) to connect systems and move data when no-code tools fall short.

 - Strong analytical skills, with experience building reporting that leaders actually use to make decisions.

 - Able to work directly with sellers and understand the realities of a complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycle.

 - Comfortable in a high-ownership environment where you scope, build, and support your own systems.

Nice to have

 - Experience at an early-stage startup building GTM infrastructure from the ground up.

 - Familiarity with selling into defense, aerospace, or other regulated industries, including longer procurement cycles.

 - Experience using LLMs or AI agents to automate research, enrichment, or outbound workflows.

jobs.title: User Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Location: San Jose, CA

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: 1245 S Winchester Blvd, San Jose

Intended Start Date: ASAP

About Think Academy

We are looking for a User Conversion & Operations Specialist who can develop a deep understanding of the needs of U.S. K–12 families and drive business growth through parent engagement, course conversion, and user operations.

This role will initially focus on frontline parent communication and course conversion. You will work directly with parents, understand their needs and decision-making process, and take ownership of conversion results. As you build a deeper understanding of our users and products, you will gradually take on broader user operations initiatives, including cross-subject enrollment among existing families, referral programs, parent communities, and user engagement activities.

We are looking for someone who can do more than simply follow an established process. We want someone who understands users, takes ownership of goals, and proactively finds ways to get results.

What You’ll Do

• Parent Communication & Course Conversion Communicate directly with parents to understand students’ learning needs, current performance, and key factors influencing family decisions. Recommend appropriate courses based on user needs and drive trial class bookings and course enrollment. Consistently follow up with prospective families and address common concerns related to learning outcomes, course difficulty, scheduling, pricing, and other considerations. Take ownership of key conversion outcomes, including trial class bookings, attendance, and long-term course enrollment. Identify recurring user needs, objections, and reasons for drop-off, and continuously improve communication strategies and conversion SOPs.

• Community Operations & User Growth Develop a deep understanding of existing families and identify cross-subject enrollment opportunities across Math, ELA, and other programs. Participate in referral initiatives by designing user outreach, incentives, and conversion pathways. Segment users by grade level, subject, and learning stage and develop targeted engagement strategies. Identify growth opportunities through user feedback and data, and turn insights into actionable initiatives.

• Community & User Engagement Programs Support the day-to-day operation of parent communities and maintain ongoing communication with families to increase engagement. Track data related to user communication, conversion, cross-subject enrollment, referrals, and engagement programs. Plan and execute programs such as learning challenges, educational resource campaigns, trial classes, assessments, and parent workshops. Develop parent-facing content and activities around topics relevant to U.S. K–12 families, including learning pathways and school or admissions-related policies. Design user journeys that move families from initial participation toward further engagement and course conversion, with timely follow-up for high-potential users. Track key metrics such as registration, participation, and conversion, and continuously optimize programs based on results.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or above.

• Native or near-native Chinese communication skills and professional working proficiency in English.

• Strong user communication skills, with the willingness to proactively reach out, follow up consistently, and move users toward the next step.

• Strong goal orientation and results ownership, with the ability to take responsibility for clear conversion and operational targets.

• Strong learning ability and execution skills; able to proactively identify solutions and move projects forward in ambiguous situations.

• Basic data literacy and the ability to use data and user feedback to evaluate and improve performance.

• Ability to work on-site in Silicon Valley on a long-term basis.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in education, user operations, community operations, admissions, enrollment, or conversion-focused roles.

• Familiarity with U.S. K–12 education or the educational needs of Chinese families in the U.S.

• Experience managing parent communities, user engagement programs, or in-person events.

• Ability to demonstrate past business impact with specific examples and measurable results.

Why You’ll Like This Role

• Clear Growth Path: Opportunities to grow into project management, academic operations, education product, or people management roles.

• Deep Exposure to U.S. ELA Education: Work directly with ELA programs serving North American K–12 families and help bring structured, effective English learning experiences into real classrooms and homes.

• Cross-Functional Business Exposure: Work closely with teaching, curriculum, and marketing teams throughout the user growth process.

• Long-Term Career Development: Build toward broader roles in user operations, user growth, academic operations, or project management.

Compensation & Benefits Structure:

• Total Compensation Package: $80,000-$90,000 Includes Base Salary: $78,000-$80,000 + Teaching Bonus: Up to 10%

• Extensive hands-on experience and the opportunity to own and lead impactful projects from an early stage; Fast-track path to management-level roles within 2–3 years, supported by structured mentorship and direct coaching from experienced leaders

• 401k and Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

• H1B Sponsorship available for eligible candidates

• As part of a global education company, you may have the chance to collaborate with international branches, engage with our headquarters, or explore cross-border career opportunities

• Relocation Allowance available

Think Academy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Director of Health and Safety
jobs.description:
TurboCell has an exciting opportunity for a Director of Health and Safety to join our team, working directly with operations, engineering, manufacturing, facilities, and executive leadership and focusing on building, leading, and continuously improving TurboCell’s health, safety, and risk management programs.

Because of our dedication to operational excellence, employee well-being, and maintaining smooth operations, TurboCell is highly selective about the people we bring on board—our work depends on it. Therefore, the Director of Health and Safety must be a proactive leader who can operate strategically while remaining hands-on in a fast-moving manufacturing and technology environment. The right person should be professional, trustworthy with confidential information, highly organized, self-motivated, and able to influence teams at all levels of the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

• Develop, implement, and continuously improve company-wide health and safety policies, procedures, standards, and training programs.

• Build and lead a proactive safety culture across manufacturing, engineering, facilities, field operations, and leadership teams.

• Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local health and safety regulations, including OSHA requirements and relevant environmental, industrial, and workplace safety standards.

• Conduct risk assessments, hazard analyses, inspections, audits, and corrective action reviews to identify and reduce operational risks.

• Lead incident response, investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action planning, and follow-up verification.

• Establish and monitor safety metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting processes for executive leadership and operational teams.

• Partner with site leaders to improve emergency preparedness, contractor safety, equipment safety, chemical safety, ergonomics, and job hazard analysis processes.

• Serve as the primary internal resource for health and safety guidance during new product introduction, facility changes, process changes, and manufacturing scale-up.

Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Health and Safety, Engineering, Industrial Safety, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive health and safety experience, including direct experience supporting manufacturing, industrial, energy, technology, or engineered-product environments.

• 5+ years of leadership experience building safety programs, influencing cross-functional teams, and advising senior leaders.

• Demonstrated knowledge of OSHA regulations, incident investigation methods, hazard recognition, risk assessment, audit practices, and corrective action management.

• Professional certifications such as CSP, CIH, CHMM, ASP, or equivalent credentials are strongly preferred.

Specific Skills / Abilities

• Strong leadership presence with the ability to coach, influence, and hold teams accountable while building trust.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present safety performance, risks, and recommendations to executive leadership.

• Practical, hands-on understanding of manufacturing operations, equipment safety, lockout/tagout, machine guarding, material handling, contractor safety, and emergency response.

• Ability to translate regulations and standards into clear, practical processes that support safe and efficient operations.

• Highly organized, data-driven, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a rapidly changing environment.

• Comfortable working independently, leading through ambiguity, and partnering across disciplines to solve complex operational challenges.

Working at Endeavour

Innovate at Speed: Thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas actually matter.
Own Your Work: Enjoy the flexibility and autonomy to execute and do your best work.
Learn from the Best: Collaborate daily with top-tier, experienced industry experts.
Elevate Your Craft: Be part of a respectful, continuous-learning culture driven by excellence.
Make a Real Impact: Join a team of dedicated changemakers building solutions that benefit people and the planet.

About Endeavour

Endeavour builds technology infrastructure for the benefit of all. As the AI revolution drives unprecedented demand for resources, Endeavour provides the integrated infrastructure required to support global innovation while restoring the local environments we serve.

Inspired by nature, we design infrastructure as a cohesive system where every element feeds another to create a cycle of regeneration. This vision is realized through the Endeavour Stack, a collection of next-generation technologies that solve critical challenges in data, energy, materials, and water. Together, our systems allow AI cloud providers to scale with speed and agility, bypassing the constraints of traditional infrastructure.

At Endeavour, we do things differently. As a purpose trust, we reinvest profits to solve global problems. We are a collection of changemakers driven by our connection to each other, our communities, and our planet. By bringing proven experts together to move fast and cut through complexity, we are building a new model for infrastructure that delivers lasting benefits to our customers and local communities.

jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist | Procurement
jobs.description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Operations partner for Ramp Procurement, you will help build and scale the workflows that enable customers to manage their procurement processes with speed, accuracy, and control. You will improve both the requester and approver experience while shaping product quality through data, customer feedback, and tight partnership with customer-facing internal teams.

Beyond your product vertical, you will also contribute to Product Operations process improvement and product building that allows our Product and Engineering teams to scale. You will use AI tools to improve release management, collect customer feedback, and enable internal teams to support customers and troubleshoot issues.

Our main goal is to reduce customer friction, measured by support tickets per active user and customer NPS.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the voice-of-customer loop for Procurement — systematically capture, analyze, and prioritize feedback from CX, Sales, and direct customer channels

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, and Design to translate customer feedback into actionable product requirements and specs

 - Own launch operations for new Procurement features as they move from Alpha to GA, including AI-native experiences that require strong customer and internal enablement

 - Directly ship product improvements (UX fixes and paper cuts) using AI tools — owning your own backlog of customer friction reduction, not just feeding the engineering backlog

 - Use AI to automate processes and build products that enable teams to ship faster while maintaining a high quality bar

 - Build scalable operating systems for release readiness, internal enablement, supportability, and issue escalation across Procurement workflows




WHAT YOU NEED

 - 3+ years in product operations, product management, or a customer-facing analytical role supporting B2B SaaS; experience with procurement, intake and approval workflows, spend management, or financial operations preferred

 - Proficiency using data to size opportunities and analyze adoption, support trends, payment flow performance, and customer friction

 - Ability to translate qualitative feedback into crisp requirements and operational processes

 - Comfort working in ambiguous, technically complex spaces and driving clarity across multiple stakeholders

 - Strong problem solving, prioritization, and communication skills; bias to ship improvements quickly and measure impact

 - Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) to accelerate your work and directly make product improvements




ABOUT OUR TEAMS

 - Spend Management owns our core spend product, including card issuance, reimbursements, and travel & entertainment to control spend

 - Procurement owns streamlining new purchase requests, approvals, vendors, savings, and price intelligence products to help companies make better financial decisions

 - Intelligence owns the reporting, savings, and price intelligence products to help companies make better financial decisions

 - Bill Payments owns our invoice management, accounts payable, and B2B payment capabilities

 - Risk owns our underwriting and financial products that determine which businesses to approve and how to manage risk

 - Growth owns onboarding, activation and retention products to help our customers be successful on the Ramp platform

 - Accounting owns creating intelligence in our accounting platform, saving finance teams time and money

 - Mobile owns our mobile app development and mobile strategy

 - Flexible PTO

 - Centralized home-office equipment ordering

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Weekly coffee stipend

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
ACCOUNTANT

Full-Time  |  Remote, US | $55K–$65K USD




COMPANY OVERVIEW

We're scaling the best YouTube agency in the world.

We've assembled a crazy-talented group of YouTube strategists and creative minds who've collectively generated over 110 billion views and shaped how YouTube works today. Our founder, Ryan Hashemi, spent seven years building Jubilee Media into a 14-million-subscriber, 5-billion-view powerhouse with four Emmy nominations, and trained the person who now runs MrBeast's studio.

Learn more about Ryan's journey [here https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7262864813221888000/]

Now we're helping the world's biggest brands crack the code on YouTube and make content that people actually want to watch at scale.

We lead YouTube creative and content programming as a strategic channel. We staff and train in-house YouTube teams for clients, hiring video producers, editors, and strategists, and build long-form storytelling systems designed to compound over time. The result: evergreen content that earns millions of views, builds loyal audiences, and drives conversions.




HOW WE HIRE

We don't screen for pedigree or platform experience. We evaluate individual superpowers, high agency, curiosity, and the ability to do exceptional work.

Our team includes SVP-level Condé Nast alumni working alongside self-taught YouTube strategists. We've got a flat culture and believe a good idea can come from anywhere.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a hands-on Accountant to help run the day-to-day financial operations behind Snowball.

This role is intentionally broad. Rather than owning one narrow piece of accounting, you'll work across the monthly accounting cycle, including invoicing and cash receipts, AP, payroll, contractor payments, reconciliations, month-end close, reporting, and financial systems.

We're looking for someone who already has strong accounting fundamentals and some real-world experience doing the work, but is excited to broaden their exposure and grow into greater ownership.

Working closely with all stakeholders at Snowball and with our wonderful clients,  the goal is for you to become increasingly autonomous across Snowball's day-to-day accounting operations while helping us build smarter systems and processes as we scale.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN


CORE ACCOUNTING OPERATIONS

 - Manage client invoicing, accounts receivable, and cash receipt processing

 - Process vendor invoices and execute accounts payable accurately and on schedule

 - Coordinate contractor payments

 - Support and process payroll

 - Review and process employee expenses and reimbursements

 - Perform bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations

 - Prepare and post journal entries and support prepaid and accrual accounting

 - Support the month-end close process and financial reporting

 - Investigate discrepancies and ensure transactions are recorded accurately


FINANCIAL SYSTEMS & REPORTING

 - Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in QuickBooks Online

 - Maintain and update financial forecasts and reporting in Google Sheets

 - Ensure financial data is accurate and consistent across systems

 - Maintain and improve integrations between financial systems

 - Troubleshoot issues and identify opportunities to make accounting workflows more efficient

 - Support the implementation of new financial systems and processes as Snowball grows


DOCUMENTATION & ORGANIZATION

 - Maintain the Finance Drive as the central source of contracts and financial documentation

 - Ensure financial records are properly stored, organized, and audit-ready

 - Maintain clear accounting processes and documentation

 - Continuously identify opportunities to improve accuracy, organization, and efficiency




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 2–4 years of hands-on accounting, bookkeeping, or related experience

 - Strong accounting fundamentals and an understanding of the monthly accounting cycle

 - Experience across multiple areas of accounting rather than exposure to only one narrow function

 - Hands-on experience with account reconciliations and month-end close

 - Experience with accounts payable and accounts receivable

 - Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online or a comparable accounting system

 - Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

 - Excellent attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy

 - Highly organized and able to manage recurring deadlines without things falling through the cracks

 - Curious and comfortable digging into a problem to understand why something isn't working

 - Proactive and willing to identify problems and propose solutions rather than waiting to be told what to do

 - Positive and collaborative

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - Comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving remote environment




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - US compensation: $55,000–$65,000 USD

 - Health & vision benefits

 - 401(k) for eligible US employees

 - Fully remote

 - Direct mentorship from the co-founders

 - Ground-floor opportunity at a fast-growing company




OUR VALUES

 - Work hard, learn harder

 - Be effectively proactive

 - Overdeliver for clients

 - Be kind by being clear

 - A+ players only

jobs.description:
For more than two decades, Bishop Fox has defined the forefront of offensive security. By combining elite human expertise with the power of its proprietary Cosmos AI engine, the firm delivers industry-leading cloud and application security services, including AI-powered penetration testing and AI/LLM security assessments that reflect real-world attacker behavior. Renowned for its innovation and contributions to the open-source community through flagship tools like Sliver and AIMap, Bishop Fox has released 25+ tools and 75+ advisories in the last 10 years.

With a 70 NPS rating, the firm remains the trusted partner for organizations seeking to stay ahead of the evolving threat landscape. Learn more at bishopfox.com

We are now hiring a Partner Marketing Manager to help support and scale our marketing execution and partner initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Partnerships Campaign Coordination

Serve as the operational backbone for our Channel and Alliances marketing programs, keeping joint initiatives moving and partners well-supported. Your work will include:

• Execute joint marketing and thought leadership campaigns with strategic partners

• Coordinate joint campaigns with strategic partners

• Track partner campaign timelines and deliverables

• Support partner event promotion, co-marketing initiatives, and outreach campaigns

• Maintain campaign calendars and partner communication workflows

• Help track partner marketing performance and engagement

• Manage and maintain partner and alliances information within the Highspot partner portal

• Support the partner deal registration process

• Qualify partner-generated inbound leads and route to sales

• Support analytics and reporting across partner initiatives

• Own the day-to-day build and launch of outbound email campaigns from list segmentation and targeting configuration to QA, approvals, and post-send reporting

• Build and schedule email campaigns in our marketing automation platform

Partner Marketing & Enablement

Coordinate joint marketing activities with our Channel and Alliance partners, ensuring programs are well-executed and partners have the resources they need to successfully position Bishop Fox services. Your work will include:

• Coordinate joint marketing activities and sponsored events with Channel and Alliance partners

• Support CISO and executive events by coordinating speakers, partners, and event-related marketing activities

• Partner with internal Channel & Alliances stakeholders to coordinate sponsored partner events and campaigns

• Help manage Marketing Development Funds (MDF) with channel partners, including tracking planned activities, budgets, and program execution

• Build and maintain partner-enablement collateral that helps partners understand, position, and sell Bishop Fox services

• Translate Bishop Fox services and capabilities into clear, partner-friendly messaging and materials

• Coordinate co-marketing and thought leadership initiatives with strategic partners

• Track partner marketing activities, deliverables, and results to ensure programs stay organized and on schedule

What Success Looks Like

• Partner marketing campaigns are organized and well-coordinated

• Campaign data and reporting are accurate and accessible

• Marketing and partnerships leaders can rely on strong operational support

• Partner data, deal registrations, and lead routing stay accurate and well-organized in Highspot and Salesforce

• Email outreach campaigns launch smoothly and on schedule

Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in marketing, partner marketing, marketing operations, or campaign coordination

• Strong organizational and project management skills

• Experience with email marketing or marketing automation platforms preferred

• Excellent attention to detail and follow-through

• Strong written communication skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

Nice to Have

• Experience with Marketo, Outreach, Salesforce, or similar tools

• Experience supporting alliance or channel marketing programs

• Familiarity with B2B marketing or cybersecurity industry

• Familiarity with Highspot or other partner relationship management (PRM) / partner portal tools

Bishop Fox has always supported remote work. Our comprehensive benefits program is tailored to meet your needs at an affordable price. We embrace diversity and an inclusive culture. We value our employees and who they are, which fosters a powerful and collective talent base to successfully serve our clients and the security community with unparalleled expertise.

Bishop Fox is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.  All new hires must pass a background check as a condition of employment.

Interested? Apply today!

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager (CONTRACT)
jobs.description:
Summary

GrayMatter Robotics is a well-capitalized Physical AI company headquartered in Los Angeles, building Factory SuperIntelligence (FSI) through systems that learn, adapt, and develop genuine process intelligence across every part they touch. Our robots take on the tedious, hazardous, and ergonomically demanding work that has kept manufacturing dependent on a shrinking skilled workforce, delivering superhuman performance. Robotics has a demo problem. GMR doesn't. Our systems are in active production today, adapting autonomously to real geometries, real materials, and real process variation without reprogramming. We deliver our system through a Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model that converts capital expenditure into an operating subscription, making Physical AI accessible to the manufacturers who need it most. We hire people who want to solve hard physical problems at an industrial scale.



We help manufacturers improve the quality of life for their workforce while increasing production capacity, and reducing scrap, repair, and rework costs. As a Supply Chain Manager, you will join our team onsite in our Carson, CA office to develop and execute procurement processes, source suppliers and manage vendor relationships to ensure a seamless supply chain while optimizing costs. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams, make strategic decisions and implement best practices within our procurement function.



Please Note: This role will begin as a 6-month contract position. While there may be opportunities to extend the engagement based on business needs, no extension or conversion is guaranteed at this time.



Role & Responsibilities

 - Own end-to-end procurement operations: source and negotiate with suppliers, issue purchase orders, and confirm correct, on-time fulfillment in partnership with the logistics and deployment teams.

 - Build and implement procurement systems and tools that give GMR clear visibility into every open PO, vendor commitment, and lead time as deployment volume grows.

 - Negotiate supplier contracts and resolve delivery defaults against fixed lead-time commitments, treating vendor recovery as a core part of the job rather than an exception.

 - Evaluate, select, and onboard suppliers against cost, quality, and engineering requirements, then manage the relationship through regular performance reviews.

 - Partner directly with engineering and product teams to translate their requirements, including ones outside your prior experience, into concrete sourcing and purchasing plans.

 - Analyze demand forecasts tied to robot deployment volume, including mobile robot rollouts, to determine what GMR needs, what it is missing, and what it will need next.

 - Act as the working bridge between vendors and quality, driving down rework and turnaround time on parts and components that fall short of spec.

 - Use AI-enabled procurement and data tools to automate reporting, flag anomalies in spend or lead time, and speed up sourcing research.

 - Develop and report procurement metrics, cost savings, and sourcing effectiveness to the Head of Operations.

Minimum Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

 - 8+ years of experience as a purchasing or procurement manager within a hardware and/or electronics business.

 - A track record of building procurement systems and processes from the ground up, ideally in a startup or rapid-growth environment.

 - Demonstrated ability to source, negotiate, and manage supplier contracts, including resolving delivery defaults against fixed lead-time commitments.

 - Comfortable operating as a self-managed individual contributor: able to run day-to-day procurement work independently and know which stakeholders to bring in for specific decisions.

 - Strong skills in budgeting, cost optimization, and negotiation, paired with excellent written and verbal communication.

 - Proficiency with procurement and vendor management software and systems.

 - Must have authorization to work in the United States and maintain ongoing work authorization from time of hire through the duration of employment.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Relevant certification in procurement or supply chain management, such as CPSM or CSCP.

 - Experience with global sourcing, logistics, and cross-border supply chain management.

 - Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools for tracking procurement metrics and spend.

 - Demonstrated use of AI tools to automate sourcing research, spend analysis, or procurement reporting.

 - Experience partnering closely with engineering or manufacturing teams on product and part requirements.

 - Prior experience at a smaller company, or as an early employee at a startup, having owned procurement across its full lifecycle.

jobs.title: Principal Data Platform Software Engineer (RaptorDB)
jobs.description:
About RaptorDB Operations

RaptorDB Operations owns the tooling, and operational excellence that safely deploys, manages, and operates RaptorDB databases across ServiceNow's global data centers and public cloud providers. Our team delivers mission-critical solutions that enable reliable service for millions of ServiceNow customers at massive scale.

We partner closely with RaptorDB development team, infrastructure automation, systems engineering, security, and customer support teams to architect and implement database operations that meet rigorous standards for uptime, performance, and resilience.

Role Overview

As a Principal Data Platform Software Engineer, you take part in architecting solutions for operating RaptorDB at scale. You will take part in setting technical directions for database deployment strategies, lead cross functional design sessions and establish best practices across teams. This role combines hands-on engineering excellence with technical leadership, bridging on-premise technologies, cloud-native architecture, infrastructure automation, and operational resilience.

What you get to do in this role

• Participate in architecting and designing solutions for RaptorDB deployment, operations, and resilience across ServiceNow's hybrid infrastructure (datacenters and public cloud providers).
• Collaborate across organizational boundaries to evolve backup, restore, replication, and failover systems that integrate with broader database reliability and scalability efforts across the platform.
• Drive adoption of cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Cloud-Native PostgreSQL) and establish reference architectures that balance operational simplicity with business requirements.
• Develop high-quality, clean, and maintainable code that enforces best practices in software architecture, automated testing, code reviews, and deployment pipelines.
• Collaborate with Architects across teams, RaptorDB development, infrastructure automation, systems engineering, and security teams to ensure database operations are secure, performant, and resilient across all environments.
• Lead performance analysis and optimization initiatives, including backup and restore times, recovery time objectives (RTO), and resource utilization across the fleet.
• Respond to urgent production incidents and provide expert guidance on database operations challenges to customer-facing and internal teams.
• Build and maintain institutional knowledge through documentation, runbooks, and architectural decision records that enable the team to scale.

To be successful in this role you have

• Skilled in applying AI-assisted tools to enhance productivity across design, analytics, and software development while adhering to governance and best practices.
• Experience in working across organizations co-architecting and co-designing holistic solutions.
• Track record of helping with setting technical direction, making architectural decisions under uncertainty in a highly collaborative environment.
• Deep expertise with databases, including operations, operational management and backup/restore strategies.
• Experience designing and building distributed systems, with strong understanding of high-availability, failover, and disaster recovery architectures.
• Exceptional communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences.

• Experience in leveraging or critical thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision making, or problem solving. This includes using AI powered tools, automated workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or reasoning about AI’s impact on how infrastructure is built and run.
• 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 8+ years focused on database systems, infrastructure, or cloud platforms.
• Hands-on proficiency with multiple programming languages (Go, Python, or equivalent) and demonstrated mastery of software engineering best practices.
• Experience with Kubernetes and database operators.
• Experience operating databases in cloud environments
• In-depth Linux knowledge
• Excellent technical problem-solving skills
• Background in open-source database is a plus

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $240,100 - $420,200, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

jobs.title: Electrical Test Technician, Hardware Platform EE Lab
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Hardware Platform Organization is Anduril's central hardware engineering org. We build the shared technologies, tools, and infrastructure that power hardware development across every Anduril division, from actuators and propulsion to batteries, avionics, rocket motors, and test operations. Our teams set engineering standards, run development manufacturing and test sites, and develop core technology products that ship across multiple product lines.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an Electrical Test Technician to join the Hardware Engineering Services team within Anduril's Hardware Platform Organization. You will be embedded in a fast-paced R&D lab building the test infrastructure and cable harnesses that support hardware development across Anduril's defense products. This is a hands-on, build-first role. You'll own custom test rack and fixture builds from scratch, fabricate mil-spec cable harnesses, and work directly with electrical engineers to bring new hardware from prototype to test.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Design and build custom electrical test racks, test fixtures, and ground support equipment (GSE) from engineering drawings, BOMs, and minimal instructions often as the first article in a fast-changing R&D environment

• Fabricate and terminate cable harnesses to IPC-620 Class 3 standards using mil-spec connectors including D38999, Mighty Mouse (Glenair), Amphenol, micro-D, and coaxial/RF assemblies; perform backshell integration, band-it clamping, and EMI shielding termination

• Set up, execute, and document electrical test procedures including continuity, hi-pot, insulation resistance, and functional validation; record findings in test records and communicate issues to engineering

• Operate and configure bench test equipment oscilloscopes (including triggering and signal acquisition), power supplies, electronic loads, function generators, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, and DAQ systems

• Troubleshoot electrical assemblies and systems to the component level using systematic root cause analysis; drive issues to resolution independently or in direct collaboration with engineers

• Perform PCBA rework and repair to IPC-610 standards, including SMT and through-hole components

• Work directly with electrical engineers to interpret drawings, redline documentation, flag design or BOM discrepancies, and propose build solutions including from in-progress or incomplete work instructions

• Support setup, execution, and troubleshooting of EMI/EMC test configurations per MIL-STD-461 and RTCA DO-160

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 3+ years of hands-on experience building custom electrical test racks, test fixtures, or cable harnesses in an R&D, prototype, or aerospace/defense environment production-line assembly experience alone does not meet this requirement

• Demonstrated fabrication experience with mil-spec circular connectors specifically D38999, Mighty Mouse, Glenair, Amphenol, or equivalent including crimping, insertion/extraction tooling, backshell integration, and band-it clamping for EMI shielding

• Current or previously held IPC-620 certification (CIS or CIT); must be able to recertify upon hire

• Current or previously held J-STD-001 soldering certification; must be able to recertify upon hire

• Proficiency configuring and operating oscilloscopes including triggering modes, vertical/horizontal scaling, and signal acquisition as well as power supplies, electronic loads, and DMMs

• Ability to read and build from electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and BOMs with incomplete or in-progress documentation; proactively identifies and escalates discrepancies before building

• U.S. Person status required as this position needs to access export-controlled data

• Ability to lift a minimum of 25 lbs unassisted

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• IPC-620 space addendum certification (CIS-S or CIT-S) and/or current IPC-610 PCBA inspection certification

• SMT and through-hole PCBA rework experience including IC-level components (QFN, QFP, BGA) under microscope

• Experience with EMI/EMC testing and MIL-STD-461 test setup, including CE102, CS114, RE102, and RS103 configurations

• Background in aerospace, defense, or satellite systems environments (e.g., SpaceX, Northrop Grumman, Boeing, Raytheon, Rocket Lab, SAIC, Shield AI, or equivalent)

• Experience building RF/coaxial cable assemblies including layer-by-layer prep and impedance-controlled terminations

• Familiarity with test automation, data acquisition scripting, or automated EMC software (TILE, Elektra, EMC32, or equivalent)

US Salary Range

$37.02—$49.04 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

jobs.title: Content Creator
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Each year, 2.5 trillion hours are spent on household chores. At Matic, we’re on a mission to recapture that lost time, and we’re doing it by revolutionizing home robotics.

Our first product, also called Matic, is a Wall-E-esque floor cleaning robot. We've built what amounts to "full self-driving in the home” with real-time 3D mapping, adaptive path-tracking, and a precise semantic understanding of the home. Our breakthroughs in spatial AI allow Matic to work reliably in real homes, using only RGB cameras and neural networks running on-device.




PRIVACY FIRST

What happens in the home, stays in the home. Our robots are private by design, with all data processing performed by the robot itself, not in the cloud.




OUR APPROACH

Before the iPhone, consumers adopted several distinct devices; cell phones, PDAs, and portable music players each served a particular need. We believe in a similar progression for home robotics, starting with single-purpose robots and building iteratively toward more complex capabilities over time.




OUR CULTURE

Matic is a tight-knit and collaborative team, singularly focused on building products our customers will cherish. We're ultra-hardworking people committed to solving tough problems that save precious time and energy.




ABOUT THE ROLE

At Matic, we’re building home robots that give people time and energy back. People spend an average of 10+ hours each week on household chores, and we’re here to change that. We build and ship products that solve real problems for real people, with a team that values curiosity, learning, and ownership.



We’re looking for a Content Creator to bring Matic’s story to life through compelling video and photography, with room to shape our creative voice and make an immediate impact.



What You Will Do

 - Shoot and edit social-first video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, paid social, and other digital channels.

 - Turn creative briefs, references, rough ideas, and existing footage into polished finished content.

 - Capture clean, professional product, lifestyle, and behind-the-scenes photography.

 - Own projects from capture through final edit, including lighting, audio, color, sound design, motion graphics, and typography.

 - Create multiple variations and iterations for paid media testing and rapid learning.

 - Use After Effects to add thoughtful motion, typography, graphics, and visual treatments.

 - Spot ideas in existing footage or cultural moments and bring them to life quickly—without waiting for approvals.

 - Contribute creative ideas. We want a partner who brings references, pitches angles, and makes the work better.

What You Bring

 - Strong editing fundamentals: excellent short-form, vertical video editing with strong pacing and visual storytelling.

 - 2+ years of hands-on experience creating and editing video content (school projects, personal work, freelance gigs, internships—we don’t care where it comes from, your portfolio does the talking).

 - Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects (demonstrated fluency across multiple projects).

 - Motion graphics experience: demonstrated ability to animate type, create graphics, and compose visual treatments in After Effects.

 - Shooting and composition skills: clean product, lifestyle, and BTS photography with strong framing.

 - Comfort working with and directing talent: ability to conduct interviews, guide people on camera, and capture authentic talking heads and performance-based content.

 - Sound design and color correction fundamentals.

 - Familiarity with AI video production workflows: comfortable experimenting with AI tools for asset creation, editing assistance, and visual storytelling.

 - A portfolio is required: submit a portfolio featuring social-first video and photography, with a brief description of your contribution to each project.

 - Fast execution: ability to move from idea to finished piece without sacrificing taste.

 - Collaborative mindset: you can take feedback, iterate, and create without needing constant direction.

Nice to Have

 - Studio or product photography experience.

 - Lighting fundamentals beyond basic setups.

 - Understanding of performance creative and paid social metrics.

 - Familiarity with Figma.

 - YouTube editing or longer-form storytelling experience.

 - Interest in consumer tech, hardware, or product-driven companies.

Compensation

Base $96,000 — $120,000

Actual Compensation will depend on skills, experience and qualifications. Base Salary is one part of the total compensation package. The role is also eligible for equity through the company’s discretionary equity program, along with a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision coverage access to a 401(k) plan.
