jobs.description:
GAQ427R57

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including over 70% of the Fortune 500 and most of the largest U.S. government agencies — rely on Databricks to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics, and agents.

About the Role

As a Program Manager for Public Sector in Commercial Legal at Databricks, you will own the contracting engine for one of the fastest-growing segments of the business: US and international public-sector deals. Reporting to the Director & Associate General Counsel, Commercial, you will act as the operational backbone for the public-sector contracting function, working in close coordination with Public Sector legal, sales, operations, product, engineering, finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders.

This is a mission-critical and highly independent role designed for a proactive, focused person who thrives on building programs in-flight to drive accountability and positive, timely outcomes. You won't just track workstreams — you will own them. You will design and manage contracting programs and workflows, build playbooks and governance frameworks, route and manage complex government deals through stakeholders, handle routine contracting matters under attorney supervision, and support some contract management/contract lifecycle work (including Databricks' GSA MAS). If you are an operationally fierce program manager with government-contracting chops and extraordinary interpersonal skills who wants to be the linchpin to Databricks' pubsec legal function, we want to talk to you.

Location: Washington, DC metro area (hybrid).

The Impact You Will Have

• Own the Public Sector Contracting Program: Act as the central driver for US public-sector contracting operations (US Federal/Defense, Defense Industrial Base, and SLED), plus Canada and priority overseas markets.

• Drive Cross-Functional Deal Execution: Coordinate stakeholders, including sales, deal desk, operations, security, compliance, and finance through a predictable, well-governed pipeline. Keep stakeholders and executives well informed about the work and accountable to deadlines. No surprises, no missed deadlines, and exceptions are handled with aplomb.

• Manage Pubsec Contracts and Contract Lifecycle: Manage Databricks' pubsec schedules, including our GSA MAS and similar vehicles. Track contracts from RFI to signature to closeout, and support amendments.

• Build Enablement: Create enablement for Legal and GTM teams so that routine matters can be handled at scale with minimal legal involvement. Build and maintain playbooks, talk tracks, clause libraries, and training that support self-service for sales teams and decrease deal friction.

• Strengthen Post-Award Obligation Management: Own (in collaboration with Compliance) traceability for non-standard contractual commitments, such as by building obligation matrices, aligning them to accountable owners, systems, and controls across the organization.

• Scale Internationally: Develop and govern contracting programs for priority international markets to create repeatable processes to drive stakeholder engagement and forward progress.

• Drive Continuous Improvement: Constantly audit the status quo to support increasing scale and anticipate future needs before they arise. Develop training and GTM enablement for sales, delivery, finance, and partner teams.

• Handle Routine Contracting Matters: Support deal flow for initial triage (including pre-award RFI/RFP support and coordination) and routine matters (under attorney supervision).

What We Look For

Practical familiarity with US pubsec regulatory requirements, prime/sub relationships, and commercial flowdown clauses.

• Interdependence without Authority: You thrive in matrixed, highly interdependent operations where your success depends on the systems you build and the depth and quality of your stakeholder relationships.

• Balanced Emotional Intelligence and Mission-Focus: Proven ability to display grace under pressure, patience, collegiality, and resilience (learning from one's mistakes) while simultaneously raising the bar and truth-seeking to ensure things happen the right way for the company. You hold others accountable and expect the same of yourself.

• AI Tools & Systems: Proficiency in leveraging AI tools to optimize legal or contracting operations and working with CLMs, CRMs, ticketing systems, and workflow automation tools.

• International Experience Welcomed: Experience with multi-jurisdictional government procurement and foreign language skills are a plus.

Minimum Requirements

jobs.title: Senior Construction Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Atlas Energy Solutions Inc. (NYSE: AESI) is a leading solutions provider to the energy industry. Atlas’ portfolio of offerings includes oilfield logistics, distributed power systems, and the largest proppant supply network in the Permian Basin. With a focus on leveraging technology, automation, and remote operations to enhance efficiencies, Atlas is centered around a core mission of improving human beings’ access to hydrocarbons that power our lives and, by doing so, maximizing value creation for our shareholders.

How You Will Make an Impact:

The Senior Construction Manager owns construction delivery for assigned power generation projects across the full lifecycle: pre-construction planning, site access and real estate, labor force planning, early works, contractor mobilization, execution oversight, and turnover to commissioning. This position carries a facility execution emphasis: the primary focus is leading construction of engine halls and associated electrical facilities from mobilization through mechanical completion and turnover, while remaining involved in pre-construction and early works from the start and working as one team with the Senior Construction Manager focused on the front end. The role is Atlas's designated construction representative to contractors for whatever scope it is assigned.

Responsibilities

• Lead pre-construction planning for assigned projects, including the construction execution plan, site logistics plan, laydown and crane strategy, and constructability and sequencing input to design reviews while changes are still inexpensive.

• Own site access and logistics: haul route surveys, heavy haul and oversize permits, road use agreements, entrance permits, and delivery sequencing for major equipment.

• Manage construction real estate needs, including laydown and staging leases, temporary construction easements, craft parking, and construction boundaries with adjacent third party work.

• Lead labor force planning: build and maintain the manpower curve, assess regional craft availability, and set the craft housing, per diem, and local hire strategy with construction contractors.

• Define, procure, and manage early works packages such as clearing, grading, drainage, stormwater controls, temporary power and water, site security, and aggregate sourcing.

• Support contractor selection with construction execution evaluation, mobilization readiness reviews, and schedule realism assessments.

• Serve as Atlas's designated construction representative to construction contractors for assigned projects or stages, including weekly construction meetings, look ahead reviews, and issue escalation.

• Direct assigned Construction Managers and field staff, set daily reporting and progress verification standards, and assign coverage across projects, stages, and buildings.

• Verify contractor progress against the schedule and recommend or withhold pay application approval in coordination with Project Controls and QA/QC.

• Coordinate field changes, RFIs, and design clarifications between construction contractors and engineering, and ensure dispositions are timely and documented.

• Coordinate major equipment delivery, installation, and care, custody, and control transfer with the CFE Logistics & Materials Coordinator and construction contractors.

• Monitor manpower, productivity, and schedule recovery plans and hold contractors to commitments.

• Enforce Atlas safety expectations on site for all contractors, review incident reports, and exercise stop work authority.

• Coordinate permit conditions affecting construction (stormwater, air, county, and utility) with the permitting consultant and ensure they are reflected in construction scopes and field practice.

• Lead mechanical completion walkdowns and the construction to commissioning turnover of each system with the Systems Completion & Turnover Coordinator.

• Review contractor claims, notices, and change requests with the Contracts function and provide construction fact finding.

• Report construction status, risks, and decisions needed to the Director and project leadership.

• Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Required:

• Bachelor of Science in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent field experience

• 15 or more years of construction experience on large industrial or power projects, including at least 5 years in a senior construction management role

• Demonstrated experience as an owner's representative over construction contractors on projects over $500 million

• Experience across the full construction lifecycle, from site development and early works through execution and turnover to commissioning

• Experience managing multi building or multi phase construction with large craft workforces

• Working knowledge of civil, structural, mechanical, and electrical construction for industrial or power generation facilities

• Experience with progress verification, pay application review, and construction change management

• Ability to lead a team of managers and to hold contractors accountable while maintaining working relationships

• Effective verbal and written communication with executives, contractors, landowners, public agencies, and customers

• Ability and willingness to be site based for extended periods

• Valid Driver's License

• Preferred:

• Reciprocating engine, gas turbine, or battery storage power plant construction experience

• Experience planning and executing site development and early works packages ahead of main contractor mobilization

• Experience on behind the meter or islanded generation projects with a customer presence on site

• Pipeline or utility lateral construction exposure

• OSHA 30 or equivalent construction safety training

• Professional Engineer license or Certified Construction Manager (CCM)

Reporting Relationship:

• Reports To: Director of Construction & Commissioning

• Supervisory Responsibilities: Yes - directs the Project Managers and Construction Managers assigned to facility construction

Work Location & Travel Requirements

• Location: West Texas project site with periodic travel to the Austin, TX office

• Work Environment: Field; active construction and industrial plant environments, including work around energized equipment, heavy equipment, and operating machinery

• Travel %: Site based during active construction; 10-25% travel to the Austin office and other project sites

Schedule/Work Arrangement: Full-Time

Physical Demands:

• Regular use of hands to handle, finger, and reach tools, test equipment, and materials

• Required to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb as needed, including work at elevation on ladders, scaffolds, and equipment platforms

• Must regularly lift and/or move up to 50 pounds, and heavier items with appropriate assistance or mechanical aids

• Required vision abilities include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus

• Must be able to work in and around energized electrical equipment while wearing required personal protective equipment

• Must be able to tolerate conditions associated with field and construction environments, including heat, cold, dust, noise, and limited climate control

How You Will Stand Out

• You have run construction on a billion dollar job and you know what the fourth month looks like before it arrives.

• You get involved in the front end because you know the execution problems are created there.

• You verify progress in the field, not in the pay application.

• You hold contractors to their word without burning the relationship you need next month.

• You hand systems to commissioning complete, with records, and on the date you said.

• You work as one team with your peer Senior Construction Manager, and contractors never hear two Atlas answers.

What You Will Love About Us

• Best People and Team. Great Place to Work , Hire Vets, Top Place to Work For – Austin American Statesman

• Your Well-Being is a Priority. 100% covered Medical, Dental, and Vision

• Invest in Your Future. 401K with company match, immediate vesting

• Relax and Recharge. Paid time off (non-rotational roles), 15+ company paid holidays

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Reasonable Accommodation

jobs.title: Sr. Spacecraft Vibration Test Engineer
jobs.description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Job Description:

This position is based in Midland, Texas. The successful candidate will be a structural dynamics engineer with deep experience defining, directing and reporting on swept sine vibration testing of spacecraft.  This includes understanding how to specify test levels, instrumentation locations, and especially how to implement response and force limiting.  Understanding laboratory equipment used in this type of testing is mandatory.  Adjacent testing skills in random vibration, acoustic, and shock is valuable.  Some proficiency in Nastran analysis is desired.

AST is looking for talented professionals who are innovative, creative, and ready to challenge the status quo.  The successful candidate will have strong communication skills and be able to work independently on complex problems.

Responsibilities:

• Determine sine vibration base input levels and author sine vibration test plans

• Serve as Test Director for sine vibration testing; working with test lab personnel to ensure proper test runs are conducted in a timely manner

• Ability to work with existing team and learn current processes

• Report on testing, including preparing launch vehicle tailored summaries

• Prepare for test readiness by working across disciplines during the spacecraft integration

• Participate in material and failure review boards

• Compile lessons learned and lead continuous process improvement

Minimum Qualifications & Experience:

• BS degree in Mechanical Engineering or related technical field

• Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience in swept sine vibration of spacecraft:

• Test Planning and Instrumentation selection

• Test Readiness

• Test Level definition

• Data Validation

• Base Input Control

• Notching and Overshoots

• Test Reporting

• Demonstrated ability to work in a multidisciplinary team with other engineers.

• Flexibility/adaptability in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent English written and verbal communication skills.

• Must be a US Person for ITAR requirements

Minimum Technical Skillset:

• Strong knowledge of MS Excel and Matlab

• SDOF system response to vibration and other closed form techniques

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. Product Sales are deep functional and technical specialists who lead and advise on Stripe's most strategic and complex deals. This team sits at the intersection of Stripe's highest-leverage growth areas: the Link consumer network, Financial Connections, Optimized Checkout Suite, and alternative payment methods including bank payments and BNPLs. jobs.title: Social Worker (MSW)
jobs.description:
About Seen Health

At Seen Health, we are revolutionizing the way senior care is delivered through the PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) model. Backed by top VCs, Seen Health is a culturally-focused, technology-enabled healthcare organization that integrates comprehensive medical care and social support with a high-touch, interdisciplinary approach.

Our mission is to empower seniors to age-in-place with dignity and provide their families peace of mind. We are building upon a proven Home and community based services model to create a culturally-competent and scalable PACE program. We are also building a comprehensive operating system focused on data and workflows that span across systems, processes, people, and care contexts. We want to empower our clinicians and staff with tools that deliver relevant data at the time and site of care and enable them to deliver exceptional care to our participants, which improve clinical outcomes, participant & provider satisfaction, and ultimately our strength as an organization.

We are a mission-driven, multidisciplinary team with deep healthcare, technology, and operations expertise, each inspired by our own personal stories of caring for seniors in our lives. Our name, Seen Health, was chosen to reflect our commitment to provide the highest standard of care to underserved older adults while respecting and incorporating their individual beliefs, heritage, and values, so that they can truly be seen.

About the Role

The Social Worker plans, organizes and implements social work services to participants and their caregivers in accordance with Seen Health policies and all applicable regulations. As an integral member of an Interdisciplinary Team, the social worker performs psychosocial assessments, develops and implements plans of care, conducts counseling and case management, and facilitates communication between the participant, family, caregivers, PACE staff, and provider support network, as appropriate.

Responsibilities

• Conduct Social Work assessments to determine the psychosocial needs, preferences and goals of the participants and actively participate in IDT meetings to develop participant care plans.

• Deliver and document social work interventions as agreed upon in the participants’ care plans including but not limited to arranging necessary resources and services, assisting with care transitions, providing individual as well as group counseling and case management.

• Completes initial assessments, re-assessments, and care plan updates for participants while continually evaluating the participants' social service needs and caregiver support needs.

• Participates in regularly scheduled behavioral management meetings with other mental health professionals.

• Work with the primary care physician and other members of the care team to guide smooth care transitions between settings (e.g., hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, home, etc.).

• Assists physician, or intermediate care provider, and other team members in understanding the significant social and emotional factors related to participant health problems.

• Acts as a resource to other team members and staff regarding topics such as dementia, difficult behaviors, and difficult personalities. Supports the IDT in establishing behavior management plans.

• Strive for continuous growth and development of cultural competency exhibiting an understanding, awareness, and respect for diversity.

• Maintains accurate and timely documentation and paperwork including participants’ electronic medical records according to policies and procedures.

• Provides referral support to community resources and participates in inter-agency coordination of care.

• Develops and maintains working relationships with community agencies, such as the Department of Social Services, psychiatric facilities, skilled nursing facilities, hospitals, social agencies, and may participate in hospital and/or SNF discharge planning.

• Initiate, coordinate and facilitate care conference meetings to ensure the highest level of care coordination among other care team members, participants, and other people within the participants’ support network (family, informal caregivers etc.).

• Responds to, investigates, and reports complaints of elder abuse.

• Maintains the confidentiality of all company procedures, results and information about participants, clients or families in conformance with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability (HIPAA) principles.

• Active contributor and change agent to continuously achieve quality care, participant experience and compliance goals.

• Proactively supports participant grievance and incident reporting processes.

• Completes timely discharge planning.

• Conducts home visits and travel to hospital facilities and/or other community agency, as needed.

• Participate in state and federal audit preparation activities.

• Performs related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Master’s degree from a school of social work accredited by the Council on Social Work Education.

• Minimum one year experience working with frail and elderly population. (3+ years social work experience preferred).

• Experience conducting psychosocial assessments, care planning and case management skills required.

• Demonstrated ability to work in a multicultural and multidisciplinary team environment.

• Excellent oral and verbal communication and meeting facilitation skills.

• Previous experience assisting persons with behavioral health & substance abuse issues, preferred.

• Current CPR certification or the ability to obtain CPR certification is required.

• Require personal transportation, current state issued driver’s license, good driving record and auto insurance as required by law.

• Bilingual required - Mandarin and/or Cantonese

Location

• Los Angeles required.

• On Site at Seen Health in Alhambra; home and community facility visits as needed.

• Relocation benefits available.

Salary & Benefits

• Salary: $90K - $110K / year

• Equity: may be included as part of team package

• Benefits: Seen Health is proud to offer a robust benefits offering for our employees. In addition to traditional healthcare coverage, we also offer additional benefits to help further your wellness and feeling of being part of the team. Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family Life Insurance and Disability Benefits Parental and Caregiver Leave Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized Paid Time Off across holidays, vacation time, personal days, and sick days 401k Plan Personal and professional development, including CME support and career growth opportunities Subscriptions and training on using AI tools including ChatGPT

jobs.title: Senior IT & Security Engineer (Robotics)
jobs.description:
The Company
We believe general-purpose, generally-intelligent robots will be built in our lifetimes. Robots will work in our factories, move our goods, walk on our streets and eventually be in our homes. To build that future, research and deployment must work in lockstep: real-world operation must make the technology better and better technology must make deployment easier. We're looking for the thinkers, builders, and researchers who want to be part of that loop.
As an AI robotics company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, on state-of-the-art hardware, every line of code written at Tutor has a direct impact on the global, physical economy.
Our Culture
We believe that something truly special can happen when talented, motivated people work together; at Tutor, every member of our team is empowered to have real impact in everything that they do. We're characterized by both technical excellence and next-level collaboration and respect.
About the Role
Our robots run inside customer facilities, on customer networks. Each of those customers has an IT and security team, and they need someone at Tutor who can work with them directly. We're looking for a senior engineer to be that person and to own the systems behind the conversation: the network between our office and the robots in the field, the identity and device infrastructure the company runs on, and our security and SOC 2 program.
This is an ownership role. You would be the first person at Tutor whose full-time job is shared IT and security infrastructure, with the authority to change it. Most of the work is planned: moving a system from where it is to where it should be. Some of it is interrupt-driven: a site loses connectivity, a customer sends a security questionnaire, someone reports a vulnerability. Part of the job is setting up the routing so those interrupts reach the right person quickly.
A significant portion of this role involves working with AI coding agents. You'll direct agents to audit configurations, collect compliance evidence, triage alerts, and carry out multi-step infrastructure tasks. Knowing how to scope work for an agent, review its output critically, and build tooling that agents can use effectively is as important as doing the work yourself.

jobs.title: Revenue and Billing Operations Manager
jobs.description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM's Finance team keeps revenue and billing accurate, automated, and audit-ready as the company scales. As our Revenue and Billing Operations Manager, you will own the billing function and be a key contributor to revenue accounting, building scalable processes, replacing manual work with automation, and ensuring our records and controls are always audit-ready. You’ll have the opportunity to shape the function from a lean base—deciding what to automate, building the right controls, and creating processes that can scale with TRM.

The Impact You Will Have:

 - Automate manual billing work, reconciliations, invoice generation, exception flagging, and data validation, building AI-assisted workflows and owning the review and controls that ensure accuracy and audit readiness.

 - Strengthen revenue accounting so our records are accurate and consistently audit-ready, using AI to accelerate reconciliations and documentation while you verify what touches the books.

 - Evaluate and implement billing solutions that fit how TRM works, using AI to compare options, assess tradeoffs, and model impact.

 - Build a prioritized automation roadmap: decide what to automate first and next, and measure the time it gives back to the team.

 - Build scalable, resilient billing processes that keep pace with growth and reduce key-person dependency.

 - Partner with Sales, Legal, and Accounting to evaluate how contracts and policies are structured and their downstream billing impact.

What We're Looking For:

 - Demonstrated AI fluency: you can identify which finance processes to automate, build the workflows, and articulate where AI output must be verified before it is trusted.

 - Senior experience across revenue accounting and billing operations.

 - Hands-on experience leading the evaluation and implementation of billing solutions and automating billing or finance processes.

 - Experience leading external audits and building and maintaining audit-ready processes and controls.

 - Strategic judgment on automation sequencing and designing effective, scalable controls.

 - A hands-on, builder mindset: you’re comfortable operating in the details, solving problems directly, and doing the work yourself as part of a lean team.

 - Clear cross-functional communication with Sales, Legal, and Accounting.

About the Team:

 - Finance is lean and fast-moving; this role adds senior capacity and redundancy to revenue and billing.

 - You will have real ownership and the mandate to modernize the function, not just maintain it.

 - The work is demanding: doing more with less, ahead of a first-year audit, on a team that moves fast.

Team Operating Rhythms:

 - The team is distributed, not distant, with strong async communication and US working-hours overlap.

 - Close collaboration with Sales/Deal Desk, Accounting, and Legal.

Learn About TRM Speed:

 - Within the first 90 days, automate at least one high-volume manual billing process end to end with documented controls.

 - In the first 30 days, map the full revenue and billing process and identify the top automation opportunities.

 - Within the first two quarters, deliver an audit-ready improvement to revenue accounting ahead of the first-year audit.


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.




WHAT TO EXPECT FROM OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

 - Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

 - Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/interviewing-at-trm-how-we-hire-and-what-success-looks-like




LIFE AT TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

 - Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

 - Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

 - A high level of personal ownership and accountability

 - Close collaboration across teams and functions

 - Frequent, high-touch communication

 - Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

 - A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/interviewing-at-trm-how-we-hire-and-what-success-looks-like 

 


AI FLUENCY AT TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

 - Accelerate repeatable workflows

 - Structure and solve problems

 - Improve output quality

 - Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.




LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

 - Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

 - Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

 - Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.





JOIN OUR MISSION

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/refactoring-podcast/id1719137305?i=1000790467591.





PRIVACY POLICY AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy https://www.trmlabs.com/policies/privacy-policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. jobs.title: Revenue Operations & Strategy Lead (backed by Y Combinator, $5M+ ARR, $23M+ raised)
jobs.description:
🧠 ABOUT LEGION HEALTH

At Legion Health https://legionhealth.com/, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications https://nypost.com/2026/03/27/business/artificial-intelligence-can-now-prescribe-mental-health-drugs/, allowing us to collapse both administrative and clinical labor costs while expanding access to care.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of visits in just two years while holding operations costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.




📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

 - Job Type: Full-Time

 - Role Type: Revenue Operations / Commercial Strategy / Provider Partnerships / Sales

 - Ideal Experience Level: 3+ years, or an equivalent record of scope and impact

 - Location: Onsite in San Francisco, CA

 - US Visa Sponsorship: No




🚀 THE OPPORTUNITY

Legion is hiring a Revenue Operations & Strategy Lead to build and operate the commercial system behind Provider Partnerships and referral growth. You will connect our growth goals to territories, account priorities, capacity, incentives, systems, data, workflows, and the decisions our field team makes every day.

This is the commercial side of revenue operations—not billing or revenue-cycle management. You will report to the Head of Provider Partnerships and begin as a senior individual contributor and player-coach across three connected areas: Planning & Performance; Revenue Systems, Data & Automation; and Provider Partnership Operations. As the business grows, you will help determine when those capabilities should become separate roles and build the function ahead of need.

This is also not a reporting-only job. You should be comfortable moving from an ambiguous commercial question to a recommendation, model, dashboard, workflow, or system that people actually adopt. The measure of success is the productivity, predictability, and quality of decisions you enable—not the number of reports you produce.

You will work closely with Provider Partnerships, Growth, Patient Operations, Finance, Product, Engineering, and People. The right person combines rigorous commercial judgment with hands-on systems ability and stays accountable from diagnosis through implementation.




✅ RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

 - Own commercial planning and forecasting, connecting referral-growth targets to market opportunity, territory coverage, rep capacity, productivity, ramp time, and hiring needs.

 - Design territory, account-segmentation, tiering, and target-account methodologies that concentrate field time on the highest-value provider and practice opportunities.

 - Build scenario models that help leadership decide when to enter markets, add capacity, change coverage, or invest in new programs.

 - Develop quota and incentive methodology, administer attainment reconciliation, and give Alex and Finance decision-ready recommendations with clear controls and economics.

 - Own CRM governance and the commercial data model across providers, practices, contacts, activities, territories, partnership status, referrals, attribution, and forecasts.

 - Define the KPI framework and build trusted dashboards for territory health, activity, conversion, signed practices, first referrals, recurring referral volume, productivity, and risk.

 - Set and execute the commercial technology, automation, and AI roadmap. Evaluate tools, lead implementation, simplify workflows, establish governance, and measure adoption and business impact.

 - Improve the end-to-end Provider Partnerships process from market and account selection through signed partnership, practice launch, first referral, and recurring account growth.

 - Serve as the operating liaison between Provider Partnerships and Growth or Patient Operations when referral handoffs, patient-conversion issues, provider updates, or recurring workflow problems require cross-functional resolution.

 - Establish the operating cadence for forecasts, pipeline and referral reviews, territory performance, quarterly business reviews, and annual planning.

 - Lead cross-functional changes from problem framing through decision, implementation, adoption, and measurable results, with clear owners and durable handoffs.

 - Define the future Revenue Operations & Strategy organization, operating standards, and hiring plan; recruit and develop the team as scale and complexity justify it.




🏆 YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU…

 - Give leadership an accurate, forward-looking view of growth, capacity, productivity, and risk—and bring a recommendation when the numbers change.

 - Make territory, hiring, quota, incentive, and market-expansion decisions repeatable and grounded in shared assumptions.

 - Increase Provider Partnerships Manager productivity by focusing field time on the right practices, reducing administrative friction, and improving ramp.

 - Create a CRM, dashboard, and operating cadence that field teams trust because it is useful, current, and simple enough to maintain.

 - Achieve high referral-attribution coverage, strong data integrity, fast exception resolution, and reliable provider-update service levels.

 - Turn decisions into adopted workflows across Provider Partnerships, Growth, Operations, Finance, Product, and Engineering without dropped handoffs.

 - Build systems and capabilities ahead of the moment they would otherwise constrain growth.

 - Surface important risks early, explain the underlying drivers clearly, and stay accountable until the issue is resolved.




🧰 IDEAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS

 - 7+ years of experience, or an equivalent record of impact, across revenue operations, commercial operations, strategy and operations, business operations, consulting, finance, or another highly analytical operating role.

 - A track record of owning complex, ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through implementation, adoption, and measurable business results.

 - Exceptional analytical and modeling ability across forecasting, capacity planning, territory design, resource allocation, scenario analysis, or performance management.

 - Working fluency with HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable commercial systems, plus comfort with spreadsheets, BI tools, SQL or SQL-adjacent analysis, and data-quality investigation.

 - Experience building practical operating processes and governance without creating unnecessary bureaucracy for the people doing the work.

 - Strong executive communication and judgment: you can turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation, decision, owner, and next step.

 - Experience driving change through influence and establishing accountability across functions.

 - Exposure to a field, territory-based, enterprise, marketplace, or other complex commercial model.

 - A hands-on, AI-native approach to work. You should be eager to use automation and agents to improve data quality, decision speed, seller productivity, and operating leverage.

 - High standards for accuracy, ownership, and follow-through, paired with low ego and comfort operating without perfect information.

 - Healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, value-based care, or provider-referral experience is helpful but not required.




💰 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $170,000 – $240,000 annual base salary, based on experience

 - Early-Stage Equity: Meaningful ownership in a category-defining company.

 - Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

 - Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, learning stipend, and AI tooling budget

 - Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

 - Work Setup: Full-time, onsite in San Francisco, with some travel for field and company meetings

 - Impact: Build the commercial operating system that helps more providers connect patients to Legion’s psychiatric care.

 - Autonomy and Learning: Own the models, systems, data, workflows, and operating cadence behind a rapidly scaling field organization.

 - Growth Opportunities: Build and lead the Revenue Operations & Strategy function as Legion scales.




📝 HOW TO APPLY AND HIRING PROCESS

 - Apply through this posting.

 - Overview of our hiring process:
   
   1. Resume + Application Screen
   
   2. Hiring Manager Interview
   
   3. Revenue Operations & Strategy Working Session
   
   4. Founder Interview
   
   5. Professional Reference Checks

 - Estimated time-to-hire: 2 weeks

 - Start date: ASAP

 - Hiring manager: Alex Carruth




🤝 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

In this role, you will provide technical oversight of Building Automation Systems and controls engineering for large-scale, mission-critical facility projects. You will review BAS submittals, controls schematics, sequences of operations, points lists, network architecture, and other engineering deliverables to ensure designs meet technical specifications and established controls standards. You will work closely with mechanical, electrical, facility engineering teams, vendors, and system integrators throughout design, construction, and commissioning, helping resolve RFIs and field issues and tracking design comments through closure. You will also support testing and validation activities, document design changes and lessons learned, and contribute to consistent BAS and controls standards across a global portfolio of hyperscale facility projects. The role offers exposure to large-scale data center build-outs and collaboration with an experienced global engineering organization

Responsibilities

• Review BAS submittals, engineering deliverables, controls schematics, sequences of operations, points lists, panel and device schedules, riser diagrams, and network architecture documentation.

• Provide technical oversight for building automation and controls design across large-scale, mission-critical facility projects.

• Review designs for quality, specification compliance, consistency, and alignment with established controls engineering standards.

• Support construction and commissioning activities by reviewing drawings, developing and executing testing scripts, validating system performance, and resolving technical issues.

• Track design comments through package revisions and closure, ensuring no outstanding technical issues remain at approval.

• Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, facility engineering teams, vendors, integrators, and other project stakeholders on design reviews, RFIs, field issues, and controls integration.

• Support hyperscale facility build-outs by reviewing BAS submittals and providing technical guidance throughout design, construction, and commissioning.

• Identify design risks and field issues and help drive timely technical resolution.

• Maintain documentation related to design changes, lessons learned, and controls engineering standards.

• Help improve consistency and standardization of BAS and controls designs across a global portfolio of projects.

• Communicate design intent, technical findings, and review comments clearly to internal stakeholders, vendors, and system integrators.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of Building Automation Systems (BAS) engineering experience.

• 5+ years of mission-critical, data center, or critical-facility construction experience.

• 5+ years of experience with major DDC platforms.

• Hands-on experience designing, programming, commissioning, or supporting BAS/DDC environments.

• Experience reviewing controls engineering documentation, including: Sequences of operations Controls schematics Points lists BAS submittals Network architecture diagrams Panel and device schedules

• Experience supporting commissioning, testing, system validation, issue resolution, or field implementation.

• Strong working knowledge of BACnet and Modbus.

• Working knowledge of DDC and PLC control systems.

• Working knowledge of HVAC, mechanical, and electrical systems as they relate to controls integration.

• Experience working with vendors, integrators, engineering teams, and other project stakeholders.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings and communicate design intent.

• Ability to collaborate across U.S. and APAC time zones, including occasional meetings outside standard U.S. working hours.

• Proficiency with relevant design/documentation tools such as AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and Visio.

Preferred Qualifications

• Controls engineering experience in mission-critical, data center, or other critical-facility environments.

• Experience supporting hyperscale data center design, construction, commissioning, or operations.

• Experience authoring, maintaining, or enforcing controls engineering standards across multiple projects.

• Familiarity with major DDC/BAS platforms and vendors, including: Siemens Johnson Controls Honeywell Automated Logic

• Previous experience working in a vendor, systems integrator, or consulting environment.

• Experience with global, multi-project engineering programs.

• Experience identifying lessons learned and incorporating them into future engineering standards and deployments.

• Experience reviewing technical deliverables for quality, consistency, and specification compliance.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Developer Experience (SDK)
jobs.description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

As the Product Manager for Developer Experience, you will be the champion for the developers building on top of Ping’s Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform. Your mission is to abstract the complexities of identity standards into a seamless, secure, and intuitive developer experience across web and mobile platforms. You will bridge the gap between deep identity architecture and elegant code, ensuring that "Time to First Integration" is as fast and frictionless as possible.

In this role, you will pioneer both human and agent-first engineering for identity. You will ensure our SDKs, APIs, and tooling are optimized not just for human engineers, but for autonomous AI agents and code assistants executing end-to-end integration workflows. You will bridge the gap between deep identity architecture and elegant code, ensuring that "Time to First Integration" is fast and frictionless.

What You'll Do:

• Drive Developer Adoption: Own the product strategy and roadmap for Ping’s Orchestration SDK across Web, iOS, Android, and Hybrid frameworks, turning complex IAM capabilities into highly adoptable developer tools.

• Champion Developer Experience (DX): Partner with the technical documentation and developer relations teams to deliver world-class documentation, quick-start guides, and sample apps that developers love to use.

• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Work closely with core Engineering and PM teams across the organization to ensure the SDK seamlessly exposes new identity capabilities and aligns with broader platform releases.

• Gather Developer Insights: Actively engage with customers, partner engineers, and the open-source community to gather technical requirements, map developer journeys, and translate feedback into a prioritized backlog.

• Evangelize the Product: Write technical blog posts, participate in developer forums, and create content that highlights SDK capabilities and modern integration patterns.

• Execute the Vision: Manage the product lifecycle from concept to release, maintaining a well-groomed backlog, defining clear success metrics (e.g., SDK adoption, integration time), and ruthlessly prioritizing high-impact work.

• Stay Ahead of the Curve: Continuously monitor evolving app development trends (e.g., Swift/Kotlin updates, cross-platform frameworks like Flutter/React Native) and next-generation identity standards to keep Ping’s SDK cutting-edge.

• Incorporate AI-Focused Mindset: Seek to make mobile and web app integration more effective by staying ahead on AI-related trends (e.g., Agent Skills) as well as broader developer experience how that relates to agents and developers.

• Contribute to wider developer-experience: Constantly assess how to improve Ping’s developer-experience holistically, contributing to wider forums and championing original ideas.

What You Bring:

• Technical Fluency & Engineering Roots: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. You have hands-on experience building software and can speak the same language as the developers using your SDK.

• Identity Domain Expertise: A solid understanding of modern identity and security protocols, specifically OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and FIDO/WebAuthn.

• Strong Developer Empathy: A keen product sense for "clean code" and developer ergonomics. You understand what makes an API intuitive, a library reliable, and documentation actually useful.

• AI-Native Development Experience: Experience using AI-assisted software development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar as part of day-to-day engineering or product workflows. Understands how modern AI coding agents interact with SDKs, APIs, documentation, and developer tooling, and can identify opportunities to optimize products for both human developers and AI agents.

• Exceptional Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex architectural concepts into clear product requirements for engineering, and compelling narratives for external stakeholders.

• Strategic Execution: Experience defining and executing a product roadmap based on market trends, competitive analysis, and customer feedback while managing a product backlog in an agile environment, balancing immediate developer friction points with long-term platform scalability.

You have an Advantage if:

• You have experience using client side SDKs and REST APIs

• You have excellent communication skills

• Deep understanding of Identity and access management standards

• Agentic Framework Familiarity: Exposure to or strong interest in emerging agentic infrastructure tools, AI software development loops (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot Workspace), and standard machine-to-machine interaction protocols like MCP.

Compensation Range:  $130,000–165,000

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

This role goes beyond day-to-day management — you will establish architectural standards, drive automation-first platform design, and ensure thousands of builders have secure, reliable tools to do their best work. From strengthening our security posture in a complex hybrid environment to mentoring senior engineers, you will shape the technical foundation that powers innovation at Roblox.

You Will:

• Standardize the global security and management strategy for our entire fleet of macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and ChromeOS devices to ensure peak performance and ironclad compliance.

• Evolve of our deployment pipeline, driving the automated rollout of patches, OS upgrades, and complex certificate lifecycles for all endpoints.

• Lead the hardening of our endpoint security posture, partnering with InfoSec to architect automated remediation workflows and deploying advanced observability tools like CrowdStrike, and Kolide.

jobs.title: Creative Lead, X
jobs.description:
About Us

Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations.

About the Role

We are hiring a Creative Lead X to own our presence on the platform end to end, with our Threads presence run as part of the same seat. This role reports to the Head of Social Content, with a dotted line to the Chief Communications Officer, and works alongside our video, editorial, and talent teams to grow one of the most-followed accounts on the platform and shape how the brand shows up in real time.

What You’ll Do

• Own the publishing calendar end to end: write, package, and ship daily posts, with purpose-built rollouts for every video premiere, product drop, and announcement.

• Watch every video, select the clips built to travel on the platform, and brief editors on cutdowns and captions.

• Adapt content for Threads and its distinct audience.

• Run real-time engagement: replies, community interaction, and jumping on the right trend moments same-day.

• Grow reach beyond our own accounts through the platform's wider creator and community ecosystem.

• Craft branded and partner content that performs like our organic content.

• Partner closely with on-camera talent, brand, and communications teams to keep publishing fast, on voice, and on brand.

• Coordinate with our YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Shorts teams so major launches hit together while X keeps its own distinct voice.

• Monitor conversation and sentiment around the brand, amplifying positive momentum and flagging what needs attention.

• Track performance daily, test constantly, and translate platform data into weekly and monthly reporting that drives decisions

What We’re Looking For

• 4 to 8 years running social media with X or Twitter as your primary platform, and at least 2 years as the named owner of a large account (1M+ followers).

• You have worked somewhere real-time is the job: a sports league, team, or broadcaster; a major media or streaming brand; a gaming or esports organization; a top creator or entertainment company; or a consumer brand known specifically for X excellence.

• You write exceptional short-form copy in a distinctive voice and can show posts you wrote that traveled, with the numbers behind them.

• You have run live coverage under pressure: game days, premieres, launches, or breaking moments, with fast approval loops.

• You are clip-native: you can cut short-form video yourself or brief editors with precision, and you know the difference between a clip that travels and one that doesn't. This is not a pure writing role.

• You understand how content spreads on the platform, including the creator and community pages that drive distribution, and ideally you bring relationships in that world.

• You work well with stakeholders: you know how to keep brand, communications, and leadership aligned while moving at the speed the platform demands.

• You are fluent in platform analytics and testing, and you make publishing decisions from data, not instinct alone.

• You live on these platforms, you understand internet culture at a native level, and your judgment holds up at speed.

Benefits

The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team

We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen.

• Competitive Salary

• Generous Medical (Blue Cross Blue Shield), Dental, Vision and company-paid Life Insurance

• Company contributions to employee Health Savings Accounts (HSA)

• 401k Plan with Safe Harbor company-matching

• Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays

• Company-provided technology package

• Relocation assistance where applicable, including travel and company-provided housing for the first 90 days

jobs.title: Social Work Assistant
jobs.description:
About Seen Health

At Seen Health, we are revolutionizing the way senior care is delivered through the PACE (Programs of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly) model. Backed by top VCs, Seen Health is a culturally-focused, technology-enabled healthcare organization that integrates comprehensive medical care and social support with a high-touch, interdisciplinary approach.

Our mission is to empower seniors to age-in-place with dignity and provide their families peace of mind. We are building upon a proven Home and community based services model to create a culturally-competent and scalable PACE program. We are also building a comprehensive operating system focused on data and workflows that span across systems, processes, people, and care contexts. We want to empower our clinicians and staff with tools that deliver relevant data at the time and site of care and enable them to deliver exceptional care to our participants, which improve clinical outcomes, participant & provider satisfaction, and ultimately our strength as an organization.

We are a mission-driven, multidisciplinary team with deep healthcare, technology, and operations expertise, each inspired by our own personal stories of caring for seniors in our lives. Our name, Seen Health, was chosen to reflect our commitment to provide the highest standard of care to underserved older adults while respecting and incorporating their individual beliefs, heritage, and values, so that they can truly be seen.

About the Role

The Social Work Assistant is responsible for assisting and managing a caseload of participants working in close coordination with the Seen Health Interdisciplinary Team  (IDT) and Social Worker. The Social Work Assistant functions as a liaison between the  participants, their family members, and the IDT assist participants by offering advice, implementing treatment plans, coordinating community services, and completing necessary  paperwork. The Social Work Assistant collaborates effectively with colleagues and  stakeholders to promote the Seen Health values, team culture and mission.

Responsibilities

• Assist Social Workers (MSWs) with daily tasks that may arise. Escalate to MSW or identified appropriate staff member as needed.

• Establish rapport with participants and families to provide psychosocial support.

• Complete IDT care plan reviews with participants and family members within regulatory time frames.

• Deliver and document social work interventions as agreed upon in the participants’ care plans including but not limited to check in calls, arranging necessary resources and services, and assisting with care transitions, and case management.

• Participate in IDT adhoc and care conference meetings to provide input, and function as the administrative support to MSW to include transcribing meeting notes and documentation as needed.

• Remain alert to pertinent input from other team members, participants, and caregivers and update the IDT/Social Worker promptly of any changes in participants’ condition or psychosocial status.

• Connect participants or families with social and community services. Arrange meetings with relevant agencies, while serving as the advocate for our participants every step of the process.

• Assist with completing grievances, appeals incident reports, APS reports, and other quality and compliance requirements as needed.

• Maintain an up-to-date roster of relevant agencies.

• Complete discharge planning with participants and or family members when participants disenroll from the program, present to IDT, and provide appropriate documentation to medical records timely.

• Provide administrative support to MSW for educational in-services to staff, participants, and caregivers/families regarding psychosocial aspects of aging and related issues

• Participate in end-of-life care coordination and support.

• Conduct home visits, hospital visits, skilled nursing visits, as necessary.

• Demonstrate ability to assist participant or family member with completion of identified application and community assistant programs. Will include but limited to benefit renewals, housing, DMV needs, utility bills, and other community support needs.

• Complete all required documentation in a timely and accurate manner.

• Protect privacy and maintain confidentiality of all company procedures and information about team members, participants, and families.

• Follow Seen Health policies and procedures and participate in any required Quality Improvement activities, staff training and meetings.

Qualifications

• High School Diploma or Equivalency.

• Associate’s Degree in Social Work, Human Services, Social Science, or relevant field preferred.

• Valid State Driver’s License with a clean DMV record.

• Minimum one year experience working with frail and elderly population. (3+ years social work experience preferred).

• Experience conducting psychosocial assessments, care planning and case management skills preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to work in a multicultural and multidisciplinary team environment.

• Excellent oral and verbal communication and meeting facilitation skills

• Previous experience assisting persons with behavioral health & substance abuse issues, preferred.

• Bilingual ability preferred (Mandarin / Cantonese)

• Current CPR certification or the ability to obtain CPR certification is required.

• Require personal transportation, current state issued driver’s license, good driving record and auto insurance as required by law.

Location

• Los Angeles required.

• On Site at Seen Health in Alhambra; home and community facility visits as needed.

Salary & Benefits

• Salary: hourly rate of $20-$27 / hour depending on experience.

• Equity: included as part of founding team package.

• Benefits: Seen Health is proud to offer a robust benefits offering for our employees. In addition to traditional healthcare coverage, we also offer additional benefits to help further your wellness and feeling of being part of the team. Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family Life Insurance and Disability Benefits Parental and Caregiver Leave Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized Paid Time Off across holidays, vacation time, personal days, and sick days 401k Plan Personal and professional development, including CME support and career growth opportunities Subscriptions and training on using AI tools including ChatGPT
