jobs.title: Senior Technical Editor
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

Services Technical Publications provides the foundation for every procedure performed on Intuitive's advanced medical devices by the global Field Service team. Our content is authored in DITA and delivered through guided workflows, which progressively discloses content for field service technicians install, maintain, and repair Intuitive systems.

In this role, you will combine expert editing skills with strategic thinking to develop and implement a comprehensive quality metrics program. You will work directly with technical writers, product teams, and stakeholders to ensure that hardware and software documentation meets our highest standards for clarity, accuracy, consistency, and usability within guided, step-by-step workflows.

As an individual contributor with significant influence and authority, your success will be measured by your ability to drive quality improvements and positive outcomes through collaboration, coaching, and strategic program development—not through direct management, but through leadership and expertise.

Essential Job Duties

• Edit hardware and software technical documentation for clarity, accuracy, consistency, voice, tone, and usability. Champion minimalist, task-based writing principles to ensure content serves the immediate needs of field service technicians. Work directly with authors and SMEs to improve content quality across the publication lifecycle.
• Make edits directly in IXIA, our component content management system, collaborating with technical writers and subject matter experts through the review workflow to implement changes efficiently. Comfort navigating the system and driving content improvements end-to-end.
• Develop and own a quality metrics program that establishes baselines, identifies improvement opportunities, and measures impact. Use data-driven insights to guide editorial strategy and demonstrate ROI of editing services.
• Design and implement best practices for technical content quality. Create scalable processes, guidelines, and checklists that enable teams to self-serve and maintain consistency without bottlenecking editorial review.
• Lead training and coaching initiatives. Educate writers on minimalism, task-based authoring, topic-based writing principles, style, and grammar standards. Establish regular office hours, workshops, or feedback sessions to build writer capability and confidence.
• Configure and integrate content quality tools (Acrolinx, Congree, Grammarly, or similar) into the publication workflow. Recommend technology solutions that enhance quality without creating friction for authors.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including product, UX, localization, and publishing—to align on quality standards and resolve editorial challenges.

Required Skills and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
• 7+ years of professional editing experience in technical communications, with demonstrated expertise editing DITA-authored content for both hardware and software products.
• Deep expertise in minimalist and task-based, topic-based authoring approaches. Demonstrated ability to coach authors on these principles and evaluate content for adherence to minimalist standards.
• Proficiency with IXIA or similar component content management systems (CCMS). Ability to navigate the system, make edits directly, and move content through review workflows independently.
• Experience developing or implementing editorial guidelines, style guides, or content quality standards. Comfort with creating scalable, repeatable processes.
• Proficiency with quality assurance tools such as Acrolinx, Congree, Grammarly, or equivalent. Ability to evaluate tools and troubleshoot configuration issues.
• Proven ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both in written and spoken formats. Skill in explaining complex editorial feedback in a way that educates rather than demoralizes.
• Experience working with metrics, data collection, or quality measurement. Comfort with analyzing trends and using data to support recommendations.
• Ability to influence and drive outcomes without direct authority. Success collaborating with subject matter experts, product teams, and writers who may not report to you.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with medical device, surgical instrument, or other regulated/high-stakes technical documentation.
• Familiarity with content management systems, publishing workflows, or localization processes.
• Experience training or coaching other writers or editors.
• Understanding of how DITA-authored content serves guided workflows with progressive disclosure, and how editing decisions impact both user experience and compliance.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description:
About the company
Kodex revolutionizes how organizations handle sensitive subpoenas and data requests from law enforcement and government agencies. Founded by a former FBI agent and backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, Peak XV and Thiel Capital, Kodex has become the industry standard for secure data exchange. Our platform supports over 15,000 government agencies in 190 countries and is trusted by industry leaders like Coinbase, Stripe, and AT&T. 

By transforming a traditionally complex and manual process into a streamlined digital workflow, Kodex helps organizations strengthen compliance, enhance security, and reduce operational costs by millions each year. We bridge the gap between companies and authorized requestors, ensuring that sensitive data is handled with uncompromising security, transparency, and efficiency.



The Role

Kodex is hiring our second recruiter to work across the full surface area of the business. You’ll own your reqs end-to-end from day one, and report directly to our Founding Recruiter as we scale.

Our search bench spans it all: threat intelligence specialists, go-to-market and customer-facing roles, and increasingly technical seats on engineering teams. This is not a coordinator role or a specialist seat — you'll run full-cycle recruiting on any roles thrown your way.

This is a rare seat. Kodex created the category we work in: lawful data exchange between the public and private sectors, and the need only grows as the tech landscape shifts. The team you help hire here will be the one that defines this space.

We're building with velocity: rapid product launches, expansion into new verticals, top-tier venture backing, and strong momentum. The recruiting function is high-visibility here — you'll partner with individual contributors and hiring managers across the org, and the quality of the people you help hire shows up directly in a product that has real-world impact for people who never touch it.

This is a U.S.-based remote role.



Responsibilities

 - Own your roles — full-cycle recruiting from intake through offer, across a shifting mix of GTM, customer, and technical searches

 - Partner with hiring managers — run intake calls, define profiles, calibrate on candidates, and drive the process end-to-end

 - Build roles and hiring plans in Ashby — you know your way around the tool and improve how we structure searches inside it, not just in intake conversations

 - Source creatively — you know how to build your own pipeline. Whether that's technical, strategic, network-driven, event-driven, or AI-assisted, you have a point of view on what works.

 - Screen and evaluate — recruiter screens, deep-dive assessments, candidate calibration

 - Manage offers and close — negotiate, build the pitch, get the yes



What You Bring

 - 3–5 years of full-cycle recruiting.

 - Series A / B or high-growth startup experience — this is not the seat for a FAANG or big-co recruiter. You've operated in real ambiguity and built process where none existed.

 - Owner mentality — you've launched reqs from scratch, built your own pipeline, and closed candidates without a team of coordinators behind you. You take a req from zero and see it through.

 - Ambition — this role is demanding. You're comfortable with velocity, high context-switching, and a search mix that shifts month to month.

 - Proven ability to ramp on new domains — you've picked up unfamiliar technical or specialized roles before and gotten to signal fast. You lean into learning.

 - Sharp candidate assessment — you form clear reads quickly and can articulate them

 - Excellent communication — with candidates, hiring managers, and in writing.



Big Pluses

 - Prior agency background before going in-house

 - Recruiting experience in regulated or sensitive-data industries (fintech, legaltech, security, govtech)

 - Experience recruiting for GTM roles (Sales, Customer Success, BDR) or technical roles (engineering, security, platform)

 - Fluency in Ashby — you know how to build roles, workflows, and interview plans inside the tool



Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or transfer employment visa sponsorship for this position.



Benefits

 - Remote-first within the U.S.

 - Offsites in exciting locations. Past trips include Seattle, Miami, Nashville, and San Francisco.

 - Competitive salary and meaningful equity

 - Unlimited Vacation plus 14 company holidays

 - 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, with a flexible return-to-work policy

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Dynamic Environment — you'll help build the team at a Series A that's actively defining a new market



Equal Employment Opportunities at the Company

Kodex is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds for all of its tech, non-tech, and leadership roles. Kodex believes that the gathering and celebration of unique backgrounds, qualities, and cultures enriches the workplace.

jobs.title: Entry-Level Water Resources Dam Safety Engineer

Preferred Qualifications:

• Ability and desire to occasionally travel to project sites, both local and remote. Valid U.S. Driver’s License and as a condition of employment, must be able to pass AECOM’s Motor Vehicle Records review.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Why Blee:

Blee is an AI-first marketing content compliance platform. PayPal, NerdWallet, and Brex already trust us. We're YC-backed, founded by an ex-Adobe marketing ops leader and former lawyer, and we're defining a category that didn't exist two years ago—across Fintech, Financial Services, CPG, Travel, and Life Sciences..






With offices in San Francisco and New York, we value in-person work but offer remote-opportunities for the right people. No matter where you join us, you can expect quarterly off-sites and opportunities to join other offices when you feel it’s important. You’ll be joining a team that values clarity, ownership, and shared responsibility—and is focused on building something that genuinely improves how teams work.



The Role

We're hiring our first product marketer to help name, shape, and own how this category gets understood—by buyers, by the market, and eventually by everyone else trying to compete in it.



You'll be the second marketer on the team, working directly with our Head of Marketing (who comes from content and brand in the compliance space and is hiring you specifically for the PMM craft she doesn't bring). You'll have unusual ownership: foundational messaging exists but is industry-agnostic, and making it land in financial services, healthcare, beauty, travel, and beyond is largely yours to figure out.



What You’ll Do

In your first six months, you'll rewrite our core narrative for our top three industries, build the ICP and persona work that sales is currently improvising around, and create the sales enablement layer from scratch—the decks, narratives, objection handling, and competitive positioning that don't exist yet in any usable form—and get close enough to customers that you can predict what they'll say before they say it.



After that, the job is whatever the company needs most—competitive positioning, sales enablement that actually gets used, launch playbooks, category-defining content. We'll figure it out together.

 - Own messaging and positioning across our core industries—financial services first, then healthcare, beauty, and beyond

 - Build the ICP and persona work for our split buyer/user dynamic (legal and compliance buy; marketing uses)

 - Create the sales enablement foundation from scratch—decks, narratives, one-pagers, objection handling, competitive positioning

 - Run a customer insight engine—regular conversations with customers and prospects that feed messaging, content, and product

 - Lead go-to-market for new product and feature launches as they come

 - Partner with content, social, events, and web to keep the story consistent everywhere it shows up



Who You Are

 - Five-plus years in B2B product marketing, with at least one tour at an early-stage company where you built from scratch rather than inheriting a playbook. You've sold to technical or regulated buyers before—legal, compliance, security, finance, infosec, something in that family. You know what it's like when the buyer and the user are different people with different incentives.

 - You write well. Not "marketing well"—actually well. You have opinions about language, you can tell the difference between a real insight and a reframed feature, and you've probably killed more decks than you've shipped.

 - You look past templated SaaS messaging and buzzwords to find the real narrative and you think most positioning could be much more bold. You have a point of view on what good looks like.

 - You're comfortable being the PMM voice in a room full of product, sales, and customer success people—and comfortable being wrong out loud when someone has a better idea
   
   

Bonus if you've done category creation before. Bigger bonus if you've worked in or around regulated industries.



#BI-Remote

How We Work:

We have offices in New York and San Francisco and value in-person collaboration, but we're open to remote for the right person. Wherever you're based, expect bi-annual off-sites and the chance to spend time in our other offices when it matters.



What You’ll Get:

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Bi-annual get-togethers

 - Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Free access to OneMedical (US Only)

 - Company-paid life insurance (US Only)

 - Company-sponsored 401k + matching  (US Only)

 - Flexible time off (with mandatory 15 days off)

 - Financial support for work-adjacent learning opportunities
   
   

Blee is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.



For roles based in the US, applicants must have authorization to work for any employer. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time



Beware of Imposter Recruiters and Job Scams

 - All official communication from our talent team will come from an @blee.com http://montecarlodata.com email address.

 - We will never ask candidates to provide sensitive personal information (such as bank details, social security numbers, or payment) at any stage of the recruitment process.

ALL ABOUT TARGET

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

ALL ABOUT HUMAN RESOURCES

You are a team that champions change, proactively removes roadblocks and builds diverse and inclusive talent strategies to deliver on our guest centric mission. You lead a team of HR Experts and Team Leaders (where applicable) that are committed to supporting teams and leaders to build a sales force that is passionate about exceeding guests’ expectations and a place where teams love to work. As the Executive Team Leader HR, most of your time is spent with the team and on the sales floor, being a consultant to your peers and seeing first-hand how you can continuously propel the business forward.

At Target, we believe in our team members having meaningful experiences that help them build and develop skills for a career. The role of a Human Resources Executive Team Leader can provide you with the:

• Experience creating and managing HR strategies and goals; delivering results through your team
• Ability to read financial reporting and interpret data
• Knowledge of federal, state and local employment laws
• Skills in recruiting, selecting and talent management of hourly team members and leaders
• Ability to support business leaders; coaching and consulting with them in growing the business and selecting and developing their teams
• Ability to influence across levels and partners (e.g. hourly team members, senior leaders)

As an Executive Team Leader Human Resources, no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will most likely include the following responsibilities:

• Lead and create a service culture that prioritizes the guest service experience, model, train, and coach expectations to deliver the service standard
• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias
• Drive total store sales, understand your role in sales growth and how your area and team contribute to and impact total store profitability
• Plan, lead and follow-up on organizational and operational change
• Anticipate and identify changes in unique store trends
• Know and assess the competition; leverage guest insights and feedback to drive the business and be the destination of choice for our guests
• Champion a culture where teams love to work and guests love to shop; recognize guest-service behaviors and reward outstanding performance
• Build teams that are committed to continuous learning through ongoing observations and reinforcement of guest-service and sales behaviors
• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias
• Support the leadership team in ensuring equitable experiences, strengthening inclusion acumen, and promoting a culture of inclusivity and belonging that embraces the contributions of all team members
• Engage and educate store team on Target’s community initiatives
• Build relationships that are important to the store’s community to address the most pressing local needs.
• Leverage gift card and volunteer accounts to enhance brand awareness and engage team in volunteerism.
• Take an active role in the development of leaders to be champions of a guest-centric culture
• Lead an open-door culture where team members feel heard and issues are quickly resolved
• Support leadership with creating schedules that fit both the guest and team members needs by teaching leaders the importance of understanding their team members scheduling desires.
• Decrease fluctuations within team member schedules by developing a store staffing strategy that enables store leaders to increase predictability within their current team members hours and identify when external staffing is needed
• Leverage your expertise to guide all store leaders in hiring and onboarding the talent with the right skills and experiences for their team by understanding guests’ and business needs
• Develop a team of HR Experts and Team Leaders (if applicable) who serve the total store team by solving problems, removing roadblocks and engaging each team member in a way that connects them to Target’s purpose
• Effectively plan and manage all team operational and cyclical programs related to culture, pay and rewards and benefits to maximize team member engagement and minimize business disruption
• Develop and coach your team leaders to elevate the skills and expertise of the team
• Establish a culture of accountability through clear expectations and performance management
• Provide service and a shopping experience that meets the needs of the guest
• Always demonstrate a culture of ethical conduct, safety and compliance; lead team to work in the same way and hold others accountable to this commitment
• As a key carrier, follow all safe and secure training and processes
• Address store needs (emergency, regulatory visits, etc.)
• All other duties based on business needs

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We might be a great match if:

• Working in a fun and energetic environment makes you excited…. We work efficiently and as a team to deliver for our guests
• Providing service to our guests that makes them say I LOVE TARGET! excites you…. That’s why we love working at Target
• Leading teams who are stocking, setting and selling Target product sounds like your thing… That’s the core of what we do
• You aren’t looking for Monday thru Friday job where you are at a computer all day… We are busy all day (yes, especially on the weekends), making it easy for the guest to feel welcomed, inspired and rewarded

The good news is that we have some amazing training that will help teach you everything you need to know to be an Executive Team Leader Human Resources but there are a few skills you should have from the get-go:

• 4 year degree or equivalent experience
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills
• Strong business acumen
• Comfortable dealing with ambiguity
• Manage conflict, lead and hold others accountable
• Relate well with and interact with all levels of the organization
• Strong cognitive skills, including problem analysis, decision making, financial and quantitative analysis
• Learn and adapt to current technology needs
• Manage workload and prioritize tasks independently

We are an awesome place to work and care about our teams, so we want to make sure we are clear on a few more basics that we expect:

• Access all areas of the building to respond to guest or team member issues
• Interpret instructions, reports and information
• Scan, handle and move merchandise efficiently and safely, including frequently lifting or moving merchandise up to 15 pounds and occasionally lifting or moving merchandise up to 40 pounds
• Accurately handle cash register operations

jobs.title: Process Technician
jobs.description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Micron Technology’s vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life. We are dedicated to people, innovation, tenacity, teamwork, and customer focus. This dedication allows us to fulfill our mission as a global leader in memory and storage solutions. This means conducting business with integrity, accountability, and professionalism while supporting our global community. It's an exciting time at Micron!

As Process Technician's, we perform technical tests and experiments for process of R&D engineering in the wafer fabrication area of semiconductor manufacturers. You will perform the set-up of semiconductor processing equipment and monitor, audit and provide guidance to line operators. As a Process Technician, you will also test run and prepares records, charts, and graphs of results for presentation to engineering to identify yield problems or test new products and provide technical assistance to process development and engineering personnel.

Responsibilities

• Follow all safety and environmental procedures to ensure compliance with applicable laws
• Supervise equipment performance and area efficiency
• Follow procedures while using applications to monitor equipment and increase efficiency
• Apply available resources and tools to recognize potential capacity constraints
• Verify that tool qualifications have optimally completed and restart any qualifications that have failed
• Performs Clean and Inspections (C and I) on area equipment
• Emphasizes focus on high constraint tools
• Monitors and releases area holds as per procedure
• Follows SWR instructions to process SWR’s and raises SWR related issues or concerns
• Responsible for monitoring and responding to SPC charts
• Reviews pertinent charts to ensure processes are within the defined limits
• Escalate process deviation to engineering
• Investigates root causes of Quality Deviation and writes Quality Deviation reports per procedures
• Monitors and responds to Param Alarm
• Responsible for Param Card Change
• Responsible for Functional C1D Temp Change and Card Change
• Performs CPM after changes
• Monitors Misprobe and maintains quality on tools
• Responsible for the NBS Coinstacker PM, maintenance, and Wafer and Robot recovery
• Leverage AI-enabled tools to improve productivity, decision-making, and operational efficiency.
• Apply AI-assisted solutions to analyze data, identify trends, and support business objectives.
• Utilize approved AI tools to streamline workflows, documentation, reporting, and problem solving.
• Identify opportunities for AI augmentation and automation within business processes.

Minimum Qualifications

• Knowledge of Probe manufacturing procedures, processes, or data systems
• Familiarity with working with automated systems and tools
• Ability to troubleshoot process problems and address root cause
• Proficiency in MS Word and Excel
• Time management and organization skills
• Experience with MTSPC and/or SPACE systems
• Ability to work 12-hour shifts (3 on/4 off and 4 on/3 off) with the need to stand the entire shift and lift equipment up to 20lbs
• Effective communication skills
• Is self-motivated, self advised and runs projects without direct supervision
• Strong customer service skills and is dedicated to meeting the needs of customers
• Good analytical and problem-solving skills
• Collaboration skills and the ability to build strong peer relationships

Preferred Qualifications

• Education in industry related associate degree; working towards a STEM related degree; equivalent military training and experience; equivalent work experience
• Experience using Linux systems
• Prior semiconductor experience
